  • 20 hrs/week

  • Fully remote

  • Marketing team

Company Overview

PROJXON is a Business Optimization Consulting Company that focuses on empowering High-Impact organizations in the Tech, E-Commerce, Health + Wellness, and nonprofit industries. We provide tailored holistic business solutions to combat chaos, turning failure into opportunities for growth. Our commitment to sustainable and scalable consulting plans drive growth, productivity and market value for our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Edit and assemble raw footage into polished, engaging video content aligned with brand and project goals.

  • Incorporate graphics, captions, music, and branding elements to elevate viewer engagement.

  • Manage multiple video projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and quality standards.

  • Adapt content for various platforms (social media, web, internal use) with attention to formatting and audience preferences.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, creative environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with motion graphics and animation tools (e.g., Adobe After Effects).

  • Familiarity with color grading and audio editing techniques.

  • Knowledge of social media trends and video optimization strategies (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).

  • Basic understanding of cinematography principles (lighting, framing, shot composition).

  • Experience working with branded content, marketing campaigns, or storytelling projects.

  • Ability to incorporate feedback and iterate quickly on edits.

  • Portfolio demonstrating a range of video editing projects and styles.

  • Understanding of content strategy and audience engagement metrics.

  • Experience with collaborative tools and workflows in creative teams.

Benefits of Joining PROJXON

  • Experience with working within a full (HR, IT, Bus, Ops, Marketing) team.

  • Opportunity to design and implement scalable systems within a consulting environment.

jobs.description:
About Simply.TV

At Simply.TV, we believe that finding the right show or game to watch should feel effortless — and behind that seamless experience is a passionate team making sure every title, every match, and every piece of content is accurate, rich, and ready to shine. We're a global company of 400+ people on a mission to build the world's best TV, movie, and sports data — powering content discovery for millions of viewers across the globe. If that sounds like something you'd love to be part of, we'd love to meet you.

What you will do

As a Sports Data Editor, you'll help make sure the sports information our customers rely on is accurate, complete, and up to date.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Researching and verifying information about sports events, competitions, leagues, teams, players, schedules, and results.
  • Creating, updating, and maintaining sports records in our database.
  • Reviewing metadata related to fixtures, competitions, teams, venues, participants, and event details.
  • Identifying and correcting missing, inaccurate, duplicated, or inconsistent sports data.
  • Using reliable sports sources to validate and enrich information.
  • Monitoring schedule changes, postponements, cancellations, and other updates that may affect event data.
  • Following internal editorial guidelines and quality standards to ensure consistency across our database.
  • Working quickly and accurately with large volumes of sports data, especially when information changes close to or during live events.
  • Collaborating with colleagues and other teams when information needs clarification or further investigation.
  • Learning new tools, processes, sports structures, and content standards as projects and customer needs evolve.


This is not an open position — but it could be your foot in the door!

We're building a community of talented, detail-driven people who are passionate about TV, movies, streaming content, and working with data.

While there isn't an open position right now, joining our TV & Streaming Editorial Talent Pool gives us the opportunity to get to know you before a new project or position becomes available. If your profile matches what we're looking for, we'll invite you to complete a short skills test followed by a screening interview with one of our recruiters.

You'll then become part of our Talent Pool and be among the first people we contact when a relevant opportunity opens at Simply.TV.

How it works

There's no open role right now, but we believe great people shouldn't have to wait for a job posting.

If you're passionate about movies, TV series, streaming platforms, entertainment content, and working with data — and you want to work with a global team that powers content discovery for millions of viewers — we'd love to get to know you early.

Here's what to expect:

  1. You apply and we review your profile.
  2. If there's a match, we'll invite you to complete a short skills test.
  3. You'll then have a screening interview with one of our recruiters.
  4. Once a relevant new project or position becomes available, you'll be among the first people we contact.

Requirements

Must Haves

  • Location: Pakistan
  • Strong knowledge of European football leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1) and broader international sports coverage would be an advantage
  • Able to recognize major teams, leagues, competitions, common abbreviations, and season structures.
  • Genuine interest in sports and habit of following sports news/results regularly.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with large amounts of sports data.
  • Comfortable researching and verifying information using reliable online sources.
  • Good written English and ability to understand sports terminology in English.
  • Able to work independently, follow detailed guidelines, and consistently meet quality standards.
  • Comfortable with repetitive/data-heavy work and working across multiple sports or competitions.

Nice to Haves

  • Broader knowledge of international football, tennis, motorsport, combat sports, golf, or other major global sports.
  • Previous experience with: sports data; sports media; TV metadata; editorial/data-entry work; statistics or sports databases.
  • Experience working with databases, spreadsheets, or internal data tools.
  • Understanding of sports scheduling, fixtures, tournaments, playoffs, conferences/divisions, and event formats.
  • Experience working in an international or remote team.

Please note - we can only accept CVs in English!

Benefits

Collaboration based on a freelancer set-up is up to 450€ per month on a full-time allocation basis (40 hours per week).

jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages.

Our CRAs work with a manageable study portfolio, allowing them to build deep protocol and site knowledge rather than spreading their focus across too many studies. With reasonable travel expectations, accessible line management and a smaller CRO environment, experienced CRAs have the autonomy to make decisions, influence how studies are delivered and see the impact of their work.

Precision for Medicine is recruiting a Clinical Research Associate II /Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our full-service team in Poland.

** This position is fully home based **

About you:

  • You are an experienced independent monitor who takes ownership of your sites and does not wait to be told what needs attention.
  • You understand what really matters for patient safety, data integrity and study delivery, and can distinguish critical risks from administrative noise.
  • You build credible relationships with investigators and site teams while remaining confident in addressing difficult or sensitive issues.
  • You identify emerging risks early, escalate appropriately and come with solutions, not just problems.
  • You are organized and well prepared, able to manage competing priorities across your sites without compromising quality.
  • You communicate clearly with CTMs and study teams and can confidently represent the site perspective in project discussions.
  • You take responsibility for the quality and outcomes of your work.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

You will independently manage and monitor investigative sites, taking ownership of site performance, quality and risk identification from site initiation through close-out.

You will partner closely with CTMs and study teams to anticipate issues, drive timely resolution and ensure studies are conducted, recorded and reported in accordance with the protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP and applicable regulatory requirements.

You may also interact directly with clients and support site payment activities.

Depending on your experience, you may have the opportunity to mentor less experienced CRAs and contribute your expertise to study-level discussions and process improvements.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • 3+ years of independent monitoring experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry
  • Independent monitoring experience in oncology clinical trials

Other Required:

  • Availability for domestic travel, including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50–60% travel commitment; occasional international travel may be required
  • Fluency in Polish and English

Preferred:

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree with a concentration in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Experience monitoring complex early-phase oncology studies, including Phase I and/or CAR-T trials

Why Precision for Medicine?

Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

Precision for Medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer—and we are passionate about helping you harness its power. We strike tumors on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway.

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching groundbreaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day. You will provide input and have your ideas valued and nurtured, impacting positive changes for the company.

Please, apply in English.

Location:Remote — work from home in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, or Utah

Employment type: Full-time

Base salary range: $80,000 - $88,000 per year, plus performance-based incentives

The opportunity

Sensibly Sprouted is hiring a Registered Dietitian Manager to build and lead a team of dietitians providing outpatient Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT). You’ll play a central role in interviewing and selecting team members, coach their development, and shape how your team delivers care.

This is a developmental management role for dietitians ready to move into formal people leadership. Prior management experience is not required.

Internally, this position is called Junior Lead. You’ll report to the Chief Dietetics Officer and have management authority from day one. The broader leadership team will support you as you handle increasingly complex team, financial, and operational decisions. Your focus is team leadership; you may provide patient care when needed, but the role has no fixed caseload.

What you’ll do

  • Take a lead role in interviewing, selecting, and onboarding dietitians as you build your team.
  • Coach and develop team members, set expectations, give feedback, and address performance concerns.
  • Own team revenue, profitability, retention, and productive capacity; use performance data to identify risks and take action.
  • Reinforce clinical, documentation, scheduling, and operational standards, partnering with Clinical Excellence on training needs.
  • Manage team workflows and priorities, involving senior leadership when decisions require their input.

What you’ll bring

  • A Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential.
  • Applicable state licensure, or eligibility to obtain required licensure.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach others, lead initiatives, and improve team performance. A prior manager title is not required.
  • Sound judgment, clear communication, dependable follow-through, and comfort using performance data to guide decisions.
  • Residence in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, or Utah, or willingness to relocate to one of these states.
  • Authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

Your growth

Junior Lead provides support and feedback as you gain experience with increasingly complex leadership situations. Advancement to Lead is the expected next step after at least four quarters, once you demonstrate sustained Lead-level capability and performance. When you advance, your base pay moves into the Lead salary range.

Benefits

Eligible team members receive medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer healthcare contributions; a 401(k) with a 3% employer non-matching contribution; paid time off and holidays; and professional development support. Sensibly Sprouted also pays required professional liability insurance, state licensure fees, and CDR registration and renewal fees where applicable.

About Sensibly Sprouted

We are a team of registered dietitians providing personalized, evidence-based nutrition counseling and Medical Nutrition Therapy. Our care emphasizes ongoing patient relationships and practical changes that fit real life.

Sensibly Sprouted is an equal opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants.

jobs.description:
• Lead long-term infrastructure assessments and sequencing to support Auckland's growth and development
    • Build a robust, evidence-based understanding of infrastructure requirements to support housing and employment growth.
    • Coordinate across Council, CCOs, and external stakeholders to align infrastructure responses to growth.

He angitūtanga: The opportunity

Auckland Council's Development Programmes team is seeking a Senior Programme Manager for a 12-month fixed-term opportunity to lead infrastructure assessments and coordinate Infrastructure Investment and Phasing (IIP) activities across a range of locations in Auckland.

This role sits within a growing programme of work to build a comprehensive, long-term understanding of infrastructure requirements across Auckland. The team focuses on long-term infrastructure planning, assessment, sequencing, and investment prioritisation. Rather than delivering physical infrastructure projects, the team develops the evidence base and strategic direction that helps shape where, when, and how infrastructure investment is needed to support growth.

You will play a critical role in developing a long-term view of infrastructure requirements, aligning infrastructure providers across multiple organisations and mandates, and informing sequencing to support housing, employment, and broader strategic outcomes. This is a strategic planning and coordination role focused on influencing future infrastructure investment decisions, rather than delivering infrastructure projects or overseeing construction programmes.

This includes responding to both planned and unplanned growth in a dynamic and evolving planning environment. You will often work with incomplete information, requiring sound judgement to develop a clear and credible view of infrastructure needs.

Your work will contribute to a robust and defensible evidence base that supports infrastructure planning, investment prioritisation, and funding decisions across Auckland. Working at the intersection of growth, infrastructure, and strategic planning, you will help ensure Auckland is well-positioned to respond to future development opportunities and challenges.

 

Day-to-day you could expect to work on:

  • Leading infrastructure assessment programmes across a range of locations in Auckland
    • Advising on infrastructure sequencing and priority infrastructure requirements to support growth, rather than delivering physical infrastructure projects
    • Lead cross-council assessments of unanticipated development proposals, identifying cumulative infrastructure impacts, service gaps, and choices about when infrastructure should be provided.
    • Develop evidence and advice on how infrastructure costs arising from unanticipated growth could be funded or recovered, working with Council teams and infrastructure providers.
    • Coordinating across Council teams, CCOs, developers, and other stakeholders with differing priorities
    • Informing Auckland’s Spatial Plan, Infrastructure Strategy, and related planning frameworks
    • Managing budgets, reporting, risks, and programme governance

He kōrero mōu: About you

We are looking for a strategic thinker and programme manager who thrives in complex, high-stakes and ambiguous environments.

You will have:

  • Experience in infrastructure planning, urban development, or programme management
    • Strong stakeholder engagement and coordination skills
    • Analytical and strategic thinking for long-term planning
    • Clear, confident communication – written and oral
    • Relevant technical qualification (planning, engineering, urban design, or similar)
    • Experience in horizontal infrastructure planning and/or urban development programmes

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with infrastructure staging, sequencing, or growth planning frameworks
    • Familiarity with Auckland growth and development context
    • GIS/spatial data skills

• Public sector experience

Auckland Council is the largest local government council across Oceania, serving over 1.7 million people and contributing towards making Tāmaki Makaurau a world-class city.

The Difference You Will Make:

The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging.   • Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze
  • Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others
  • Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business
  • Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders
  • Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards
  • Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting
  • Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.


Position Purpose:

The Manager of Delivery Management is an experienced project professional responsible for leading a combination of planning and execution of activities related to the delivery of large initiatives and/or financial/budgeting activities for their teams. Managers are responsible for leading a team of project management professionals. They are also responsible for attracting, retaining, and developing top talent. When leading project delivery, Managers support their team in execution of their projects. They are also responsible for leading large, cross functional initiatives across the organization. When performing financial/budgeting activities they are responsible for developing and implementing efficient and accurate processes for financial management. They are also responsible for maintaining vendor relationships, partnering with other leaders to influence contract negotiations. They are also responsible for providing leadership financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 50% Delivery & Execution - Works with stakeholders to support the project planning effort, including the formulation of the project scope, definition of the project deliverables and the required delivery dates, creation of a logical work breakdown structure, and definition of major project milestones; Awareness of overall change management needs across both business and technology groups. Applies and guides team on change management processes and practices across programs, project and/ initiatives. Collaborates with stakeholders to integrate technology changes into the overall change roadmap; Understands organizational/initiative goals and guides team members to align processes and project work. Proactively identifies barriers and partners with leadership to mitigate. Facilitates across multiple domains and complex initiatives; Applies and guides team members on Project Management best practices. Collaborates with leaders to create standards and processes that increase business value. Supports and executes against quarterly planning and prioritization. Applies lessons learned to inform future initiatives; Works with stakeholders to determine and align dependencies, then proactively risk and issues via identification and mitigation plans; Sets outcome-focused goals and ensures accountability to deliver on commitments. Scope typically includes execution and/or supporting team of large, complex projects across matrix organization. Leads team through issue / obstacle resolution in order to maintain team momentum and productivity; Ability to communicate and negotiate across the organization. Seeks to understand stakeholder perspective and apply it to project delivery. Guides project team to develop their communication plan and stakeholder approach
  • 25% People Leadership - Attracts, retains, and develops top talent; Provides leadership, mentoring, and coaching to the team
  • 25% Resource & Financial Management - Maintains vendor relationships. Partners with other leaders to make suggestions on pricing negotiations, SLAs, resource plans, etc.; Executes and leads fiscal management and reporting for operational, product/business, technology, and vendor stakeholders; includes gross labor, capital spend, and non-labor forecasting for tracking, reporting, and variance analysis

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

  • This Position typically reports to Sr Mgr of Delivery Management
  • This Position has 1 direct report

Travel Requirements:

  • Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time.

Physical Requirements:

  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position, and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.
  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
  • Working knowledge of Tableau
  • Working knowledge of presentation software (e.g., Microsoft PowerPoint)
  • Ability to draw accurate conclusions from financial documentation
  • Demonstrated project management skills
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work
  • Ability to negotiate, handle complaints, settle disputes, and resolve grievances with both internal and external customers effectively with cross-functional teams
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience
  • Deep experience in project delivery across different types of initiatives in a matrix environment
  • Deep experience with Microsoft Office tools and Project Management tools (MS Project, JIRA, etc.)
  • Deep experience with the planning and execution of projects and risk mitigation strategies;
  • Deep experience with project management execution in a modern software environment via multiple methodologies with blended approaches based on project goals; deep experience managing technical projects
  • Experience managing and growing team members in a professional setting

Minimum Education:

  • The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.

Preferred Education:

  • No additional education

Preferred Years of Work Experience:

Minimum Leadership Experience:

Preferred Leadership Experience:

Certifications:

  • None

  • Instills Trust

jobs.title: Global Study Manager – Clinical Research , Central Labs Services
jobs.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a remote Global Study Manager to join our Central Labs Services team.


Job Responsibilities

  • Key contact for clients; Liaison between Clients, CRO, and Labcorp
  • Ensure successful interactions between Labcorp study team members needed to provide seamless study delivery to the client.
  • Provide project management oversight, focusing on key client deliverables through budget, risk, and milestone management.
  • Facilitate communications between Client and extended Labcorp study team, including Study Design Lead and Regional Study Coordinator.
  • Perform review of Statement of Work (SOW) to ensure quality implementation of client specifics and requirements.
  • Manage a portfolio of global and local studies with varying complexities.
  • Act as an ambassador on behalf of the client within Labcorp Central Labs and across Labcorp business units; exemplifies the concept of Signature Client Service through outstanding, personalized customer service skills
  • Work with appropriate internal and external personnel to understand the culture and pipeline of assigned clients
  • Participate in functional meetings and provide input, keeping processes up to date
  • Comply with Central Labs Global Project Management strategy
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement, quality, and productivity

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 6 years or more of experience in clinical research
  • 2 years or more of project management experience
  • 2 years or more of direct client and stakeholder engagement experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences
  • 2 years or more of experience working within Labcorp's CLS group

Additional Job Standards

  • Proven ability to manage internal and external customer relationships, including handling escalations and delivering high‑quality client support
  • Demonstrated success operating in fast‑paced environments with shifting priorities; strong ability to plan, organize, problem‑solve, and manage competing deadlines
  • Exceptional organizational and analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities

At Labcorp, we believe in the power of science to change lives. We are a leading global life sciences company that delivers answers for crucial health questions. Through our unparalleled diagnostics and drug development capabilities, we provide insights and accelerate innovations that not only empower patients and providers but help medical, biotech, and pharmaceutical companies transform ideas into innovations.


Central Laboratory Services is part of a global contract research organization within Labcorp. We offer the world’s largest network of central laboratories and support global clinical trials testing. A common set of processes, procedures, and instrumentation is offered throughout our sites in Europe, Asia/Pacific, and the United States, allowing us to receive samples globally and provide more than 700 assays across all laboratory science disciplines.

Pay Range: 70-90K

jobs.description:
Alkira is growing our Solutions Architect (SA) team and looking for high-energy, dedicated professionals who can help new and existing clients succeed on our Network-Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform.

Sr. Lead Solution Architects are hands-on technologists who embed directly with our largest strategic Enterprise accounts — from pre-sales technical validation through production deployment, adoption, and expansion.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the key technical differentiators of the Alkira service, architect and build alongside customer teams, and help enterprises transform their network to become disruptive, creative, and innovative. As a SA, you sit at the intersection of Sales, Engineering, and the customer: you win technical evaluations, deploy real solutions in customer environments, and shape the product roadmap with a deep understanding of customer technical needs.

Responsibilities

  • Embed with strategic customers as the hands-on technical owner from evaluation through production deployment
  • Lead network architecture discussions with customers and partners
  • Design, build, and deploy Alkira-based solutions in customer environments using best practices
  • Develop automation, integrations, and tooling (Terraform, APIs, scripting) to accelerate customer deployments
  • Collaborate directly with customer networking, cloud, and platform teams
  • Conduct technical workshops, trainings, and whiteboard sessions for customers and partners
  • Create design and architecture best practices, reference architectures, and deployment guidelines
  • Provide deep technical support and troubleshooting for customers, escalating and driving resolution with Engineering
  • Own customer success on key accounts from adoption and expansion perspective
  • Work with Alkira Product Management and Engineering to provide feedback on upcoming features from the customer's lens
  • Track and drive key customer features/asks with Product Management through to implementation

Minimum Requirements

  • Strong cloud and networking fundamentals
  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (consulting, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or professional services)
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience architecting and deploying cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP, and/or OCI)
  • Hands-on experience designing and building hybrid and public cloud infrastructure
  • Strong networking background in routing technologies and network security
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Python, REST APIs)
  • Experience in large-scale network design/deployment is a plus
  • Strong passion for customer outcomes and creating long-lasting professional relationships
  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites
  • Relevant technical certifications are a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • BA/BS/MS degree is a plus

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

jobs.excerpt: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

The Food Safety and Quality Assurance team helps ensure CookUnity’s meals meet food safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Working across Culinary, Supply Chain, Procurement, Nutrition & Standards, Food Science Lab, Legal, Marketing, Design, Product, Engineering, and Operations, the team supports accurate product information and consistent execution across our markets.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Director of Labeling and Nutrition Compliance to lead labeling and nutrition compliance across our meals, ingredient data, product claims, and customer-facing information.

You will own the overall source-to-label process, including governance, performance metrics, third-party laboratory validation, and approval of product and nutrition claims. You will establish technical acceptance criteria, verify data suitability, coordinate cross-functional deliverables, and manage the label and content release process, withholding approval when supporting evidence is insufficient.

This role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to lead within a cross-functional organization. You will establish clear accountability, verify nutrition and labeling information, and ensure teams have practical controls for maintaining compliance as ingredients, recipes, suppliers, systems, and markets evolve.

Within your first 90 days, you will establish technical acceptance criteria and a risk-ranked review baseline, verify a representative set of supplier and market substitutions delivered by Supply Chain, and demonstrate an independently reviewed, controlled release pilot that includes label-to-website reconciliation. You will also align ongoing verification and escalation measures with functional owners, while Supply Chain retains ownership of the data remediation plan and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Lead CookUnity’s labeling and nutrition compliance program. Establish practical standards consistent with applicable Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA) requirements for ingredient declarations, allergens, Nutrition Facts, serving sizes, net quantity, claims, required statements, and market-specific labeling, in partnership with Nutrition & Standards.

  • Own the create, review, approve, and distribute (CRAD) labeling process, governance, and consolidated KPI dashboard. Define functional accountability, independent review requirements, approval records, version controls, release criteria, escalation paths, and corrective-action follow-through.

  • Define regulatory and technical requirements for ingredient master data owned by Supply Chain Operations. Lead the specification approval and stakeholder sign-off process, including supplier-item and market specificity, source evidence, approved substitutions, and acceptance criteria.

  • Review and approve ingredient data eligibility for labeling and claims, tracking and escalating unresolved dependencies.

  • Own third-party laboratory validation, including lab qualification, risk-based representative sampling across suppliers and markets, appropriate testing methods, and comparison against approved recipes, portions, declared nutrition, and claim criteria.

  • Investigate laboratory discrepancies and drive verified corrections through the accountable data, recipe, or execution owner.

  • Approve product, nutrition, standards, ingredient, and dietary claims before publication across channels. Require substantiation, approved wording, applicability and conditions, review dates, and change control.

  • Obtain documented Food Science Lab approval of the nutritional basis for claims, required Legal concurrence, and appropriately qualified clinical approval of medically tailored meal criteria.

  • Set risk-based technical review priorities for estimated and generic legacy records. Partner with Supply Chain, which owns data remediation and maintenance, to verify corrections, assess supplier and market equivalence, and confirm impacts on recipes, nutrition values, allergens, and claims.

  • Manage the compliance impact of supplier, ingredient, recipe, process, portion, packaging, and system changes. Require affected products and claims to be reassessed before release, including substitutions and market-specific variants.

  • Establish technical acceptance criteria for labeling and data systems. Partner with Engineering to verify source-to-label and website field mappings, controlled synchronization, and automated completeness, calculation, rounding, and version checks.

  • Require production first-article checks and ongoing label-to-meal verification. Partner with Operations and Supply Chain on approved masters, effective dates, acknowledgment of changes, and removal of obsolete labels and templates.

  • Verify consistency between approved label master data and customer-facing channels, including the CookUnity website, for ingredients, allergens, nutrition values, serving details, and claims.

  • Define website reconciliation criteria and verify publication and correction evidence. Partner with Growth Marketing/SEO, which owns website accuracy, publishing, discrepancy correction, and the website parity KPI, and escalate safety or compliance discrepancies through the incident process.

  • Exercise delegated authority to hold or reject nonconforming label and content releases. Ensure independent review of technical work you prepare and escalate product holds, disposition decisions, and unresolved safety or compliance issues to the VP of FSQA under established procedures.

  • Maintain inspection-ready records and train cross-functional teams on labeling requirements, approval workflows, and operating controls.

  • Maintain the overall CRAD KPI dashboard covering technical data acceptance, Culinary recipe and portion conformity, laboratory-versus-declared accuracy, claims compliance, release performance, defects, and corrective actions. Incorporate Growth Marketing/SEO’s website parity and coverage results, coordinate functional delivery, and escalate gaps while each function owns its evidence, results, and corrective actions.

  • Drive a consistent process in which released products have traceable inputs, supported claims, documented independent review, approved market-specific labels, consistent website content, and verified production execution.

Qualifications

  • Deep, practical experience in food-labeling regulations, nutrition, and standards compliance, including hands-on technical review of packaged food labels, ingredient and allergen declarations, nutrition calculations, and claim substantiation.

  • Strong working knowledge of applicable U.S. FDA food-labeling requirements and the ability to determine when USDA FSIS or other market requirements apply, with qualified specialist support as needed.

  • Experience connecting supplier specifications, ingredient databases, formulations, recipe systems, nutrition analysis, artwork, and production execution through controlled workflows.

  • Sound technical judgment regarding ingredient variability, cooking yields, portioning, laboratory results, and the limitations of calculated nutrition.

  • Ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into clear acceptance criteria and practical operating controls.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional programs, resolving ownership gaps, and implementing change without relying solely on direct reporting authority.

  • Clear written communication, careful documentation, and confidence holding a release when supporting evidence is incomplete.

  • A degree in food science, nutrition, regulatory science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in multi-site prepared meal operations.

  • Experience with recipe-management systems and supplier-data platforms.

  • Familiarity with Canadian food-labeling requirements.

  • Registered Dietitian credentials. Clinical standards and medically tailored meal criteria require appropriately qualified expertise.

What we look for in an exceptional candidate

jobs.description:
About The Role

KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.

This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.
  • Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.
  • Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.
  • Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.
  • Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.
  • Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.
  • Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.
  • Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.
  • Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.
  • Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.
  • Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.
  • Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.
  • Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.
  • The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

  • Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.
  • Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.
  • CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

  • Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG.
  • A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.
  • A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.
  • Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.
  • European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

Professional Competencies

Collaborative Spirit | Results Above All | Innovation as a Habit | Creative Freedom | Financial Prudence | Eternal Learner | Daring Adventures | Open Feedback | Integrity in Action | Embrace Change | Accountability

The Services Technology Risk team is looking for a Director, Service Technology Risk professional to help maintain secure, resilient, and trusted technology environments while enabling innovation and growth.

Role:
The Director, Services Technology Risk will lead the identification, assessment, prioritization, monitoring, and escalation of technology and operational risks across Services. This role will develop risk management strategies and frameworks, including risk registers, product risk assessments, and risk and control self-assessments, providing leadership with clear insights to support informed decisions.
The role will partner with Product, Engineering, and Security teams to embed risk management into business and technology processes, strengthen accountability, and ensure risks are effectively managed. The Director, Technology Risk Identification & Assessment will:

• Translate complex technology risks into clear business impact, tradeoffs, and actionable insights to support leadership decision-making, prioritization, investment, and remediation.
• Provide Services leadership with an integrated view of the risk profile, including material exposures, emerging risks, accepted risks, trends, and areas requiring management attention.
• Partner across Engineering, Product, Security, Business, and enterprise risk functions to drive consistent risk practices, reduce fragmentation and duplication, and strengthen overall risk management across Services.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity, resolving competing priorities, and establishing structure where processes are not yet mature.

jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

The AVP, Strategy & Executive Operations serves as Chief of Staff and trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution and as a member of the Distribution Executive Leadership Team. The role enhances executive effectiveness, facilitates strategic planning, coordinates cross-functional priorities, and manages the leadership operating cadence across Exclusive Agency, Personal Auto, Commercial Auto, Lead Generation, Direct to Consumer, Marketing, and Distribution Enablement.


The Chief of Staff serves as a strategic advisor and force multiplier to the Head of Distribution, shaping the leadership processes through which executive leaders align on strategy, priorities, business performance, and enterprise decisions. The role creates organizational leverage by connecting priorities across functions, anticipating risks and dependencies, improving decision quality, and ensuring leaders have the insights and alignment needed to drive business outcomes. The Head of Distribution and functional executives retain accountability for strategic choices, resource decisions, operational execution, and business results. Acting as a strategic extension of the Head of Distribution, this role synthesizes information, frames complex issues anticipates and surfaces risks and opportunities, facilitates alignment, and ensures executive commitments receive appropriate follow-through and enables effective executive decision-making across a highly matrixed organization.


The Chief of Staff does not assume accountability for business results, functional execution, project delivery, or organizational decision rights. Functional leaders remain accountable for strategy execution and outcomes. The Chief of Staff creates value through strategic insight, organizational alignment, executive decision support, and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:


Executive partnership and leadership effectiveness: Serve as a trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution; anticipate leadership needs, prepare executive briefings and decision materials, coordinate sensitive cross-functional matters, and facilitate follow-through on executive commitments and help focus leadership attention on the highest value opportunities, risks, and decisions.


Strategic planning process: Design and facilitate the annual and ongoing strategic planning process. Coordinate inputs from executive leaders, structure planning discussions, document strategic choices, and integrate functional plans into a coherent Distribution agenda while leaders retain ownership of strategy and execution.


Executive governance and operating cadence: Establish and manage leadership meetings, business reviews, planning forums, agendas, decision logs, escalation paths, and accountability tracking that enable organizational alignment, transparency, and effective execution. Coordinate executive committee, CEO, and Board materials as requested.

Cross-functional alignment: Facilitate coordination across Exclusive Agency, Personal Auto, Commercial Auto, Lead Generation, Direct to Consumer, Marketing, and Distribution Enablement, as well as Finance, Product, Underwriting, Claims, Operations, Technology, and other enterprise partners by connecting priorities, resolving ambiguity, identifying dependencies, and ensuring critical decisions and information flow effectively across organizational boundaries.


Performance insights and decision support: Coordinate executive scorecards and business performance reviews; synthesize financial, operational, customer, and distribution information; identify trends, emerging risks, opportunities, trade-offs, and strategic implications requiring leadership attention.


Strategic portfolio visibility: Maintains an integrated view of major initiatives, strategic priorities, critical dependencies, organizational friction points, and emerging risks. Proactively identify potential collisions, surface issues early, and facilitate executive dialogue to enable timely decisions and course correction.


Executive communication: Support consistent communication of Distribution priorities and leadership decisions across functions and enterprise stakeholders; prepare executive narratives, updates, and presentations.


Organizational effectiveness: Creates organizational leverage for the Head of Distribution by connecting priorities, aligning stakeholders, reducing complexity, accelerating decision-making, and ensuring leadership attention remains focused on the issues most critical to business performance and growth.

  • Experience influencing multidisciplinary teams and senior leaders in a matrixed organization; direct line authority over functional execution is not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect business performance, financial outcomes, customer insights, and market dynamics into actionable executive recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive-level briefings and materials for senior management, executive committees, and Boards.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, analytical judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, and ability to synthesize complex information into actionable decisions.

Location: Remote (U.S. and globally) or in-person at ELAW’s office in Eugene, Oregon USA.

Candidates should indicate whether they intend to work remotely, or from ELAW’s Eugene office. The Eugene office is a historic building. In-person internships may include additional opportunities to interact with visiting lawyers.

Timing: 10 weeks between late May and September 2027 (full-time, ~40 hours/week). We are open to considering a different timeframe to accommodate other academic schedules. If you need a different timeframe, please clearly describe that in your application materials.

Eligibility: Open to students enrolled in or who have recently completed a graduate-level studies in environmental science. International applicants with equivalent science education are welcome to apply and should describe how their academic or professional background prepares them to succeed in this role.

The Science internship with the ELAW Science Program team involves communication in English. For applicants from non-English speaking countries, we will work with applicants to identify the best method of establishing proof of English language proficiency (including but not limited to TOEFL or IELTS scores, or enrollment in an English-speaking LLM, as proof of English language proficiency). Spanish or French as a first language or proficiency is a welcome asset.

Compensation: While applicants are encouraged to seek funding through school grants or external scholarships, financial aid status is never considered during candidate selection. ELAW will supplement external funding to guarantee that all interns receive a total rate of $17.50 per hour for 10 weeks of full-time work (up to $7,000 total).

Who We Are

Environmental Law Alliance Worldwide (ELAW) is an international NGO, registered in Oregon as a nonprofit. At ELAW, we believe that environmental protection and human rights are inseparable—and that the best solutions come from those closest to the problem. That’s why we support a global network of public interest lawyers and scientists in 80+ countries working to protect communities and ecosystems through law.

The Science & Economics team delivers timely scientific and economic expertise to global public interest advocates in pursuit of environmental justice. We respond to individual requests from public interest environmental lawyers on a broad range of topics, including public health, ecology, air and water quality, marine environments, natural resources, and climate science.

As a Science & Economics Intern, you’ll directly support these efforts—gaining hands-on experience, dedicated mentorship, and global exposure while empowering communities with science-backed arguments for systemic change. Learn more at .

What You’ll Do

Over the course of your internship, you will:

  • Conduct science research and draft memos on a wide range of scientific topics.
  • Analyze and summarize studies in the peer-reviewed scientific literature.
  • Assist with drafting of memos that answer questions pertaining to environmental science for use in submissions to courts and administrative agencies. briefs, regulatory analyses, or resource updates;
  • Participate as a collaborative member of a science team that supports interns through meaningful mentorship; and
  • Observe strategic and information gathering meetings with local lawyer partners;

Recent intern projects have included:

  • Evaluation of environmental impact assessments to identify deficiencies that might be grounds for rejecting approval of environmentally harmful projects.
  • Interpretation of air and water quality data to identify levels that pose risks to human health of wildlife and that might exceed health-based and ecological-based environmental standards

Who Thrives in This Internship

Successful interns tend to be:

  • Deeply committed to public interest environmental justice, and human rights;
  • Curious, meticulous researchers who write clearly and think critically;
  • Collaborative and communicative, but self-directed in managing time and projects;
  • Adaptable and open-minded, eager to learn across legal systems and cultures; and
  • Multilingual or bring lived experience from frontline or underrepresented communities (preferred but not required)

What Success Looks Like

  • Meaningful Scientific Contribution: You complete high-quality research and writing that directly supports frontline legal partners.
  • Strong Mentorship Relationships: You build supportive, lasting connections with ELAW scientists who care deeply about your growth.
  • Clarity on Career Path: You leave with insight into your values, your place in the global environmental justice movement, and what comes next.
  • Positive Community Impact: Your work contributes to legal tools to better protect those defending the environment.

What Makes This Internship Unique

  • Global Exposure: Interns engage with the use of scientific information in environmental advocacy with partners in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and beyond.
  • Hands-On Experience: This is not a siloed research position—you’ll work on live issues and real-world advocacy.
  • Movement-Aligned Mentorship: Interns receive clear supervision, collaborative feedback, and intentional support.
  • A Mission-Driven Team: Our team is collaborative, inclusive, and grounded in shared values—not just expertise.
  • Remote Flexibility with Real Connection: Whether remote or in Eugene, interns are included in meetings, team communications, and one-on-one check-ins.

How to Apply

Please submit one PDF file that includes the following documents in this order:

  1. Cover letter (1 page) describing your interest in ELAW and this opportunity, what you hope to gain from the internship, and relevant experiences or skills
  2. Resume or CV
  3. Legal writing sample (10 pages max)

Apply by October 23, 2026

Note: We may send updates via BambooHR. Please monitor your inbox (including spam/junk folders) for messages from us.

Our Commitment to Equity

We actively seek interns from diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from those historically underrepresented in the legal field.

We recognize that unpaid or underfunded internships create barriers for many students. To expand access, ELAW offers fully remote, 10-week full-time internships compensated at $17.50 per hour (up to $7,000 total).

We do not expect all candidates to follow the same academic or professional path. If your experience doesn't match our eligibility criteria exactly but you’ve completed rigorous science education that you believe is equivalent to two years of graduate-level science education — we encourage you to explain in your cover letter how your background prepares you to succeed in this internship.

In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution of revenue accounting as AcuityMD scales. You will partner with Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Finance so complex deals are understood before they close, and you will help build the controls and processes that keep us audit-ready as we grow.

Responsibilities

  • Revenue recognition: Apply ASC 606 to new and amended contracts, including performance obligations, standalone selling price allocation, contract modifications, and variable consideration for usage-based fees.
  • Month-end and quarter-end close: Prepare revenue entries, deferred revenue schedules, and contract-level reconciliations on a predictable close calendar.
  • Systems and data integrity: Maintain the sub-ledger flow between HubSpot and Rillet, reconcile contract data to revenue schedules, and flag gaps before they reach the close.
  • Contract review and deal support: Review non-standard terms such as discounts, free or bundled services, and renewals and upsells, and give Sales and Deal Desk fast, clear guidance on revenue treatment.
  • Commissions accounting: Support capitalized contract cost accounting under ASC 340-40, including amortization schedules and period-end true-ups. [Confirm scope with Jess]
  • Audit readiness: Build and maintain support for revenue and deferred revenue balances, draft technical memos, and respond to auditor requests.
  • Process improvement: Document procedures, tighten controls, and automate manual steps so the function scales without adding headcount at the same pace.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Explain revenue implications in plain language to non-finance teams and help reduce close-time fire drills.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or CPA-eligible preferred.
  • 4–6 years of revenue accounting experience in public accounting and/or a high-growth SaaS company.
  • Hands-on ASC 606 experience with multi-element and usage-based contracts, including SSP analysis and contract modifications.
  • Experience owning a revenue close, including deferred revenue roll-forwards and reconciliations.
  • Comfort with cloud ERP and billing systems (Rillet experience a plus) and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Clear communicator who can explain GAAP to Sales, Legal, and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • B2B SaaS experience, ideally MedTech or another regulated vertical.
  • Usage-based or hybrid pricing experience and the related ASC 606 implications.
  • Experience with ASC 340-40 deferred commissions.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot CRM and its integration to a revenue sub-ledger.
  • Exposure to SOX scoping or public company readiness work.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. Who We Are:

The ideal candidate will have education and experience in organic regulations, organic and/or sustainable farming methods and production, and familiarity with the various production scopes that MCS certifies. Experience in food processing is a plus. The Certification Specialist reports to the MCS Director and works collaboratively with MCS staff, specialists, and inspectors. This position requires some field work, including inspections, residue sampling, and investigations. Priority will be given to candidates who apply before November 13, 2026

Overview: The Certification Specialist provides high quality customer service along with skilled review and auditing verification to support positive organic certification experiences for organic producers in our service territory, while upholding the USDA National Organic Program regulations. This position assesses compliance of an operation’s organic system plan, reviews inspection reports, and issues subsequent responses, primarily within the livestock and dairy scopes. This position works collaboratively with other certification specialists, inspection program manager, and inspectors, and conducts inspections and pesticide residue sampling as time allows. Certification Specialists also support the MCS quality management system, and may represent MCS at conferences or other MOFGA events. Contributing to MCS policy development, writing pieces for MCS’ newsletter, The Organic Sprout, is an expectation for this position.

Requirements:

  • Education or experience in organic certification or regulatory compliance, including inspections and auditing.
  • Knowledge of the USDA-National Organic Program standards, especially as it applies to crop, livestock/dairy, , and processing.
  • Working knowledge of organic or sustainable crop and livestock farms, dairies, and food processing.
  • A demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, especially in writing.
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Proficiency in computer software, including databases and collaborative platforms.
  • Strong interpersonal skills that welcome collaboration and constructive feedback.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle
  • A commitment to MOFGA’s mission and values.
  • IOIA training and prior organic inspection experience a plus
  • College degree in agriculture or related field a plus
  • Must be able to travel to attend meetings, training workshops and conferences.
  • Participate in MOFGA’s Common Ground Country Fair as needed.

Certification Specialist Responsibilities:

  • Performs certification activities for clients including these specific activities:
    • Perform technical reviews of organic system plans, primarily within the livestock and dairy scope. Communicates according to policy with producers about the results of these reviews.
    • Review inspection reports for these same clients. Communicates according to policy with producers about the results of these reviews.
    • Assists applicants by explaining the organic standards and the certification process, encouraging them to take advantage of the technical services offered by MOFGA.
    • Pursues adverse actions with clients in accordance with MCS policy and in coordination with colleagues/supervisors.
    • Keeps track of clients; assures that auditable files are in good order.
  • Conduct annual, investigative and/or unannounced inspections or residue sampling as time allows.
  • Performs material review of products as needed and in conjunction with other MCS staff and agency affiliates.
  • Investigates complaints to protect the integrity of the organic label. Pursues adverse actions, as necessary.
  • Participation in MCS internal audits and NOP accreditation audits.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as deemed necessary to carry out MOFGA’s certification program and maintain accreditation with USDA.

Physical Requirements: Ability to walk long distances over rough terrain; occasional light lifting; ability to drive and travel long distances by car. Able to work in outdoor conditions that include all types of seasonal weather, as well as, inside environments where there may be loud noises or strong odors. Ability to sit for long periods to complete computer-based work, participate in meetings, and conduct organic inspections, whether in person or over video conference platforms.

The Maine Organic Farmers and Gardeners Association (MOFGA) is a broad-based community that supports farmers, empowers people to feed their communities, and advocates for an organic future. Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.
  • Build a library of well-tested, reusable Terraform modules with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Implement Terraform automation pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Atlantis, Terraform Cloud, or Spacelift, with plan/apply gating, drift detection, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and enforce policy-as-code using Sentinel, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Conftest, or Checkov to prevent insecure or non-compliant infrastructure changes.
  • Manage Terraform state at scale with appropriate backend strategies, state locking, workspace organization, and disaster recovery patterns.
  • Drive multi-account, multi-region, and multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning strategies with clear isolation, naming, and tagging standards.
  • Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, and platform teams to embed guardrails directly into reusable modules and pipelines.
  • Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.
  • Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.
  • Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.
  • Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.
  • Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Strong Git-based workflows including code review, branching, and release management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cloud Terraform (AWS + Azure or AWS + GCP).
  • Familiarity with Terragrunt, Atlantis, Spacelift, or env0.
  • Experience with policy-as-code engines (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov).
  • Contributions to public Terraform modules or providers.
