jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Reporting directly to the Division Director, the Coordinator serves as the primary operational support resource responsible for maintaining organized project records, tracking deadlines, facilitating communications, coordinating deliverables, supporting financial administration, and ensuring the efficient movement of projects from initiation through completion.

The position plays an important role in supporting municipal contracts and private development projects while facilitating coordination with Bureau Veritas's Commercial and Residential Building teams for plan review, permitting, and inspection services.

The Coordinator works closely with division leadership, branch managers, technical personnel, business development representatives, and corporate support departments to maintain consistent procedures, improve operational efficiency, and ensure a responsive client experience.

Drive user growth by turning analytics into business impact

At Resmed, you’ll transform how we understand and grow our connected-device user base. As the User Data Growth Analytics Lead, you’ll lead the measurement framework that explains what drives user engagement, retention, and expansion—and how those dynamics connect directly to demand and revenue. In this role, you’ll help Resmed make smarter, faster decisions about how to grow value across millions of active users.

You’ll collaborate across Finance, Product, and Commercial teams to connect insights from our digital ecosystem, including myAir and AirView, with the financial performance that drives our continued growth. Your analysis will shape trusted metrics, forecasting models, and next-generation analytics products that help connect patient engagement to commercial outcomes.

You’ll bring a consumer-first lens to healthcare, building experimental approaches that move quickly from analysis to action. This is your chance to help Resmed evolve the way we measure and grow user outcomes—by teaching us new ways to think about engagement and retention.

What you’ll do

  • Define the analytics foundation - Own and evolve the measurement framework for our user base, shaping clear KPIs for engagement, retention, and experience enhancement across connected platforms.
  • Tell the story behind the data - Build cohort and lifecycle analyses to explain user behaviors, identify growth opportunities, and clarify what drives retention or churn.

  • Drive cross-functional visibility, insights, and accountability – Partner across Product, Marketing, Finance and Commercial teams to analyze business performance, identify drivers of growth and retention, and align actions to improve outcomes. Elevate actionable insights to leadership to inform strategic decisions, drive cross-functional accountability, and strengthen business performance.

  • Move fast, measure impact, and evolve - Discover opportunities in the data, test hypotheses, measure results, and quickly refine strategies based on what the insights reveal.

What you bring

jobs.title: Director, Clinical Operations
jobs.excerpt: About LifeforceWe are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health.
jobs.description:
About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

    Lifeforce is hiring a Director, Clinical Operations to run the operating engine behind our national proactive care delivery model. You'll own how clinicians get licensed, credentialed, onboarded, scheduled, supported, and reviewed for quality, and you'll make sure all of it holds up as we grow.

    And we're growing fast. Our network of 50+ physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants is expected to more than triple over the next 15 months, across a growing number of states. At the same time, we're opening physical longevity centers and the clinicians supporting those centers run through this role too. The systems that work for a network of 50 won't work at 200, and this role is the one that gets us there ahead of demand rather than behind it.

    This is primarily an operations leadership role, not a clinical one. Clinical standards and clinical judgment stay with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. You'll own the people, processes, systems, and data that let clinicians do their best work at scale. You'll report to the COO and lead four teams: Clinical Operations, Clinical Onboarding & Enablement, Credentialing & Licensing, and Clinical Quality Assurance. You'll start with a small team and build it out to about 15 people by the end of 2027.

Key Responsibilities

    Capacity & Scheduling

  • Own clinician capacity planning against member demand, state by state. Know where we'll be short a quarter before it happens.

  • Own clinician scheduling, including how appointments are assigned across telehealth, nurse services, and our centers, and how continuity of care is protected as the network grows. Work with Product and Engineering to build the tools for scheduling that the teams need.

  • Track utilization, panel concentration, and access (time to next appointment), and act when they drift.

    • Hire to Productive

  • Own the full clinician pipeline after the offer: licensure, credentialing, onboarding, training, and ramp to full schedule.

  • Set and hit targets for time to credentialed and time- to-productive, and fix the bottlenecks in between.

  • Build a licensure and DEA strategy that ensures compliance and keeps pace with growth.

    • Quality & Clinician Performance

  • Own the operations of the clinical QA program, so every clinician is reviewed on schedule and the results reach the people who need them. The Clinical QA Lead reports to you, with a dotted line to the Medical Director on clinical standards.

  • Build the operating process for clinician performance management with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. They own the clinical judgment; you own the cadence, data, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Make sure the review approach and the follow-up fit our independent contractor model.

    • SOPs, Systems & Change Management

  • Own the clinical SOP lifecycle: intake, drafting with clinical owners, approval, rollout, and retirement, with Guru as the system of record.

  • Run changes so clinicians hear about them once, clearly, and know what they need to do differently.

  • Own the clinical operations tool stack (Healthie, Rippit, Guru, and our scheduling and credentialing tools) and the vendors behind it.

    • Metrics & Reporting

  • Build and optimize the clinician and clinical operations scorecards: capacity, utilization, time-to-productive, credentialing status, quality, satisfaction, adherence, and clinician and member retention.

  • Partner with Data & Analytics to automate it, and use it to run the business and report up to the COO and executive team as well as across the clinical and clin ops orgs.

    • Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Hire, develop, and lead the managers and leads across your four teams, and set structure and spans as the teams grow.

  • Support the clinicians serving our franchise centers, and partner with the Director, Clinical Franchise Operations so telehealth and center operations share standards and systems.

  • Work closely with the Medical Director and Deputy Medical Directors, Recruiting, CX, Pharmacy Operations, and Product.

  • Own the clinical operations budget and headcount plan.

What Success Looks Like

    In your first 90 days: map how clinician ops actually runs today and set a baseline on the core metrics. Get the new Onboarding & Enablement Manager and Clinical QA Lead fully ramped. Publish a capacity plan by state through the end of 2027, and get clear visibility into where every clinician in the pipeline stands.

    In your first year: clinician capacity stays ahead of member demand in every state we serve. New clinicians move from offer to full schedule on a predictable, measured timeline. Every clinician is reviewed on schedule, SOPs are current and in one place, and the scorecard runs without manual pulls. Your four teams are built out with strong leaders, and the operation is ready for the next stage of growth.

Qualifications

    Required

  • 8+ years in healthcare operations, including 3+ years leading managers.

  • Experience in direct-to-consumer telehealth, or in longevity, concierge, or preventive medicine.

  • Has scaled a clinician network through fast growth at a telehealth company, a multi-site provider group, or a similar organization.

  • Hands-on experience with clinician capacity planning, scheduling, or workforce management.

  • Working knowledge of multi-state licensure and credentialing, and how they gate clinician supply.

  • Has built and run onboarding, QA, or SOP programs that held up as volume grew.

  • Comfortable with data: defines metrics, builds reporting with analytics partners, and uses it to make decisions.

  • Has earned credibility with physicians and advanced practice clinicians as a non-clinical leader, and knows where operations ends and clinical judgment begins.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

    • Preferred

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience

  • Experience in both strategy or consulting and hands-on operational roles

  • Experience with multi-site or franchise healthcare operations.

  • Experience running an independent contractor (1099) clinician model.

  • Experience with Healthie, Rippit (formerly MaestroQA), Guru, or similar tools.

  • Has introduced automation or AI tools into clinical operations workflows.

Traits for Success

  • Builds the system before it breaks, not after.

  • Comfortable holding clinicians and clinical leaders to operating standards without being a clinician.

  • Moves between strategy and the details of a broken workflow in the same day.

  • Pairs every problem with a recommendation.

  • Keeps the member and the clinician experience in view when making operating decisions.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment

  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment

  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager to produce the real-world experiences where traders, creators, partners, and builders meet MetaMask. You’ll lead production, help shape event strategy, and sharpen the creative execution.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the Experiential & Global Events team within MetaMask’s Creative Studio and report to the Director of Experiential Marketing. We concept, design, and produce the ways people meet MetaMask in real life across global conferences, community events, VIP experiences, co-branded activations, and more. Our calendar runs across the world with priorities across APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.

You’ll lead production, taking each event from brief to on-site to recap. You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. Your focus will be experiences for our most active users and co-branded work with brands and creators, alongside community events for the builders who create on MetaMask.

Our formats are expanding to include live trading competitions, viewing events, product launches, and private experiences for VIP traders and creator partners.

How You’ll Do It

  • Produce events and experiences end to end: venues, run of show, fabrication, AV, F&B, and staffing, working alongside our production agency partners.
  • Own timelines, workback plans, and budgets for multiple events running in parallel across regions.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage agencies, venues, and vendors in APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.
  • Run registration and guest management, from guest lists and approvals to VIP access and arrival.
  • Build programming for events and panels, including formats, session flow, and speaker coordination.
  • Keep the operational side tight: source-of-truth docs, trackers, internal team staffing, and on-the-ground comms during conference weeks. Build playbooks that make each event easier to run than the last, using AI tools to move faster.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across product, marketing, business development and more to turn briefs into event plans with clear audiences, objectives, and success metrics tied to product and business goals.
  • Help develop and refine concepts with the creative team. Bring a point of view on formats, venues, and cultural trends, and work with designers and copywriters on decks and creative deliverables.
  • Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.
  • Track post-event results, including attendance, registration data, and social reach and sentiment, and write recaps that show what worked and what to change.
  • Over time, help source and manage co-hosts and sponsors for our owned franchises.

We’re looking for someone with

  • 5+ years in event production, experiential marketing, or brand activations, ideally in fintech, crypto, consumer tech, esports, or entertainment.
  • Experience producing large-format or competitive live events, such as tournaments, launches, or live viewing events.
  • A track record of delivering multi-city or international events on time and on budget.
  • Experience managing agencies and vendors and negotiating contracts under tight deadlines.
  • Experience producing premium or invite-only experiences for high-value guests.
  • Strong initiative. You spot what needs to happen and do it before anyone asks, and you stay steady when the plan changes.
  • Strategic and creative judgment. You connect an event to a product or business goal, and you bring ideas that sharpen a concept.
  • A systems mindset. You turn one-off events into repeatable processes.
  • Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership. Partners, vendors, and colleagues want to work with you again.
  • Based in the US or EU, and willing to travel internationally up to 20% of the year, typically 1 to 2 weeks per quarter across several markets.
  • Curiosity about money, markets, and how people trade, save, and spend. Finance experience isn’t required, but interest is.

It’s a bonus to have

  • Experience in crypto, whether producing events for digital asset audiences or at global conferences such as Token2049, Korea Blockchain Week, EthCC, or Devcon.
  • Experience sourcing or managing event co-hosts and sponsors.
  • Relationships with brands, creators, or communities that could become MetaMask partners.
  • An existing network of production vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, and Luma.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$101,000—$141,000 USD

At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

Salesforce and GTM stack

Job Description:

Are you looking to join an entrepreneurial firm which is one of the fastest growing in the US - one where you will be the "go to" high net worth tax expert?


Are you inspired to lead a practice, lead people and make a difference for your clients?


If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a High Net Worth Tax Managing Director! Our private wealth practice recognizes the unique challenges of wealthy individuals and privately held business owners. We help company executives, business owners, affluent families and family offices, estates and trusts in managing, preserving and transitioning wealth. Our consulting professionals provide comprehensive strategic income, trust, estate and gift tax, succession planning, valuation and international tax services.


You will work side-by-side with firm leadership and will be a valued mentor and coach to a group of talented staff. BT has the ability to provide you with an amazing ownership experience working with some of the most entrepreneurial partners in our field.


What you will do:

  • Lead compliance and consulting services to high-net-worth individuals, multi-generational affluent families, family offices and their private businesses and/or investment entities:
    • Perform technical review of complex individual, partnership, S-corp, trust, estate, gift and state tax returns
    • Lead multiple engagements that deliver proactive tax planning and strategic consulting including federal, estate, gift, charitable planning and generation skipping tax
    • Advise and make recommendations to clients on business succession planning
    • Build on technical competence by keeping up-to-date on trends, developments and technical authorities - applying them to complex situations
  • Manage client engagement staffing, billings/collections, and ensure client profitability targets are met
  • Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with the goal of acquiring new clients, projects, and revenue
  • Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
  • Support the growth and development of team members through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals
  • Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance

Successful candidates will have:

  • An undergraduate degree in accounting or law required
  • CPA or JD required
  • Experience as a leader in a public accounting firm in the Tax space
  • Eight (8)+ years’ experience in tax planning and consulting for wealthy individuals, family members and their trusts, investment entities, and private businesses. This includes strong experience in personal taxation, trust taxation, estate & gift taxation, charitable taxation, with exposure to flow through entities, partnership taxation and corporate taxation
  • Four (4)+ years supervisory experience, mentoring and counseling associates
  • Ability to lead and supervise others, provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning in order to stay current regarding applicable strategies, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of projects.
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S., without sponsorship, highly preferred.
  • Ability to travel as needed for client engagements.

    The California pay rate range is $201,810 to $382,600.
    The National pay rate range is $182,000 to $382,600

jobs.excerpt: About Five JarsFive Jars is a US-based digital product and engineering company with a distributed team across the United States and Europe.
jobs.description:
About Five Jars

Five Jars is a US-based digital product and engineering company with a distributed team across the United States and Europe.

For nearly ten years, we have designed, built, integrated, and supported complex digital platforms for nonprofit organizations, membership-based organizations, cultural institutions, healthcare organizations, and other mid-market clients.

Our experience includes:

  • digital platforms and customer-facing products;
  • CMS-based ecosystems;
  • custom integrations;
  • portals and self-service experiences;
  • web and mobile applications;
  • managed support and platform development;
  • our own SaaS products, Screen Pulse and Deyra.

We are now evolving our commercial direction. While web development remains part of our business, we intend to place greater emphasis on digital products, integrations, platforms, automation, managed services, and recurring product revenue.

We are looking for a hands-on commercial leader who can own this transition from the business development and sales side.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build and Own Lead Generation

Develop and execute a practical lead-generation strategy across Five Jars’ service and product directions.

Responsibilities include:

  • defining and refining ideal customer profiles, buyer roles, target-account criteria, and priority markets;
  • researching new industries, market segments, accounts, partners, and commercial opportunities;
  • building targeted account lists and identifying relevant decision-makers;
  • personally executing targeted outbound activities during the initial stage of the role;
  • developing personalized outreach through email, LinkedIn, referrals, industry communities, events, and other appropriate channels;
  • responding to and qualifying inbound leads;
  • reactivating previous leads, stalled opportunities, former clients, and existing relationships;
  • identifying expansion opportunities within the existing client base;
  • developing referral, technology, agency, and industry partnerships;
  • working with the company’s marketing resource to improve landing pages, case studies, campaigns, sales materials, and inbound conversion;
  • testing different messages, offers, industries, buyer segments, and acquisition channels;
  • tracking channel performance from initial contact through qualified opportunity and revenue;
  • identifying why previous lead-generation activities did or did not work;
  • discontinuing low-performing activities rather than optimizing for outreach volume;
  • establishing a repeatable lead-generation process that can later be delegated or scaled through additional hires or external resources.

The objective is to create a consistent flow of qualified opportunities – not simply contact lists, email volume, booked meetings, or other activity metrics.

2. Own the Full Sales Cycle

Take responsibility for opportunities from initial contact through contract signature.

This includes:

  • responding to inbound leads;
  • generating and researching targeted outbound opportunities;
  • qualifying leads against agreed ICP and commercial criteria;
  • running discovery calls;
  • identifying business goals, problems, stakeholders, budget, timeline, and decision process;
  • shaping the commercial solution;
  • preparing proposals, estimates, presentations, and follow-up materials;
  • handling objections and negotiations;
  • maintaining momentum and clear next steps;
  • progressing opportunities through to close.

You will be expected to independently close standardized and lower-complexity opportunities without requiring a founder to participate in every call.

3. Rebuild the Business Development and Sales Process

Review the existing commercial process and identify where opportunities are being lost.

Responsibilities include:

  • auditing recent leads, proposals, and lost opportunities;
  • conducting win/loss analysis;
  • identifying weaknesses in qualification, discovery, positioning, pricing, proposals, follow-up, or trust-building;
  • defining clear sales stages and exit criteria;
  • establishing practical lead qualification rules;
  • improving CRM data quality and forecasting;
  • creating reusable discovery, proposal, follow-up, and presentation templates;
  • defining appropriate sales KPIs;
  • ensuring that qualified opportunities are consistently progressed.

The objective is not to introduce unnecessary sales bureaucracy. The objective is to create a process that is visible, manageable, and repeatable.

4. Help Transform Five Jars’ Go-to-Market Direction

Work with company leadership to refine what Five Jars sells and how those services are presented to the market.

This includes:

  • analyzing demand across existing and adjacent markets;
  • identifying commercially attractive project types;
  • helping shift positioning away from technology-specific messaging such as Drupal or WordPress;
  • developing offers around products, integrations, digital platforms, automation, and managed services;
  • helping package services into clearer and easier-to-buy engagements;
  • evaluating pricing, scope, commercial structure, and differentiation;
  • testing new service propositions with real prospects;
  • recommending which verticals and opportunities Five Jars should prioritize or avoid.

5. Develop Revenue Channels

Build a balanced commercial pipeline using channels appropriate for a specialized software and digital product company.

Potential channels include:

  • inbound lead conversion;
  • expansion of existing accounts;
  • reactivation of previous leads and opportunities;
  • targeted account-based outreach;
  • strategic partnerships;
  • referrals;
  • technology ecosystems;
  • industry events and conferences;
  • selective outbound campaigns;
  • product-led entry opportunities.

The goal is not simply to maximize outreach volume. The goal is to identify channels that generate qualified opportunities and can become repeatable.

6. Develop Existing Accounts

Work with current Five Jars clients to identify additional opportunities, including:

  • integrations;
  • platform modernization;
  • new digital products;
  • automation;
  • AI-enabled functionality;
  • mobile or self-service experiences;
  • accessibility and performance improvements;
  • ongoing managed services;
  • Screen Pulse or Deyra adoption.

This should be done as consultative account development, not aggressive upselling.

7. Sell Five Jars Products

Own or support the commercial development of Screen Pulse and Deyra.

Responsibilities include:

  • understanding the products and target customers;
  • running product discovery and demonstrations;
  • qualifying product opportunities;
  • preparing commercial proposals;
  • independently closing straightforward product deals;
  • identifying opportunities to bundle products with Five Jars services;
  • collecting market feedback;
  • helping refine pricing, packaging, positioning, and target segments;
  • distinguishing real customer demand from speculative product ideas.

Product sales are part of the role, but not expected to operate as a completely separate sales organization from day one.

8. Build the Future Commercial Team

Initially, this is a hands-on individual contributor position.

As the commercial process becomes repeatable, you will be expected to:

  • identify which additional sales or marketing capabilities are genuinely needed;
  • define future roles and responsibilities;
  • participate in hiring;
  • onboard and manage commercial team members;
  • establish performance expectations;
  • create a structure that does not depend indefinitely on the founders.

Hiring a team is not the first objective. The first objective is proving a working commercial model.

Required Experience

Must Have

  • Proven experience owning the complete B2B sales cycle for custom software development, digital products, systems integration, digital agencies, or related professional services.
  • Experience personally generating, qualifying, progressing, and closing opportunities.
  • Experience selling services to clients in the United States.
  • Demonstrable history of closing mid-market service or technology deals, not only low-cost SaaS subscriptions.
  • Strong experience running business-focused discovery calls.
  • Ability to translate client problems into a clear commercial solution.
  • Experience preparing proposals, statements of work, estimates, presentations, and follow-up materials.
  • Experience responding to RFPs.
  • Experience handling objections, negotiations, and complex decision processes.
  • Ability to work with technical teams and understand software delivery sufficiently to sell it credibly.
  • Experience improving or building sales processes in an environment where they were incomplete or ineffective.
  • Ability to work independently without requiring daily management from founders.
  • (If candidate is not English-native speaker) Strong written and spoken English, C1–C2.
  • Strong organizational discipline and CRM usage.
  • Ability to work hands-on before building or managing a team.
  • Comfortable working in an organization with limited marketing and sales resources.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling both professional services and software products.

Background: Center for Civilians in Conflict (CIVIC) is an international nonprofit with offices around the world working to improve protection for civilians caught in conflict zones. Our mission is to work with armed actors and civilians in conflict to develop and implement solutions to prevent, mitigate, and respond to civilian harm. We are advocates who believe that no civilian caught in conflict should be ignored, and advisors who provide practical solutions to prevent and respond to civilian harm. Learn more at civiliansinconflict.org.

CIVIC and Human Rights Activists in Iran (HRA) are undertaking communications and advocacy campaign to amplify awareness of the human costs of the US war in Iran by telling compelling, human-centered stories about civilian harm.

Project Description & Scope of Work: To support the development of content amplifying these stories, CIVIC is seeking to recruit a Multimedia Production and Content Creation Consultant. The consultant will work closely with CIVIC and HRA to design documented testimonies, evidence, and advocacy messages into engaging visual and multimedia content for public dissemination. This will include the production of professional, high-resolution videos suitable for social media platforms, as well as graphics, carousel, and animated videos as required.

Based on documentation collected and curated by HRA, the consultant will collaborate with CIVIC to develop a creative storytelling approach, including visual style, format selection, and audience engagement strategies. The consultant will spearhead the production process, including visual design, video editing, motion graphics, subtitling, sound design, integration of photographs, video footage, interviews, and other source materials as relevant. The consultant will also consult on storyboarding and script development.

All products must adhere to conflict-sensitive and trauma-informed communications principles, ensuring that storytelling approaches do not expose contributors, affected communities, or partners to undue risk. The consultant will work iteratively with CIVIC and HRA throughout the process, incorporating feedback and revisions to ensure that final products align with project objectives, advocacy priorities, and ethical storytelling standards.

The consultant must preserve the factual and contextual integrity of testimonies and source materials. Any substantive editing, reconstruction, use of generative AI, synthetic imagery or audio, or alteration of documentary materials must receive prior written approval from CIVIC and must not misrepresent the experiences or statements of contributors.

Where publication may create protection, privacy, or security risks, the consultant should work with CIVIC and HRA to apply appropriate mitigation measures, including anonymization, blurring, voice alteration, removal of identifying information or metadata, and secure handling and transfer of source files.

Under the supervision of the US Director, the consultant will undertake the following activities:

  • Develop compelling multimedia content (including graphics and videos) amplifying the experiences of Iranian civilians during the US-Israel-Iran war;
  • Consult with the CIVIC and HRA teams on storyboarding and script development;
  • Brainstorm innovative concepts to shape raw materials from the ground into engaging, high-impact content.
  • Produce and deliver edited videos (approximately 1-3 minutes in length) adapted to the formats agreed upon by the CIVIC and HRA teams and the consultant;
  • Edit photos (selection and color correction) and videos (editing, color correction, color integration and subtitles);
  • Propose creative formats tailored for various platforms, ensuring all outputs strictly align with CIVIC’s tone of voice and branding.
  • Ensure that the free and informed consent of the persons filmed or photographed is obtained and properly archived internally, and that CIVIC's principles of confidentiality, data protection and ethics are strictly adhered to;
  • Ensure compliance with the visibility and visual identity requirements of CIVIC; and
  • Consult with CIVIC and HRA teams in the design and implementation of a tailored dissemination strategy.

Deliverables

  • Complete captions and corresponding contextual notes; and

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

At Chainguard, we are on a mission to secure the software supply chain by default. We are choosing to do this the right way, which is the hard way. Some have even called us “the Justice League of security.” Our team is founded by the industry's leading experts on open source software, security and cloud native development and is backed by Spark Capital, Sequoia, Amplify Partners, the Chainsmokers and more. Chainguard’s product portfolio includes Chainguard Images and Professional Services. Customers range from Fortune 500 companies in banking, fintech, government and infrastructure to startups and SMBs. Join us as we help organizations secure their software supply chain from source to production.

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our Commercial customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.

What you’ll do:

  • Customer Onboarding: Lead the technical onboarding process for new customers. Partner with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to understand requirements, goals, and challenges to formulate an onboarding plan.
  • Account Management: Develop relationships with multiple levels of customer stakeholders from technicians to CISOs. Work closely with sales teams to identify the best path to renew and expand customers while minimizing churn risks.
  • Training & Education: Collaborate with customers and our Edu team to ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles.
  • Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams. This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influencing them to act toward customer needs.
  • Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years experience in customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.
  • Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.
  • This is a strategic and proactive role, our expectation is that this person will take full ownership of their customer portfolio and act with a high level of autonomy. This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or C-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be required to both deviate from established procedure and often build entirely new processes or practices to ensure we best serve customers.
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development, actively seeking opportunities to enhance skills, expand knowledge, and advance within their career and field.
  • Driven, high emotional intelligence, and strong priority management skills

Strongly Preferred:

  • Previous early-stage startup experience
  • Passion for technology & cybersecurity
  • Relevant hands-on technical experience, in one or more of the following domains: cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, Linux, Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security, security infrastructure, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle

Compensation: Up to $125,000 base salary + bonus

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: Research Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us:Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit. We conduct rigorous economics research to advance access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the Lab are Achyuta Adhvaryu - Professor of Economics and Director of 21st Century India Center at the School of Global Policy and Strategy, UC San Diego (), Anant Ahuja - Head of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd., and Anant Nyshadham - Assistant Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan ().

About the role

Research Managers (RMs) are integral to the success of our randomized evaluations. Working closely with the research team at GBL and collaborating economists and researchers across U.S. universities, the RM will support all key activities to grow our U.S. project portfolio. The RM will support all stages of the research process across two U.S.-based projects, along with other key activities to develop more projects in the U.S. Here is a quick description of the two active projects in the U.S.:

  • AI-assisted job search and matching: Research on using algorithmic matching to connect low-income jobseekers to local vacancies — widening the scope of job search across sectors and improving matching to jobs in which candidates may have no prior experience. This research builds on our prior work on AI-directed job search, which you can read about here.
  • Cash incentives and continuity of care: Research investigating the effects of small cash incentives on continuity of care among the unsheltered population in the Los Angeles region.

To acclimatize yourself with our work, you can explore our website and LinkedIn.

Compensation: $80,000–$100,000 annually, subject to the candidate’s experience, skills, and fit for the role.
Type of Employment: Fixed Term Employment

Duration: 1 year

Location: This is a remote position. Team members are based in Philadelphia, PA (with an office space) and Ann Arbor, MI, and relocation to either location is an option for candidates who are interested.
- Please note, the candidate must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead grant writing and prepare reports for funding agencies
  • Mentor Research Assistants and other research staff; assist with hiring and training Research Assistants and other research staff
  • Assist with Research Assistant responsibilities as needed (literature reviews, survey instrument design, data cleaning, survey planning, data quality monitoring, fieldwork supervision, etc.)
  • Ensure projects follow GBL standards and protocols, including IRB approval, coding standards, and analysis procedures
  • Anticipate and identify risks or threats to research design/projects, propose solutions, and escalate to researchers as needed
  • Maintain clear communication and alignment between researchers, GBL staff, and implementation partners; clarify expectations and troubleshoot challenges
  • Ensure the project has sufficient material and human resources
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation — codebooks, field protocols, and project logs — to academic standards of transparency and reproducibility
  • Coordinate with administrative and finance teams on participant payments and study-related costs
  • Prepare policy memos, research briefs, and communications content (blogs, articles) on ongoing and completed studies
  • Represent GBL at meetings with external stakeholders (e.g., delivering presentations)

Who are you?

  • Master's or doctoral degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field (or Bachelors degree with 4+ years of relevant work experience)
  • Ability to work in a team, manage multiple projects on the ground and be self-motivated
  • Experience managing Randomized Controlled Trials
  • Extensive experience conducting social science or economic field research (supervising data collection, survey design and implementation, data management, etc.)
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including proficiency in statistical software such as Stata or R, and experience with financial reporting and management
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel/spreadsheet applications
  • Strong familiarity with data science principles and AI coding platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex/GPT), among others.
  • Detail-oriented with strong written and oral communication skills
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites
  • Experience in grant writing for existing and new projects

Additional Requirements:

What should you be comfortable with?

  • A dynamic environment with competing priorities
  • Working in a team with shared responsibilities
  • Independently coordinating with coworkers to accomplish goals
  • Being resourceful in new environments and scenarios
  • Problem-solving in high-pressure environments
  • Adapting your approach, being focused on the problem and not being stuck to one idea or way of solving a problem

How to apply?

Share the following documents with your application form:

  • Curriculum vitae (CV)
  • A cover letter describing your background, interest in economics research, familiarity with relevant statistical software, and any experience as a research assistant and/or manager or on independent projects.
  • Please include the names and email addresses of two references in your cover letter.

Deadline to Apply:

On rolling basis

The process:

We are glad you’re interested in applying for this role!

After each step, we decide whether to invite you to the next one. The screening process takes approximately 4–6 weeks from the application deadline and includes the following stages:

  1. CV screening
  2. Data test
  3. First-round interview
  4. Second-round interview

Depending on the candidate pool, we may add any additional interviews to make a well thought through decision.

Our commitment to diversity:

GBL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a young and growing company making us the ideal ground for team members to experiment, take on dynamic roles, and grow with us. We focus on happiness, output, and quality of work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Salary: $80,000–$100,000 annually, subject to the candidate’s experience, skills, and fit for the role.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Examiner with deep expertise in Medi-Cal Managed Care claims adjudication. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of California Medi-Cal regulations, delegated risk arrangements, provider disputes, and complex facility claim processing. Experience with Medicare and Commercial claims is required, but this role is primarily focused on supporting and serving as a subject matter expert for Medi-Cal business.

About Us

All Care To You is a Management Service Organization providing our clients with healthcare administrative support. We provide services to Independent Physician Associations, TPAs, and Fiscal Intermediary clients. ACTY is a modern growing company which encourages diverse perspectives. We celebrate curiosity, initiative, drive and a passion for making a difference. We support a culture focused on teamwork, support, and inclusion. Our company is fully remote and offers a flexible work environment as well as schedules. ACTY offers 100% employer paid medical, vision, dental, and life coverage for our employees. We also offer paid holiday, sick time, and vacation time as well as a 401k plan. Additional employee paid coverage options available.

Job Purpose

The Claims Examiner III (Medi-Cal Managed Care) is responsible for the accurate processing, adjustment, adjudication, and release of complex hospital, ancillary, and professional claims with a primary focus on Medi-Cal managed care claims. This role requires extensive knowledge of California Medi-Cal regulations, delegated IPA and capitated hospital arrangements, provider disputes, and claims payment requirements.

The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert in Medi-Cal claims processing and is also experienced in Medicare and Commercial lines of business. This individual will identify claim processing issues, perform root cause analysis, recommend operational improvements, support compliance initiatives, and ensure adherence to CMS, DHCS, DMHC, and applicable state regulations. The Claims Examiner III must consistently meet production and quality standards while serving as a resource to other team members.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Process, adjust, and adjudicate professional, institutional, and complex claims with a primary focus on Medi-Cal Managed Care, while supporting Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Medi-Cal claims processing, reimbursement methodologies, delegated risk arrangements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Review and apply provider contracts, benefit plans, divisions of financial responsibility, authorizations, and reimbursement methodologies to ensure accurate claim adjudication.
  • Validate diagnosis and procedure codes and ensure claims are processed in accordance with DHCS, DMHC, CMS, AB 1455, AB 1324, and other applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve complex claims issues, payment discrepancies, provider disputes, grievances, escalations, and claims processing errors.
  • Process claim adjustments, voids, reopenings, reconsiderations, overpayment recoveries, and underpayment corrections in accordance with departmental guidelines.
  • Generate and document provider communications, including acknowledgement, development, denial, resolution, and notification letters as required.
  • Collaborate with Customer Service, Provider Relations, Configuration, Compliance, and other departments to resolve claims and payment issues.
  • Create and utilize Crystal and SQL reports to support inventory management, operational efficiency, and regulatory turnaround time compliance.
  • Identify claims payment errors, system configuration issues, and process improvement opportunities; provide recommendations for corrective action.
  • Participate in internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, workflow improvement initiatives, and special projects.
  • Meet established productivity and quality standards while maintaining accurate documentation within EZ-Cap and related systems.
  • May assist with training, mentoring, check run preparation, and other departmental needs as assigned.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, and confidentiality requirements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of claims adjudication experience with significant experience processing Medi-Cal managed care claims.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience processing Medicare and Commercial claims.
  • Experience using EZ-Cap required.
  • Extensive knowledge of California Medi-Cal, Medicare, and Commercial reimbursement methodologies.
  • Thorough understanding of DHCS, DMHC, CMS, and applicable state and federal claims regulations.
  • Experience with delegated IPA, Medical Group, and capitated provider arrangements.
  • Demonstrated experience resolving Provider Disputes (PDRs), claims appeals, grievances, and escalated claims issues.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • AB 1455 Claims Settlement Practices
  • AB 1324 Requirements
  • Knox-Keene regulations
  • Timely filing requirements
  • Coordination of Benefits (COB)
  • Claims payment and regulatory turnaround requirements
  • Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, DRG, APC, ASC, and other reimbursement methodologies.
  • Proficient in outpatient PPS, inpatient DRG, interim rate payment methodologies, and other reimbursement structures applicable to Medi-Cal, Medicare, and Commercial products.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and claims research skills

Working conditions

  • This job may require flexible work hours due to the nature of the responsibilities.

Physical requirements

  • This job is not considered physically demanding, therefore there are no physical requirements.
Salary: $28.00 - $35.00 hourly ($75,000 Annually)

jobs.excerpt: Summary:For more than 150 years, the ASPCA has been on the frontlines to save, transform and protect the lives of millions of animals.
jobs.description:
Summary:

For more than 150 years, the ASPCA has been on the frontlines to save, transform and protect the lives of millions of animals. The Behavioral Sciences Team (BST) team plays an integral role in the ASPCA's commitment to champion good animal welfare and protect animals from cruelty. We are looking for a Director, Applied Animal Research to work on innovative internal companion animal applied behavior and welfare research projects.


The application for this position will be open until 5pm EST on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.


Who We Are

This role is part of the ASPCA’s Animal Behavior vertical, which includes the Behavioral Sciences Team (BST), the Learning Lab (LL), and the behavior teams at all Shelter and Rehabilitation Operations (SRO) facilities. Working within and across teams, behavior professionals in the vertical share expertise, implement aligned behavior program standards and practices, and help advance the ASPCA’s strategic priorities. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative internal projects and capacity-build external research efforts that inform best practices for companion animals in shelters across the nation.


What You’ll Do

Working under the supervision of the Senior Director of Applied Behavior Research, the Director of Applied Behavior Research leads the design and development of internal applied behavior and welfare research projects focused on both the ASPCA’s unique cruelty case populations and generalizable behavior interventions and welfare assessments for shelter-housed dogs and cats. In addition to strong research and analytical skills, this position requires an individual with a collaborative work style, project management experience, and the ability to lead committees and project teams in a matrix structure.


Passion for translating research findings into practical applications is essential, requiring strong data visualization and science communication skills. The Director of Applied Behavior Research supports behavior colleagues across multiple teams as a subject matter expert in applied behavior science and its methodology. The Director oversees the creation and delivery of new learning opportunities to elevate subject matter literacy across behavior teams and broader audiences within the ASPCA.


The ideal candidate will be an experienced research professional with high standards for project quality and critical thinking skills balanced by a collaborative approach, a respect for diverse perspectives and areas of expertise, and an appetite for working in cross-functional project teams. Collaborative committee work to support internal initiatives will be required, as will travel for conferences, research studies, and to support forensic behavior and field operations.


The Director, Applied Behavior Research reports to the Senior Director, Applied Behavior Research and has no direct reports.


When and Where You’ll Work

  • This remote-based position (which requires travel, as described below) is open to all candidates based within the United States.
  • The regular schedule for this position is Monday through Friday. Ability to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, evenings and holidays based on program needs is required. Schedules are subject to change as needed by the ASPCA.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 15% of the time, sometimes with short notice, required

What You’ll Get

Compensation

The target hiring range is based on where the employee works, which for remote roles is the employee’s primary location of residence, and its respective cost of labor. You can view which zone applies to you based on your location (aspca.app.box.com/v/aspcazonetable). For questions regarding locations not on the list, please send an email to for more information.

Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to education, training, experience, location, business needs, internal equity, market demands or budgeted amount for the role. The target hiring range is for new hire offers only, and compensation may increase beyond the maximum hiring range based on performance over time. The maximum of the hiring range is reserved for candidates with the highest qualifications and relevant experience. The expected hiring salary ranges for this role are set forth below and may be modified in the future.

  • Zone 1: $ 105,000 - $ 112,000 annually
  • Zone 2: $ 116,000 - $ 123,000 annually
  • Zone 3: $ 128,000 - $ 136,000 annually

Benefits

At the ASPCA, you don’t have to choose between your passion and making a living. Our comprehensive benefits package helps ensure you can live a rewarding life at work and at home. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Affordable health coverage, including medical, employer-paid dental and optional vision coverage.
  • Flexible time off that includes vacation time, paid personal time, sick time, bereavement time, paid parental leave, and 10 company paid holidays that allows you even more flexibility to observe the days that mean the most to you.
  • Competitive financial incentives and retirement savings, including a 401(k) plan with generous employer contributions — we match dollar-for-dollar up to 4% and provide an additional 4% contribution toward your future each year.
  • Robust professional development opportunities, including classes, on-the-job training, coaching and mentorship with industry-leading peers, internal mobility, opportunities to support in the field and so much more.

Check our website for more information on our benefits offerings.

Responsibilities:

Responsibility buckets are listed in general order of importance. They include, but are not limited to:


Design and Conduct Collaborative Research

  • Creatively use data sources and interdisciplinary approaches
  • Strategically identify and prioritize research questions with the greatest potential impact on organizational priorities and the animal welfare field
  • Effectively lead research projects with minimal supervision to answer priority research questions that drive the ASPCA’s and animal welfare field’s work forward
  • Scope projects appropriately, help define roles and responsibilities, and outline timelines, communicating effectively across multiple stakeholder groups
  • Complete specific components of individual research projects by applying individual expertise
  • Recognize when the work needs to change in scope or if the overarching goal of the work needs to be revisited, and generate appropriate solutions
  • Identify key audiences for uptake of the research
  • Support the development of an internal and external communication plan for the completed work
  • Lead or participate in efforts to advance internal and external research: e.g., ASPCA-sponsored research grant programs, annual ASPCA Research Forum
  • Manage consultants and temporary employees as needed
  • Mentor interns and junior colleagues in research
  • Communicate research to diverse audiences through journal articles, reports and presentations

Provide Expertise and Share Knowledge

  • Maintain and develop subject matter expertise relevant to the work of the ASPCA to provide input on area of expertise across the organization
  • Translate subject matter expertise into meaningful insights to help inform the ASPCA’s strategic and programmatic work
  • Stay abreast of the animal welfare field in programmatic focus areas to share new research and drive change
  • Build and maintain partnerships with organizations, universities, and other institutions working at the nexus of animal welfare and behavioral biology

Strategic Thought Partnership

  • Quickly and creatively develop effective relationships with colleagues across the organization
  • Assist with identifying and prioritizing the most impactful work using subject matter expertise
  • Help teams across the ASPCA identify research that would drive programmatic focus areas’ goals
  • Collaborate across the organization by elevating data-driven insights that support the creation and successful execution of the ASPCA’s strategy

Education and Work Experience

  • PhD in animal behavior field (such as applied ethology, behavioral ecology, animal welfare science) required
  • Minimum of 6 years of professional research experience (post-PhD) required
  • Experience writing peer-reviewed scientific publications required
  • Leadership experience required, such as managing, mentoring, coaching and/or training others
  • Applied companion animal behavior experience preferred
  • Certified Applied Animal Behaviorist (CAAB) or ability to become certified within one year of hire
  • Dr. Sophia Yin’s Low Stress Handling ™ certification required or obtained within 6 months of hire

Qualifications:

  • Ability to apply discipline-specific tools and knowledge to novel questions in animal welfare required
  • Ability to translate research to applied audiences, e.g. shelter staff, executive leadership, required, formal experience with science communication strongly preferred.
  • Ability to guide teams, without direct reporting authority, to drive outcomes and achieve shared objectives.
  • Knowledge of various forms of research required
  • Knowledge of various experimental designs and threats to validity (internal and external) addressed by each required
  • Demonstrated ability to identify data sources for research and to assess the quality of these data sources required
  • Strong statistical analysis skills, including generalized linear mixed models, required
  • Proficiency with statistical software (R, Python, SPSS, Stata, etc.) and Excel required; Data summary and visualization skills required
  • Strong project oversight and management abilities required, including excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication (verbal, written, and typing) skills
  • Must be a self-guided, creative, highly organized, and motivated individual requiring minimal supervision
  • Must have strong ability to rapidly assimilate new information
  • Must be able to quickly, calmly, and efficiently adjust to changes in programmatic, strategic, and/or research direction
  • Must be nimble and able to rapidly re-prioritize own work
  • Must be able to work confidently and independently in a remote office
  • Ability to adhere strictly to protocols and maintain confidentiality of sensitive information is required
  • Capable of standing for 8 or more hours on concrete floors and bending, crouching, kneeling and moving freely to perform responsibilities that include handling animals, and/or carrying and lifting research equipment.
  • Ability to exemplify ASPCA’s core values and behavioral competencies.

Language:

English

Education and Work Experience:

Doctorate (Required)

jobs.description:
albo

albo is a leading fintech company offering financial products to individuals and SMBs with the mission to bring financial freedom to everyone, everywhere.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on Network Engineer with an automation mindset to join our Infrastructure team. You will own the network layer of our multi-cloud platform (GCP and AWS): VPCs, private connectivity, DNS, load balancers and edge protection. Rather than operating it by hand, you will turn it into code: every route, firewall rule, DNS record and edge policy should be versioned, reviewed through a pull request and applied by a pipeline. You will also bring network capabilities into our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), known internally as Keymaker, so engineering teams can request changes such as IP allowlists through self-service instead of tickets.

What you’ll be doing at albo:

  • Cloud Networking: Design, operate, and evolve our network across GCP and AWS (Shared VPC, VPC peering, Private Service Connect, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN/Interconnect, and private DNS), moving towards a central ingress/egress hub architecture.
  • Network as Code: Codify network infrastructure with Terraform and automate repetitive operations (DNS records, firewall rules, IP allowlists) with Python or Go, delivered through GitOps workflows (e.g., via Bitbucket PRs and CI/CD pipelines).
  • Load Balancing & Edge: Operate Google Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Armor (WAF and rate limiting), IAP, and our NGINX-based private proxies on GKE, implementing the policies defined together with the Information Security team.
  • Observability & Troubleshooting: Use VPC Flow Logs, Cloud Logging, and Datadog to diagnose connectivity, latency, and DNS issues, build network alerts and dashboards, and lead the network side of incident response.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Platform, DevOps, and Information Security teams, documenting the network in runbooks and diagrams so that network operations never depend on a single person.

About you and what type of skills you'll need:

  • 2+ years of experience in a Network Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps/SRE role with a strong networking focus.
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting/CIDR, routing (BGP basics), NAT, DNS, TLS, and HTTP.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and scripting in Python, Go, or Bash to automate network tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud networking on GCP and/or AWS (VPCs, firewall rules/security groups, load balancers, private connectivity, VPN).
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes networking (Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicies), reverse proxies such as NGINX, and edge controls such as Cloud Armor or AWS WAF.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to automate network operations and troubleshooting is a massive plus, as are certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer, AWS Certified Advanced Networking, or CCNA/CCNP.
  • Automation-first approach: if you do it twice, you script it. You measure success by fewer manual changes, fewer network incidents, and faster turnaround on network requests.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, eagerness to keep growing, and an extreme ownership mindset.
