jobs.excerpt: CARE Canada is looking for a Gender Equality and Inclusion Specialist (12-month parental leave cover) JOB SUMMARYThe Gender Equality and Inclusion Specialist is part of the Gender Equality and Inclusion (GEI) Team, within Gender Justice and Impact, which includes the GEI, Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning and Accountability (MEAL), and Environment and Climate Technical Teams of Global Programs.
jobs.description:
CARE Canada is looking for a Gender Equality and Inclusion Specialist (12-month parental leave cover)

JOB SUMMARY

The Gender Equality and Inclusion Specialist is part of the Gender Equality and Inclusion (GEI) Team, within Gender Justice and Impact, which includes the GEI, Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning and Accountability (MEAL), and Environment and Climate Technical Teams of Global Programs. The Global Programs Team is responsible for developing and managing the organization’s programs in both development and humanitarian assistance focusing on the injustice of poverty and gender inequality. Our ultimate impact goal is to support women’s leadership for a gender-just future grounded in strong programs supporting safety/protection, health and dignified livelihoods across both humanitarian and development settings. The Global Programs unit is responsible for the overall management of CARE Canada’s global programming circa $50m annual development and humanitarian programming portfolio. Global Programs also supports the Revenue & Marketing Unit that is responsible for building innovative partnerships and sustainable, balanced revenue sources, including private-sector and corporate partnerships, institutional funding (Global Affairs Canada) and co-investment, and philanthropic funding (foundations, etc).

The Specialist will be part of a team of Gender Equality and Inclusion (GEI) and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) experts to advance CARE Canada’s commitment to program quality, specifically by supporting gender equality and inclusion, as well as commitments to GBV across the organization and programs spanning Women Economic Justice, Sexual Reproductive Health and Rights, Climate Justice and Gender in Emergencies sectors, among others. They will seek to ensure strong alignment of new programs and existing programs with CARE Canada’s gender equality commitments, with a particular focus on ensuring gender transformative and innovative program design and implementation.

The role works in collaboration with CARE Canada’s Gender Justice & Impact team (Including technical advisors and specialists on GEI, GBV, MEAL, climate); Program Management team; and Resource Mobilization and Partnerships team. Externally, they regularly engage with Country office teams, Global technical teams, Project/program partners and Sector partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

Gender Equality and Inclusion Excellence in Programming

  • As part of project matrix teams, provide technical support and guidance to CARE Country Offices (COs) and partners remotely and in person on assigned projects to strengthen the integration and achievement of gender equality and inclusion (GEI) and gender-based violence risk mitigation (GBV RM) outcomes.
  • Support the development and implementation of key GEI and GBV RM deliverables, including gender and power analyses, GEI strategies and action plans, annual work plans, donor reports, training materials, technical guidance, and project tools.
  • Support COs and partners to identify, adapt and operationalize gender-responsive and gender-transformative approaches and interventions, drawing on relevant CARE approaches and tools, including Social Analysis and Action (SAA), Community Score Card (CSC) and other relevant methodologies; and CARE best practices related to gender transformative change, inclusion and women’s economic justice.
  • Support the integration of GEI, gender-transformative and feminist principles, GBV RM, do no harm, and safeguarding considerations into project activities, tools and implementation processes.
  • Contribute GEI and GBV RM technical inputs to project monitoring, evaluation, research and learning activities, as assigned, including baselines, midlines, evaluations, climate vulnerability assessments, research partnerships and other technical deliverables.

Business Development and Mobilization

  • Support CARE Country Offices and CARE Canada colleagues in responding to key GEI and GBV RM requirements for concept notes and proposals across development, resilience and humanitarian programming.
  • Contribute to the development of GEI and GBV RM components and deliverables for concept notes and proposals, including gender analyses, theories of change/results frameworks, approaches, activities, indicators and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute, as requested, to the development and improvement of GEI/GBV RM tools, templates and guidance for new business development.
  • Support other business development and resource mobilization work, including research, if assigned.

Thought leadership and Learning

  • Support the development and delivery of organizational learning opportunities related to GEI and GBV RM, including webinars, training sessions and other learning initiatives.
  • Support CARE Canada GEI Team and project teams in the development of organizational GEI and GBV RM tools, processes, templates and guidance.
  • Support GEI Team, project, and matrix teams in developing knowledge products for external dissemination, including abstracts, papers, case studies and other relevant publications.
  • Participate in relevant CARE International or external Communities of Practice, technical working groups and learning events, as requested or based on relevance to assigned areas of work, and contribute learning back to CARE Canada teams.
  • Support, as needed, networking, relationships and partnerships within the CARE Confederation as well as other NGOs, government, private sector and academics, with a view to position CARE Canada as a thought leader and partner of choice in terms of GEI and GBV.
  • Provide support for ad-hoc initiatives within the GEI team if assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Development, Gender Studies, or in a related field or equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • Three or more years of professional experience in role directly related to gender equality and inclusion, women’s rights, and/or gender-based violence.
  • Experience working within an international NGO context.
  • Demonstrated experience advancing gender equality and women’s voice and leadership within women’s economic justice, climate justice, health programming, emergency response or other relevant sectors.
  • Knowledge of programming designed to address social norms change, injustice and inequality with the goal of reaching gender transformative objectives.
  • Expertise in qualitative data research, analysis and interpretation.
  • Fluency in English, including written and spoken.
  • Excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU EXTRAORDINARY

  • Knowledge of results-based Gender Equality monitoring.
  • Knowledge of feminist theory and/or experience with feminist programming
  • Experience with the private sector or with Private-Public-Partnerships (PPPs) in areas related to gender equality and inclusion.
  • Experience with Market systems and value chain programming, Women's entrepreneurship and financial inclusion, climate justice, and other Gender transformative economic programming.
  • Experience with diverse donors, including the Mastercard Foundation and/or Global Affairs Canada.
  • Experience on projects/services to mitigate, prevent or respond to Gender Based Violence in Canada or abroad
  • Experience working on gender equality in emergency, development, or nexus contexts.
  • Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

REQUIREMENTS

Promote and maintain an organizational culture that advances gender equality, diversity and inclusion, reduces power abuse and inequalities, and fosters trust and safety.

Create an environment within CARE's workplaces, programming, and communities where CARE works that is free from sexual harassment, sexual abuse and sexual exploitation and child abuse (SHEA-CA).

Ensure high standards of prevention and response measures for SHEA-CA are in place consistent with the CARE International (CI) Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Starting annual salary between $75,005 - $80,364
  • Comprehensive benefits package, providing family coverage for a wide range of services, including paramedical services, gender-affirming care, mental health support, and access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Paid annual and wellness leave benefits
  • Extended list of paid holidays, beyond provincial requirements
  • December Office Closure (between December 24-January 1)
  • Inclusive holiday policy
  • Parental leave top-up
  • Employer contributions to group pension plan beginning in 2nd Year; Optional participation in group RRSP
  • International and domestic travel opportunities
  • Annual all-staff retreat
  • Learning and development opportunities and specialized training
  • Flexible work hours to support employee wellbeing and productivity
  • A focus on wellness and work-life balance
  • Amazing colleagues who are very committed to CARE’s mission

HOW TO APPLY

If you are someone who thrives on challenge, loves to be part of a dynamic team and are passionate about making a difference, then this opportunity is for you! Don’t think you check all the boxes? Reach out anyway – we would love to hear how your experience translates to this role!

Please apply by October 25, 2026. Please note resumes will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and the advertisement will be removed once a candidate has been identified. We are only able to consider candidates who currently have the right to work in Canada.

CARE Canada is committed to employment equity, welcomes diversity in the workplace and encourages applications from all qualified applicants. Recruitment-related accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request.

CARE Canada does not use artificial intelligence tools to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All application reviews and hiring decisions are conducted by our amazing people. AI tools may be used in drafting communication, editing or interview question sourcing from time to time.

As part of CARE Canada's commitment to preventing sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, we conduct reference checks on all final stage candidates in line with the Interagency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. By applying to this role with CARE Canada, you are giving us consent to contact your previous employers to seek information in line with this scheme.

jobs.excerpt: About NscaleNscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI.
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centers, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.

At Nscale, our Data Center Design team plays a critical role in turning AI infrastructure requirements into buildable, scalable facilities across our global portfolio. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

As Director, Data Hall Design, you will build and lead Nscale's data hall design practice, the specialist function responsible for the physical design of AI infrastructure inside the data hall. This includes GPU rack layouts, high-speed network and storage topology, structured cabling, fiber tray routing, patch matrices, rack-level power distribution, and bill of materials development.

The role sits at the intersection of AI infrastructure architecture, physical data center design, construction delivery, and operations. You will translate complex GPU, networking, storage, power, and cooling requirements into precise, buildable design packages that construction, installation, procurement, and operations teams can execute with clarity.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at launch. You will establish standards, templates, and quality processes, and build a scalable team of data hall designers as Nscale's global portfolio grows.

What You'll be Doing

  • Own data hall layout design across Nscale's AI data center portfolio, from early concept layouts through construction-ready drawing packages.
    - Design rack layouts that optimize for GPU cluster topology, compute density, cooling strategy, power distribution, cable management, and operational access.
    - Translate network architecture into physical design for spine-leaf, fat-tree, rail-optimized GPU fabric, InfiniBand, Ethernet, storage, and management networks.
    - Produce clear data hall design deliverables, including layout plans, rack elevations, cable management plans, fiber tray layouts, patch matrices, topology diagrams, power distribution plans, BOMs, and asset documentation.
    - Design structured cabling systems for high-density AI environments, including fiber type, connector type, polarity, bend radius, slack management, labeling, color coding, and documentation standards.
    - Integrate thermal and power requirements into data hall layouts, including hot/cold aisle containment, rear-door heat exchangers, direct liquid cooling, immersion cooling, rack loads, power feeds, and cable pathway requirements.
    - Develop accurate bills of materials for data hall equipment, cabling, hardware, accessories, and procurement packages, from early budget estimates through construction-ready packages.
    - Establish DCIM and asset documentation standards covering rack positions, device assignments, port mappings, power connections, IP addressing, as-built records, and operational handover.
    - Partner closely with network engineering, IT architecture, MEP engineering, construction, procurement, operations, commissioning, and design technology teams.
    - Develop and maintain reusable data hall design standards, templates, reference layouts, quality review processes, and delivery cadences.
    - Stay current on AI hardware evolution, including new GPU generations, switch architectures, optical interconnects, liquid and immersion cooling, and increasing rack power densities.
    - Build and lead a team of data hall designers as the portfolio scales, setting expectations for technical quality, documentation, delivery pace, and cross-functional collaboration.

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in data hall design, data center infrastructure design, IT infrastructure planning, structured cabling engineering, or a closely related technical field.
    - Deep experience designing physical infrastructure for high-density compute environments, including rack layout, power distribution, cooling integration, and structured cabling.
    - Strong knowledge of GPU cluster physical design, ideally including NVIDIA DGX/HGX systems, SuperPOD-scale environments, or comparable AI/HPC infrastructure.
    - Strong understanding of high-speed networking physical design, including InfiniBand, 100G/400G/800G Ethernet, spine-leaf and fat-tree topologies, and GPU fabric architectures.
    - Expertise in structured cabling and fiber infrastructure, including OS2, OM3/OM4/OM5, LC, MPO/MTP, polarity schemes, loss budgets, and high-density fiber management.
    - Demonstrated ability to produce production-quality design documentation, including data hall layouts, rack elevations, cable plans, fiber tray layouts, patch matrices, topology diagrams, and BOMs.
    - Experience developing procurement-ready bills of materials for complex data hall builds.
    - Familiarity with DCIM, IPAM, and asset management platforms such as NetBox, Nlyte, Sunbird, or equivalent systems.
    - Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, and at least one data center design, BIM, DCIM, or infrastructure documentation tool.
    - Working knowledge of rack-level and row-level power distribution, including PDUs, busway, overhead power, and rack power management.
    - Experience collaborating with MEP engineers, construction teams, procurement teams, and operations teams in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.
    - Ability to set standards, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and turn ambiguous infrastructure requirements into clear, buildable design packages.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with direct liquid cooling, rear-door heat exchangers, and immersion cooling integration in high-density data halls.
    - Familiarity with NVIDIA NVLink Switch System, Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum Ethernet, and emerging AI fabric architectures.
    - Experience designing AI, HPC, hyperscale, cloud, or mission-critical data center environments.
    - Knowledge of optical transceiver types, silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, and their implications for high-speed server and switch connectivity.
    - Experience building or leading a data center infrastructure design team.
    - Experience integrating data hall assets into BIM, DCIM, digital twin, or operational documentation workflows.
    - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
    - Relevant certifications such as BICSI RCDD, BICSI DCDC, NVIDIA DGX-related certifications, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent credentials.

Why this role matters

The data hall is where Nscale's AI infrastructure comes to life. In this role, you will:

  • Set a consistent documentation standard across layout, cabling, fiber, patching, rack elevation, power, BOM, and asset documentation for every Nscale data hall.
    - Enable GPU clusters to deploy at target density with clean cabling, correct fiber topology, accurate power distribution, and minimal field rework.
    - Deliver BOMs that procurement can rely on directly, making missing materials, substitutions, and emergency orders the exception.
    - Become a trusted technical partner to network engineering, IT architecture, MEP, construction, and operations from the earliest design stages.
    - Make DCIM and as-built documentation complete, current, and trusted as the operational source of truth.
    - Grow the data hall design practice from a hands-on lead role into a high-performing team with reusable standards, repeatable processes, and strong delivery discipline.
    - Turn Nscale's data hall designs into a competitive advantage in deploying AI infrastructure quickly, accurately, and reliably.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
    - Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
    - Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
    - Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
    - Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

$170,000—$240,000 USD

Silicon Ranch is a fully integrated provider of customized renewable energy, carbon, and battery storage solutions for a diverse set of partners across North America.

By joining Silicon Ranch, you will be joining a team of experienced and dedicated individuals who have proven time and again that it is indeed possible to not only “make solar do more”, but to make the promise of carbon-free, renewable energy that benefits people right where it comes from a tangible, measurable, and replicable reality.

Position: Senior Civil Engineer

Location: Remote

Overview: The Senior Civil Engineer supports all Civil aspects of our utility-scale Photovoltaic (PV) Solar power plants. This includes oversight through the Civil Engineering design process, ensuring adherence to jurisdictional requirements, SRC Contract documents, industry standards and sound engineering judgement. The Senior Civil Engineer will also assist throughout construction with resolution of field issues and final acceptance of the project prior to Contractor demobilization.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Primary Job Responsibilities:

Successful candidate also must be eager to learn and grow as a professional in the field. Candidate must have experience self-managing project tasks, be budget conscious, and support multiple project teams simultaneously. Working knowledge of permitting agencies and multidisciplinary design teams is required. Experience interpreting geotechnical reports citing soil conditions, full property surveys, wetland delineations, object and feature setbacks and other major critical civil features often found on complex sites. jobs.description:
***For that position, we only hire in Casablanca (Morocco) 🇲🇦***

Who is Rollee

Rollee is a data platform that helps financial institutions make better risk decisions by accessing verified income, employment, and other alternative data directly from the source.

The way people work has changed. Income can now come from multiple employers, freelance work, gig platforms, or other sources, but many financial institutions still rely on traditional documents and credit data to understand someone's financial situation. This can make verification slow and fragmented and can leave people with non-traditional income profiles underserved.

Through a single platform, we connect to sources such as gig platforms, government tax portals, payment platforms, and other employment and income systems, then transform that information into structured, actionable data. Our customers use it to verify income and employment, improve their risk models, reduce fraud, and make better underwriting decisions.

Ultimately, our mission is to help build a financial system where people can be assessed based on a more complete picture of their real financial situation, regardless of how or where they work.

The role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer Intern to join our Coverage team for 6 months.

The Coverage team is responsible for expanding and maintaining Rollee’s ability to connect to employment and income data sources. You’ll work alongside our engineers on technical challenges involving web and mobile applications, third-party systems, APIs, authentication flows, and data extraction.

This internship is a great fit for someone who enjoys exploring how systems work, solving unconventional technical problems, and learning by doing. You’ll have the opportunity to work on real production challenges, collaborate with different members of our tech team, and progressively take ownership of your work.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters most to us is your curiosity, technical foundations, willingness to learn, and ability to tackle unfamiliar problems.

What you'll do

  • Build, maintain, and improve integrations with employment and income data sources
  • Explore web and mobile applications to understand how they communicate with backend systems
  • Work with documented, partially documented, and undocumented third-party APIs
  • Help debug authentication flows, network requests, and data extraction processes
  • Write clean, reliable, and maintainable Python code
  • Investigate technical issues and contribute to finding solutions
  • Learn and apply good engineering practices, design patterns, and clean architectures
  • Contribute to testing, monitoring, and automation
  • Collaborate with engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, Frontend Developers, and other members of the team
  • Take ownership of your work, iterate quickly, learn from feedback, and continuously improve

As you progress, you’ll have the opportunity to take on increasingly challenging problems and greater ownership.

What we're looking for

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience with Python, whether through internships, personal projects, coursework, or professional experience
  • Some hands-on experience with web scraping, automation, or data extraction
  • An interest in exploring and debugging web and/or mobile applications
  • Curiosity about HTTP, APIs, and how applications communicate with backend systems
  • A self-learning mindset and an appetite for challenging technical problems
  • A strong interest in fintech, data, and financial inclusion
  • The ability to learn independently and get comfortable with unfamiliar technical challenges
  • Good written and spoken English - we work 100% in English

This is an internship, so we don’t expect you to tick every box. We’re much more interested in your technical foundations, curiosity, and ability to learn than in the number of technologies you already know.

Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus:

  • Experience working with undocumented or partially documented third-party APIs
  • Experience with network debugging and traffic analysis
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms
  • Familiarity with mobile and/or web application security, encryption, and common security protocols
  • Experience investigating how web or mobile applications work under the hood
  • An understanding of privacy-by-design principles
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, or DevOps practices
  • An interest in software architecture, design patterns, and technical excellence
  • Experience working independently or as part of a remote team

Why Rollee

  • Learn by building something that matters. Join an early-stage company with an ambitious mission: transforming how employment and income data is accessed around the world.
  • Work on real problems. You won’t spend your internship on side projects. You’ll contribute to real technical challenges and production systems alongside our engineering team.
  • Learn from an experienced team. Work closely with engineers, Product Managers, and Data Scientists and develop your skills through hands-on experience and feedback.
  • Take ownership. We’ll give you the support you need while encouraging you to progressively own your work, make decisions, and learn from the results.
  • Grow with us. Take on increasingly challenging problems as you develop your skills and demonstrate what you can do.
  • Work flexibly. We care about outcomes and ownership, not where you sit. We give our team the flexibility and trust to do their best work.
  • Get the tools you need. We provide a MacBook, plus access to a coworking space and/or a remote-work equipment budget, depending on your location.
  • Be part of an international team. Work with people from different backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives in an environment where everyone can contribute.
  • Join a well-backed company. Rollee is backed by leading investors and business angels, including Speedinvest, Seedcamp, and 20VC.
  • And there’s more. We offer additional benefits that we’ll be happy to walk you through during the interview process.

Our hiring process

  1. Cultural interview with our People Manager (30 min)
  2. Take-home technical assignment
  3. Technical interview with members of the Coverage Team (1 hour)
  4. Interview with a Tech Lead & Product Manager (30min)
  5. Final conversation with our CEO (15 min)
Salary: 800-1000 euros/month

jobs.description:
Req ID:392719

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Data Migration Engineer (Informatica/DBT) to join our team remotely in the US.

Role Overview
o The Senior Data Migration Engineer serves as a hands-on technical contributor and delivery anchor, responsible for designing and implementing Python-based extract/load pipelines, dbt-based transformations, and Airflow-based orchestration for a large-scale migration from Informatica PowerCenter to a modern data stack.
o This role requires deep expertise in converting complex Informatica workflows into Python, dbt, and Airflow, and the ability to deliver production-quality, functionally equivalent output at enterprise scale.

Key Responsibilities:
• Assess complex Informatica workflows including sessions, mappings, and parameterizations and translate them into equivalent Python EL scripts and dbt transformation models.
• Develop and maintain Python EL pipelines to land high-volume data, including billion-row tables, into the target warehouse using SQLAlchemy, cx_Oracle, pyodbc, and bulk export tools such as Oracle Data Pump and SQL Server BCP.
• Design and develop dbt transformation models based on Informatica mapping logic, incorporating dbt best practices including model layering, macros, incremental strategies, and snapshot patterns.
• Develop dbt-native tests as well as custom Python unit tests to validate transformation correctness and data quality.
• Develop Airflow DAGs to orchestrate Python EL and dbt scripts end-to-end, producing output that is functionally equivalent to the source Informatica workflows.
• Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipeline for dbt and Airflow code, including lint gates, automated testing, and deployment to shared NAS.
• Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
• Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
• Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

Required Skills & Experience:
• 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
• 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
• Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
• 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing
• 5+ years of SQL experience - complex joins, window functions, aggregations across large datasets
• Experience with Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp) or SQL Server BCP / BULK INSERT for high-volume data movement

Preferred:
• Experience with SQLAlchemy, cx_Oracle, or pyodbc for Python-based database connectivity

jobs.description:
Chez Fresche Solutions, nous offrons un excellent équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée avec des horaires flexibles. Vous pouvez travailler n'importe où en Amérique du Nord... que ce soit depuis votre domicile ou dans l'un de nos bureaux... la décision vous appartient.

POURQUOI REJOINDRE FRESCHE ? Nous croyons en notre rôle de leader dans notre secteur, nous croyons en l'innovation, nous croyons en la satisfaction de nos clients, en garantissant leur succès et en nous assurant que 100 % de nos clients peuvent servir de référence.

Notre culture d'entreprise distincte fait de nous un employeur de choix, ainsi qu'un choix de premier plan pour nos clients depuis onze (11) années consécutives. Nous travaillons sans relâche pour que nos valeurs imprègnent l'entreprise et se reflètent dans tout ce que nous faisons. Qu'il s'agisse de fixer des priorités, de définir des idées ou d'exécuter des processus, nous nous engageons à ce que nos valeurs se manifestent à tous les niveaux de notre organisation.

Êtes-vous intéressé(e) à aider les organisations à faire un meilleur usage de leurs données et de leurs analyses ? Nous recherchons un(e) Représentant(e) en développement des affaires (BDR) qui aidera à construire le pipeline de ventes pour Fresche Analytics, en connectant les organisations avec des solutions qui améliorent le reporting, la visibilité financière, l'intelligence d'affaires (BI) et la prise de décision basée sur les données.

Fresche Solutions aide les organisations à moderniser leurs applications, leurs données et leurs environnements technologiques. Grâce à Fresche Analytics, nous aidons les clients à tirer une plus grande valeur de leurs données en utilisant des solutions modernes d'analyse, de reporting, d'IA et de données basées sur Microsoft.

Résumé du poste

En tant que Représentant(e) en développement des affaires (BDR) – Fresche Analytics, vous serez un membre crucial de notre équipe de vente, responsable de la génération de leads qualifiés et de la construction d'un solide pipeline d'opportunités Analytics.

Un point central de ce rôle sera d'engager les directeurs financiers (CFO), les leaders de la finance, les équipes FP&A (Planification et analyse financières), les contrôleurs et d'autres parties prenantes de l'entreprise qui peuvent bénéficier d'une amélioration du reporting financier, des analyses et de l'accès aux données d'entreprise.

Votre objectif principal sera d'identifier de manière proactive les comptes cibles, d'engager les décideurs clés, de qualifier les opportunités potentielles et de planifier des réunions d'introduction de haute qualité pour l'équipe de vente Analytics.

Responsabilités

Prospection proactive

  • Identifier et rechercher des clients potentiels et des comptes cibles pour les solutions Fresche Analytics.
  • Identifier les décideurs clés, y compris les directeurs financiers (CFO), les leaders de la finance, les équipes FP&A, les contrôleurs et les leaders de l'analytique.
  • Utiliser des outils de prospection tels que LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo et des bases de données de l'industrie pour créer des listes de prospects ciblées.

Sensibilisation et engagement

  • Mener des actions de prospection sortante par téléphone, e-mail, LinkedIn et d'autres canaux pour susciter l'intérêt pour Fresche Analytics.
  • Articuler clairement la manière dont les solutions d'analyse peuvent améliorer le reporting financier, l'intelligence d'affaires, la visibilité des données et la prise de décision.
  • Adapter l'approche en fonction de l'industrie du prospect, de ses défis commerciaux, de son rôle et de son environnement technologique existant.

Qualification des leads

  • Mener des conversations de découverte initiales pour comprendre l'environnement actuel du prospect en matière de reporting, d'analyse et de données.
  • Identifier les défis tels que le reporting manuel, la dépendance aux feuilles de calcul, les données fragmentées, la visibilité limitée ou les processus de reporting financier inefficaces.
  • Déterminer si les prospects ont un besoin potentiel pour les solutions Fresche Analytics.
  • Documenter avec précision les informations de qualification dans Salesforce et les plateformes d'engagement commercial.

Planification de réunions

  • Planifier des réunions d'introduction qualifiées entre les clients potentiels et l'équipe de vente Analytics.
  • Fournir un contexte clair concernant les défis du prospect, ses priorités commerciales, les parties prenantes et l'opportunité potentielle.
  • Assurer un transfert fluide des opportunités qualifiées aux Chargés de compte (Account Executives).

Génération de pipeline

  • Générer de manière constante des leads et des opportunités Analytics qualifiés.
  • Établir des relations avec de nouvelles parties prenantes de la finance et des affaires au sein des comptes cibles.
  • Suivre et rendre compte des activités de génération de leads, des réunions, des opportunités et du pipeline généré.
  • Collaborer avec les ventes et le marketing pour affiner les campagnes sortantes et les messages axés sur l'analytique.

Gestion du CRM

  • Maintenir des registres précis et à jour des activités de prospection et des interactions dans Salesforce.
  • Suivre les progrès par rapport aux objectifs d'activité, de réunions, d'opportunités et de pipeline.
  • Maintenir des informations précises sur les comptes et les contacts pour soutenir les efforts de prospection en cours.

Connaissance du marché

  • Développer une forte compréhension du paysage des données et de l'analytique, y compris l'analytique financière, l'intelligence d'affaires, le reporting, l'IA et les plateformes de données modernes.
  • Rester informé(e) sur les solutions Fresche Analytics, les cas d'utilisation des clients et les propositions de valeur.
  • Développer une compréhension des défis commerciaux auxquels sont confrontés les directeurs financiers et les organisations financières.

Collaboration

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Chargés de compte Analytics pour identifier les comptes prioritaires et générer des opportunités qualifiées.
  • Collaborer avec le marketing sur des campagnes ciblées axées sur l'analytique et la finance.
  • Partager des retours sur les objections des prospects, l'efficacité des messages, les tendances du marché et les points de douleur des clients.

Objectifs et indicateurs

  • Activité de prospection sortante constante par téléphone, e-mail et LinkedIn.
  • Réunions qualifiées : Générer environ 8 à 12 réunions Analytics qualifiées par mois.
  • Génération de pipeline : Contribuer constamment au pipeline qualifié pour Fresche Analytics.
  • Pénétration de comptes : Établir de nouvelles relations avec les parties prenantes de la finance et des affaires au sein des comptes ciblés.
  • Suivre la conversion des réunions, la création d'opportunités, le pipeline généré et l'efficacité globale des campagnes.

Qualifications

  • Expérience de succès démontrée dans un rôle de BDR, SDR, ventes internes ou développement des affaires, de préférence dans le domaine de la technologie, de l'analytique, du SaaS ou des services informatiques.
  • Expérience de prospection auprès de parties prenantes commerciales de haut niveau ; une expérience d'engagement auprès de directeurs financiers (CFO) ou de leaders de la finance est un atout.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et verbale.
  • Forte présence téléphonique et capacité à engager efficacement des décideurs de haut niveau.
  • Capacité à comprendre et à articuler des concepts analytiques et technologiques de manière claire et axée sur les affaires.
  • Motivé(e), orienté(e) résultats et à l'aise pour travailler de manière indépendante. • Solides compétences organisationnelles et en gestion du temps.
  • Maîtrise du CRM et des outils de prospection tels que Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesloft, Outreach ou des plateformes similaires.
  • Une expérience ou une familiarité avec l'analytique, le reporting financier, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data ou des technologies connexes est considérée comme un atout.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Salaire de base compétitif et structure de commissions basée sur les performances.
  • Programme d'avantages sociaux de premier ordre.
  • Outils et ressources de vente avancés avec un ensemble technologique (tech stack) fourni par l'entreprise.
  • Une culture de l'innovation et des équipes collaboratives axées sur le succès des clients.
  • Environnement entièrement à distance avec des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis et au Canada selon les besoins.
  • L'opportunité de jouer un rôle direct dans la construction et la croissance de l'activité Analytics de Fresche.
  • Si vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des affaires, l'analytique et la création de nouvelles relations avec des dirigeants d'entreprise, nous aimerions vous connaître.

Bright!Tax is hiring a Tax Senior specialising in Business Entities, to anchor our US business entity work. You will prepare, review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for American entrepreneurs living outside the United States. You will handle most of that work end to end, and you will also review returns prepared by others so our team can learn from you. Between entity deadlines you will carry individual expat returns and the international forms that sit alongside them, so the year stays balanced. You will also mentor the preparers on our team who want to grow into entity work. This is a fully remote independent contractor role, open on location, working the US filing calendar. It will suit someone who is confident making their own judgment calls and comfortable working the way a small, fully remote firm works.

Key responsibilities

  • Review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for expat-owned businesses, and prepare them end to end where that is the better fit.
  • Grow into the international layer that sits on top of entity work, including Forms 5471, 8865, and 8858, GILTI and subpart F, and foreign trust reporting. Experience here is welcome, and we will teach it if you have not done it.
  • Talk directly with clients by phone and video: explain positions, walk them through their entity returns, deliver completed work, and flag where their facts call for filings beyond the current scope. No selling or business development.
  • Mentor and upskill Tax Team members toward independent entity preparation, in partnership with Learning and Development.
  • Carry individual expat returns and international filings in the months between entity deadlines.

jobs.excerpt: Senior QA EngineerFull-Time | Remote (Europe / CET-Compatible Time Zones) About Prism StudioPrism Studio is a Malta-based, independent video game development company focused on building unforgettable, player-first experiences driven by clear artistic direction, state-of-the-art tools and a strong visual identity.
jobs.description:
Senior QA Engineer

Full-Time | Remote (Europe / CET-Compatible Time Zones)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based, independent video game development company focused on building unforgettable, player-first experiences driven by clear artistic direction, state-of-the-art tools and a strong visual identity. Our work is guided by a culture of innovation, creativity and close collaboration, allowing us to pursue our vision of bringing back the fun in video games and creating experiences that feel engaging, rewarding and memorable for players. We operate as a fully remote studio with a globally distributed team of experienced developers, artists and designers. Prism is structured around trust, accountability and clear communication, enabling us to collaborate efficiently across time zones while maintaining a consistent standard of quality and execution.

The studio is currently developing its first PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter, Heptic Arena, with the aim of standing out within the genre and leaving a lasting impression on players. Join us on our exciting journey as we continue to build cutting-edge games, push the boundaries of what’s possible in the gaming world, and provide unparalleled entertainment and compelling experiences for players around the globe!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to play a hands-on role in maintaining and raising the quality of our games throughout development.

Working closely with engineering, design, art and production, you will help apply a structured and proactive approach to testing across game features. You will be responsible for creating detailed test plans, identifying and investigating complex issues, executing testing workflows, and ensuring problems are communicated clearly and resolved effectively.

This role goes beyond surface-level testing. We are looking for someone who understands game development from a technical perspective and can think critically about how systems interact, where they may fail, and how quality can be verified early in the development process. As we develop Heptic Arena, you will play an important role in ensuring that gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality, performance, and the overall player experience meet the standard we want to deliver.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute test coverage across features, systems, and game builds throughout development.
  • Create detailed test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical and gameplay requirements.
  • Test new features and systems across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility scenarios.
  • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and relevant technical information.
  • Work directly with engineers, designers, and other disciplines to investigate issues, determine severity, and validate fixes.
  • Test gameplay systems within Unreal Engine 5, using your technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behaviour.
  • Support testing of multiplayer and networked gameplay, identifying issues relating to replication, connectivity, latency, synchronisation, and player interactions.
  • Coordinate and support internal playtests, turning observations and player feedback into clear, actionable findings.
  • Maintain bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and reporting within Jira.
  • Monitor defect trends and testing data to identify recurring issues and areas requiring additional test coverage.
  • Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.
  • Work closely with production and QA leadership to prioritise defects against development milestones and release requirements.
  • Help the wider team identify technical and gameplay risks early rather than relying on testing at the very end of production.

About You

  • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a senior QA, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality role.
  • Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine 5, with proven commercial experience on a shipped title or game currently in active production.
  • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the relationship between engineering, design, art, production, and QA.
  • Experience creating and maintaining structured test plans, test cases, and regression coverage.
  • Strong bug investigation and reproduction skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and precisely.
  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant scripting or programming technologies, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.
  • Experience with QA and bug-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration/delivery workflows.
  • Experience analysing QA data, defect trends, and testing results to identify patterns and areas of risk.
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and discussing issues directly with engineers.
  • Highly organised and capable of independently managing priorities across multiple features and areas of development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A proactive approach to quality, with the ability to identify potential issues before they become larger production problems.
  • Genuine interest in games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay feel polished, responsive, and enjoyable.
  • Must be based in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in daily collaboration, meetings, and team syncs.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter titles.
  • Experience testing networked gameplay and debugging issues involving replication, latency, matchmaking, or online services.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, scripts, or QA tools.
  • Experience with performance, load, or stress testing.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.
  • Experience testing across multiple platforms.
  • AAA game development experience.
  • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.
  • Experience contributing to a title through multiple stages of production, from early development through launch.
  • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer games.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplinary team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

Working remotely in New Brunswick with one of Postmedia’s news teams, ideal candidates are graduating students or recent graduates. Enterprising self-starters and team players, they have a sense for stories that resonate with a diverse readership. A key asset is the ability to use digital tools to break and develop stories and ideas. Successful candidates will work to tight deadlines covering a wide range of news and other subjects.

This full-time reporting position under the collective agreement will be assigned to the Fredericton Daily Gleaner.

Provision may be made by mutual agreement for assignment to other of Postmedia’s newsrooms. Some weekend and statutory holiday work may be included.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop content to engage audiences across several platforms tailored to meet the varying needs of web and mobile audiences.
  • Have story ideas daily, a job essential along with the flexibility to quickly pivot to other newsroom priorities to meet changing needs.
  • Use social media and other digital tools to uncover what’s breaking and what readers in real time are talking about which quickly needs attention.
  • Cultivate sources to break stories and help set the news agenda.
  • Work with digital teams to create interactive content, including text, photo, video and other multimedia elements that both engage and enrich readers.

Who you are:

  • A graduating journalism school student or graduate, or a candidate from a related field. Newsroom experience is an asset, but you have the ability to quickly layer and prioritize what needs to be done to quickly move up the job learning curve.
  • Flexible to work effectively in breaking news, features and short form, along with non-traditional story formats.
  • Hungry to make the most of a chance to work in a daily newsroom with top-notch journalists and eager to show what you can do to help by collaborating with colleagues.
  • A digger with natural curiosity, not satisfied with pat answers; always looking for hidden story angles and with a talent, or developing one, for explanatory journalism.
  • A reporter interested not just in what happened or is happening, but also why and how, with the ability to concisely convey that added meaning to readers.
  • Experience and strength in video, podcast presentation and other digital tools is an asset.
  • A valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle are also assets.

jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

As a Claims Adjudication Specialist, you will play a critical role within our Operations Department, focused on evaluating and servicing claims related to our Product and Shipping Protection plans, which are offered by over 1,000+ Merchant Partners. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert, supporting our Customer Support and Service Technician partners to ensure accurate and timely service of complex claims that require deeper investigation.

This position requires strong analytical skills, critical thinking, and the ability to interpret multiple policies across a wide range of product categories. On a daily basis, you’ll review complex claim submissions, manage escalations, and investigate unusual claim patterns. Success in this role relies on meticulous attention to detail, evidence-based decision-making and ability to adapt to frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment.

You'll collaborate closely with customers, service partners, and internal teams to deliver accurate claim decisions while ensuring an exceptional customer experience. The role involves inbound and outbound calls, as well as written communications with customers, service providers, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the escalation point of contact from outsourced partners, customer support teams and service technician partners.
  • Investigate and resolve complex claim situations, ensuring decisions align with contract terms and internal policies.
  • Troubleshoot delays in claims processing, ensuring timely resolutions and enhanced customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate service technician dispatching and parts ordering when necessary to support claim resolution.
  • Resolve escalated customer issues by proposing fair resolutions within policy guidelines and clearly communicating outcomes to the customer.
  • Maintain detailed and organized documentation of all customer and partner interactions.
  • Investigate suspected fraudulent claims and report findings as needed.
  • Recommend process improvements and opportunities to automate routine tasks.
  • Provide timely responses to claim inquiries via phone and email, in line with established SLAs.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and escalate unresolved claim issues.
  • Stay up to date on product offerings, service workflows, and policy updates to better support customers.
  • Identify and communicate training needs for front-line support teams to improve service quality.
  • Keep internal systems current with relevant technical issues, customer feedback, and insights.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge:

  • Active adjuster licenses (preferred).
  • 3-5 years of technical customer service, claims management/adjudication, insurance adjusting, or contact center experience. Claims adjudication preferably in a protection plan environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written with the ability to convey complex claim details and supporting rationale for decisioning in a clear and concise way both to customers and internal system notations.
  • Embraces frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in managing evolving challenges.
  • Experienced with claims management systems, contact center platforms, and Google suites of products.
  • Proven ability to to navigate and work effectively across various software systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, identify solutions, and make decisions efficiently.
  • Thrive in environments of high claim volumes with exponential company growth while maintaining excellent performance and accuracy.

Estimated Pay Range: $45,000 - $55,000 per year salaried*

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, work location and job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

We work in close partnership with providers, advocates, policymakers, and public health leaders to create healthier communities and protect immunization access for all families.

The Regional Advocacy Director manages a portfolio of state chapters within a defined multi-state region, ensuring strong execution of grassroots advocacy efforts, organizational priorities, and state campaign goals. Reporting to the Director of Advocacy, this role provides direct supervision, accountability, guidance, and operational support to State Directors while helping build consistent, high-functioning advocacy programs across the region.

State Chapter Management & Supervision

Development and Onboarding of New State Chapters

  • Support expansion efforts by helping identify, assess, and develop new state chapter opportunities within the region.
  • Provide training, operational guidance, and early-stage support to help new chapters build sustainable grassroots infrastructure and advocacy capacity.

Operational Coordination & Communication

  • Maintain consistent communication between national advocacy leadership and state chapters.
  • Help create consistency in systems, processes, and advocacy operations across chapters.

Travel Requirement

This position requires regular travel within the assigned region and occasional national travel for organizational convenings, trainings, conferences, and strategic meetings.

Qualifications

We do not expect candidates to meet every qualification. If you are passionate about grassroots organizing, vaccines, and advancing public health, we encourage you to apply.

  • 5+ years of experience in grassroots advocacy, community organizing, public affairs, political campaigns, nonprofit leadership, or related work.
  • 2+ years of direct people management, team leadership, or supervision experience, including coaching, performance management, and supporting professional development.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, teams, regions, or stakeholders simultaneously in fast-paced environments.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Integrations (US + Calgary)
jobs.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the Role:

We are seeking a Software Engineer to build, maintain, and manage our integration platforms, ensuring scalable, reliable, and secure data flows across systems. This role is crucial as integrations become central to our service delivery. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing workflows, managing connectors and APIs, and providing ongoing support for integration performance.

At its core, this role is about transforming how data flows at Syndio and building the future of all data ingestion across the company.

Why this job is exciting:

  • Build the front door to Syndio — Data Hub is where every customer starts and the foundation every analysis runs on, so you'll decide how they connect a system, map their fields, and see exactly what came through.
  • Keep it fast at scale — customer datasets run to hundreds of thousands of employees across dozens of sources, and holding refresh times as that grows is a standing engineering problem, not a one-time fix.
  • Integrate against HRIS, ATS, and payroll APIs, building the platform's native connections and handling the real-world mess of auth flows, pagination, rate limits, schema drift, and partial failures.
  • Make failures legible by turning opaque sync errors into clear, actionable feedback so customers and Customer Success can resolve issues without an engineer in the loop.
  • Improve the implementation platform, collaborating with Forward Deployed Engineering and Implementation to understand what customers need and grow the platform's capabilities to meet more of it out of the box.
  • Work across a real distributed system spanning a Go API, Temporal workflows, a Python transformation engine, and a customer-facing frontend, following problems wherever they lead instead of stopping at a service boundary.
  • Raise the standards by establishing the patterns, documentation, and error-handling conventions that let integrations scale past what any one person can hold in their head.

Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years building and shipping production software, with solid backend fundamentals. Python and/or Go preferred.
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining integrations against third-party APIs — REST/SOAP, webhooks, OAuth and API-key auth, pagination, rate limiting, and handling upstream schema changes.
  • Experience with data pipelines and orchestration: scheduling, retries, sequencing, and monitoring workflows across systems.
  • Solid SQL and the ability to reason about data models and transformations.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, CRM, or ERP systems and their data models.
  • Strong documentation habits and a bias toward making your work legible to others.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams — you'll work directly with Customer Success and Implementation.

Nice to have:

  • Frontend experience (TypeScript/React or equivalent) and interest in building the product surface customers use to connect their systems.
  • Experience with iPaaS tools (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Tray.io, Celigo) and a point of view on when to build versus buy an integration.
  • Workflow orchestration engines (Temporal, Airflow)
  • File-based ingestion at scale — SFTP, CSV, flat-file pipelines and the validation they demand.
  • Working with sensitive employee or compensation data and the security and privacy practices that requires.

About You:

  • You like building products people depend on, and you care about the experience of whoever's on the other end — not just whether the pipeline ran.
  • You've worked with sensitive data and treat security, privacy, and compliance as part of your job rather than someone else's.
  • You've seen customer onboarding up close and know the ways cross-system data flows go wrong in practice.
  • You're comfortable in unfamiliar territory — reading a third-party API's docs, tracing a bad record back through a pipeline, and working out what actually happened.
  • You want a say in where the platform goes over the long term, and you're eager to grow into that as you learn the domain.
  • You are a strong communicator, collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical teams across levels and functions.
  • You assume positive intent, are humble and eager, expect the best from yourself, value partnership over perfection, and provide grace and understanding in stressful situations
  • You value a remote work environment and know that it requires greater intentionality on your part to build and maintain strong working relationships
  • You are based in Calgary and legally authorized to work in Alberta without need for additional visa support now or in the future.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at: $125,000 - $148,000 CAD per year in Canada / $140-160k USD in the United States. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success
  • 🏝 20 days annually in Canada. Flexible PTO in the US. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave
  • 🩺 Additional Private Medical coverage
  • 📍 Remote-First (within commuting distance of Calgary)

Role progression:

  • In the first 30 days: Focus on onboarding, mastering our core integration platforms and tools, and independently handling bug fixes and documentation updates. By the end of this period, you will have completed your first small-scale integration task.
  • In the first 60 days: Independently manage and optimize a portfolio of existing integrations, troubleshoot complex cross-system issues, and lead the build-out of new, standard integration workflows.
  • In the first 90 days: Design and implement advanced integration architectures, establish enterprise-level governance standards, and spearhead high-impact collaboration projects across engineering and customer success teams.

The Interview Overview:

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Software Engineer, Integrations position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  1. 30min phone call with a member of our Talent Team
  2. 45-60min Zoom deep dive with the Hiring Manager
  3. Technical Skills Evaluation - 60min Pair Programming
  4. Meet the Team - 30min interview with a Product
  5. Final - 30min with Engineering Leader

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.

jobs.description:
EdOps Finance Team Manager- Independent Schools Team

EdOps’ Finance Team Manager position is an ideal role for accounting or finance professionals interested in using their skills to manage a team of finance professionals and directly serve independent school clients in a leadership role within a mission-driven context. The Finance Team Manager position is designed for individuals with significant experience managing professionals. As the manager of a team of finance staff, the Finance Team Manager provides quality control to ensure work best meets the needs of schools. The manager is also responsible for staff support, developing staff technical and soft skill competencies, and guiding staff career paths.

Reports to the Director or Senior Finance Team Managers. Location flexible (this is a remote position). Part time arrangements possible for exceptional candidates.

Who we are:

EdOps is a Washington, DC-based B-Corp focused on minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance demands of running a school and supporting education leaders with data-driven insights to improve student outcomes. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. We work with all the schools that need us. Our growing team of 100+ professionals work with over 100 schools and school networks nationwide. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 99% annual client retention rate and rapid growth rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact, and we were recognized as a Washington Post Top Workplace. We are looking for education focused, finance and accounting loving, collaborative people to join our team.

What you will do:

  • As the front line manager of a team of analysts and finance specialists (generally teams of 2-5 but at least 2), deliver on all of the EdOps People Manager Expectations including:
  • Train and coach staff as part of standard training sessions and beyond, so that they meet and exceed expectations for their role and are developing towards their goals.
  • Guide and support staff’s career paths through EdOps via discussion, navigation and collaborative planning.
  • Develop and conduct Annual Reviews, Mid Year Deep Dives for direct reports with input from EdOps colleagues and clients.
  • Address underperformance and develop PIPs as necessary.
  • Decide on staff promotion timing (with approval of the Director).
  • Create and maintain a team work culture that is inclusive and fair.
  • Resolve staff issues as necessary.
  • Informing upwards on trends.
  • Create and maintain a team work culture that is inclusive and fair.
  • Ensure that their team’s client work meets EdOps quality standards:
  • Provide the necessary project management to ensure that EdOps work is completed on timely with general expected quality
  • Support in the accounting review of schools and implement team specific QC mechanisms to have reasonable certainty that work meets EdOps standards. Adapt QC processes and cadence as necessary for individuals on their team while ensuring staff are in compliance with EdOps’s standard approach to QC.
  • At times, problem solve or find solutions for the more complex parts of the work.
  • Serve as an outsourced controller for at least one school by overseeing all day-to-day full-cycle accounting and compliance aspects of the schools:
  • Close the books monthly/quarterly/annually and support the preparation of monthly financial statements.
  • Oversee federal, state, and local grants administration.
  • Serve as a school’s primary contact during annual financial audits and 990 preparation.
  • Support the annual budgeting process in partnership with School Finance Managers.
  • Liaise with a school’s state education authority (SEA) as needed.
  • Contribute to Edops’s continual improvement of our finance service line efficiency and accuracy. Gather information, notice trends, and make recommendations to Directors to improve product and processes, identify service/tools needed, and address issues.
  • Make recommendations, inform and collaborate with the Director of People Operations to optimize our people operations wide practices and approaches.
  • Play an active role in the ongoing recruitment process of new staff.
  • Some Managers, who will have a smaller team and/or staffed on fewer clients, can have specializations that encompass responsibilities not outlined here (e.g., overseeing changes to regional compliance, facilities accounting).

What you will accomplish:

By Year 1 you will have:

  • Sharpened your expertise in people management by leading a team of accounting and finance professionals.
  • Contributed to the development of the finance team’s operational changes.
  • Solved small, real problems for schools on a daily basis.
  • Independently managed the annual financial cycle for at least 1 school

By Year 3 you will have:

  • Contributed to EdOps continual improvement of our finance service line by collaborating on internal process improvements for the finance service line.
  • Possibly, specialized in an area of your own interest such as new hire onboarding and training, quality control, tool design and development, or liaising with state education agencies and/or authorizers to ensure new compliance requirements are disseminated to the whole team.
  • Continue to manage a team of accounting and finance professionals.
  • Continue to solve real problems, small and large, for schools every day.

Who you are:

  • Enjoy leading teams and helping them grow and navigate challenges they encounter in their work.
  • Accounting or finance professional who enjoys the work and is committed to delivering on the accuracy, clarity, and integrity that strong accounting and finance can bring to organizations.
  • Find meaning in applying your professional skills in support of mission-driven organizations.
  • Strong in independent problem solving. We are a very collaborative community that supports each other, but our Finance Team Managers are independent and solve new problems every day.
  • Energized by being in a customer service role. We are here first and foremost to serve our school clients.
  • Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Open to learning and growing in these areas together so that each of us can contribute to building a culture of equity and support our schools in advancing these values. Please see more on EdOps' commitment here.

What you need:

  • Experience managing teams of finance or accounting professionals.
  • Strong organization and time management skills. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities while meeting deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience with accounting systems (e.g. QuickBooks Online) and capacity to learn new systems.
  • Ability to write and clearly document processes and procedures.
  • Intermediate Excel skills.
  • Ability to interface professionally with clients.
  • Typically, Finance Team Managers have 10+ years of work or post-secondary educational experience, including 3+ years of management or supervisory experience.
  • Experience working with schools or non-profit organizations is a plus.
  • Audit experience is a plus.

What you get:

  • The chance to challenge and develop your management skills while using them to help our team be better.
  • Opportunity to work every day with colleagues who are committed to kids and supportive of each other’s efforts.
  • EdOps salaries are commensurate with relative experience and geographic location. The range for the Finance Team Manager position is $96,200-128,000/year.
  • Check out other perks of working at EdOps here. And some details on benefits here.

We know that a team from a wide range of backgrounds with different life experiences, identities, opinions, and talents makes us better able to innovate and deliver on our mission of supporting schools to improve student outcomes. Every day we work to build an inclusive company culture where everyone can be themselves at work and do their best work.

Apply:

If you are skilled in your field, excited by our mission, ready to learn, and looking for a place where you can be yourself, we want to hear from you!

What you can expect from the hiring process:

  • Application Review
  • First Review
  • Performance Task
  • Final Interviews (Behavioral, Technical, Values)

  • Offer
