jobs.excerpt: About SiGMAFounded in 2014 and headquartered in Malta, SiGMA Group employs over 400 professionals across six global offices, including Malta, Cyprus, Serbia, São Paulo, Manila and Armenia.
jobs.description:
About SiGMA

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Malta, SiGMA Group employs over 400 professionals across six global offices, including Malta, Cyprus, Serbia, São Paulo, Manila and Armenia. SiGMA is a global leader in gaming, emerging tech, affiliate marketing, events, and media, best known for its flagship international summits and industry-leading platforms. The company’s culture champions inclusivity, sustainability, collaboration, and philanthropic impact through its SiGMA Foundation initiative.

About the Role

The CRO Specialist will own the conversion performance of SiGMA Group's websites, with a primary focus on event ticketing and SiGMA Shop. We already drive strong traffic across our brands; this role exists to turn more of that traffic into revenue.

The ideal candidate is an expert in user journey strategy and tactics. They can map how visitors move from ad or search to landing page, ticket selection, checkout and post-purchase, pinpoint exactly where and why revenue is being lost, and deliver the changes that recover it. This is a hands-on, commercially driven role measured on revenue, not page aesthetics or dashboards.

Key Responsibilities

User Journey Strategy:

  • Map and own the end-to-end user journey for each brand and event: Traffic → Landing Page → Ticket/Product Selection → Cart → Checkout → Payment → Post-Purchase.
  • Design journey strategies by audience, market, device and traffic source, including first-time visitors, returning attendees, sponsors and paid-campaign traffic.
  • Ensure a consistent, low-friction path from ad to purchase, with message match between campaigns and landing pages.
  • Apply behavioural psychology (urgency, scarcity, social proof, anchoring, choice architecture) to shape journeys that convert.

Conversion Funnel Analysis:

  • Identify drop-off points, friction and bottlenecks using GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback.
  • Segment performance by device, source, campaign, geography and customer type.
  • Separate traffic quality problems from on-site conversion problems and report clearly where revenue is lost.

Experimentation & A/B Testing:

  • Own the CRO roadmap and testing backlog, prioritised by revenue impact, effort and confidence.
  • Build hypotheses from quantitative and qualitative evidence, write experiment briefs, and define success metrics.
  • Run A/B and multivariate tests on pages, CTAs, forms, pricing presentation and checkout.
  • Analyse results, decide to implement, iterate or reject, and maintain a test and learnings log.

Checkout, Payment & Revenue Growth:

  • Reduce checkout steps and fields, optimise mobile checkout, and analyse abandonment by stage.
  • Review payment methods, presentation and success/failure rates across markets and currencies.
  • Grow Average Order Value through ticket upgrades, VIP packages, bundles, add-ons, upsells and cross-sells without hurting core conversion.
  • Advise on pricing hierarchy, package comparison, early-bird mechanics and ticket tier differentiation.

Tracking & Reporting:

  • Validate GA4, GTM and HubSpot tracking for every key journey event and close measurement gaps.
  • Report weekly on CVR, AOV, ARPC, abandonment and test results to marketing leadership.
  • Quantify the incremental revenue delivered by the CRO programme.

Cross-Team Collaboration:

  • Partner with Paid Media, Social, Content, Product, UX/UI and Engineering on landing pages and journey changes.
  • Translate findings into clear requirements: Problem → Evidence → Hypothesis → Change → Expected Impact → Measurement.
  • Review new journeys before build and challenge friction or complexity.
  • Support evaluation of ticketing, e-commerce, payment and testing platforms.

Core KPIs

  • Website Conversion Rate and landing-page conversion
  • Revenue per Visitor (RPV) and Average Order Value (AOV)
  • Cart and checkout abandonment
  • Payment success rate
  • Upsell/cross-sell attach rate
  • Incremental revenue from experiments
  • Contribution to ROAS and cost per ticket

First 30 Days

  • Audit the full ticketing journey on desktop and mobile, with priority on paid-traffic funnels.
  • Set conversion baselines for each funnel stage and validate tracking.
  • Identify and size the biggest revenue leaks.
  • Deliver a prioritised CRO roadmap split into quick wins and larger builds.
  • Launch the first structured experiments and set up ongoing CRO reporting.

Key Skills & Requirements

  • 4+ years in CRO, growth or e-commerce optimisation, with a proven record of increasing website revenue, not just monitoring metrics.
  • Expert in user journey mapping, funnel analysis and conversion strategy and tactics.
  • Strong grasp of behavioural psychology and persuasion principles applied to web design and copy.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools (e.g. VWO, Optimizely, AB Tasty or similar) and experimentation frameworks.
  • Advanced GA4 and Google Tag Manager; experience with heatmap and session tools such as Hotjar or Microsoft Clarity.
  • Strong understanding of CVR, AOV, RPV, CAC, ROAS, LTV and checkout abandonment.
  • Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, ticketing platforms or comparable commerce systems.
  • Experience optimising checkout and payment flows, including mobile.
  • Technically comfortable enough to work with developers on tracking, integrations and payment gateways.
  • Commercially minded, evidence-driven and pragmatic in separating high-impact work from minor tweaks.
  • Organised, able to manage multiple brands, events and deadlines at once.
  • Experience in event ticketing, conferences, iGaming, travel or high-volume e-commerce is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with international journeys across markets, currencies and payment methods is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English (C1 or higher); additional languages are an asset.

Why SiGMA Group?

  • Grow with us – Play an important role in SiGMA's continued expansion across Latin America and help strengthen our presence within the land-based gaming industry.
  • Free iGaming Academy access – Develop your industry knowledge with access to professional courses and training.
  • Travel perks – Attend major gaming events, visit our international offices and build relationships with industry leaders around the world.
  • Performance rewards – High performers are recognised and provided with opportunities for career progression through annual reviews and bi-yearly performance check-ins.
  • International exposure – Work with leading casino operators, gaming companies and senior industry stakeholders across LATAM and SiGMA's wider global network.

jobs.description:
OUR TEAM:
The Applied Markets SBU is a small, high-impact team driving Promega's growth into specialized industry segments in Animal Health, Food Safety, Agriculture, and Environmental, where life science tools are reshaping how the world innovates, detects, validates, and ensures quality. We operate with significant autonomy, direct access to leadership, and the full backing of a privately held company that invests for the long term. Each team member owns their domain fully; there is no micromanagement, just clear strategy and the freedom to execute. We are collaborative without being codependent, and we bring genuine scientific curiosity to commercial work, which means the conversations we have with customers, partners, and regulators actually matter. If you want to build something real in markets that are still taking shape, this is the team to do it with.

YOUR ROLE:
The Animal Health industry is a relationship market, won through sustained field presence, scientific credibility, and trust built over years. The Strategic Collaborations Manager is the person who builds those bridges. You are not a product seller. You are a market maker, showing up at key industry conferences, walking the customer's lab, earning regulatory relationships, and connecting Promega's capabilities to problems the industry hasn't fully articulated or solved yet. You will build and steward relationships with global organizations including veterinary diagnostics leaders, animal health manufacturers, agricultural biotechs, and regulatory bodies, all of which require a trusted scientific partner willing to play the long game. Promega's AI layer handles the intelligence infrastructure, synthesizing market data, organizing account knowledge, and preparing briefings, so you can focus on what no tool can replicate: being present, building trust, reading the room, and seeing opportunity before it's obvious. If you have built a career on relationships that compound over time and want the autonomy to shape a market rather than just cover a territory, this is the role.

CORE DUTIES:

1. Develop and implement programmatic relationships and collaboration agreements with strategic accounts globally, working in partnership with Applied Markets SBU leadership, Branches, and the global Sales organization.

2. Leverage AI-driven analytics, digital collaboration platforms, and automation tools to identify patterns in market data, competitive intelligence, and customer behavior that inform relationship strategy and partnership design.

3. Manage high-level collaborations across targeted industry vertical(s) — including corporate manufacturers, diagnostics companies, regulatory bodies, and academic institutions — applying both catalog and custom solutions to address complex customer needs.

4. Lead feasibility assessments, support pricing objectives aligned with business segment profitability goals, guide the development of work plans and agreements, and coordinate review meetings with clients for collaborations in process.

5. Build and maintain a strategic account portfolio that progresses from transactional to long-term partnership, with clear milestones for relationship depth, revenue growth, and collaborative output.

6. Represent Promega at 10–15 major industry conferences annually, including scientific society meetings, industry trade events, and regulatory forums relevant to Applied Markets verticals.

7. Conduct strategic customer and partner site visits to deepen relationships, gather operational intelligence, and identify collaboration opportunities not visible through remote engagement.

8. Present technical content — posters, abstracts, and invited talks — at industry events to establish and sustain Promega’s scientific credibility in target market segments.

9. Build relationships with regulatory bodies (e.g., USDA Center for Veterinary Biologics, FDA CVM, EMA, Pharmacopoeia) to support market access strategy and establish Promega as a recognized technical partner in regulated applied science spaces.

10. Report critical field-based intelligence back to the business team on a regular cadence, including changes in market dynamics, customer organization and behavior, competitive landscape, regulatory trends, and emerging technology opportunities.

11. Develop a field-based plan for penetration and growth into new markets and customer segments where Promega seeks to establish a market-leading position.

12. Gain and maintain a thorough understanding of market trends, customer needs, and the competitive environment within the Animal Health vertical to inform strategic and tactical business decisions.

13. Identify early adopters, alpha and beta testers, and validation partners within target segment(s) to accelerate new product introduction and application development.

14. Interface effectively with multiple internal functions, including Strategic Business Units, Branches, Global Sales, Business Management, R&D, Operations, Finance, and Global Custom and OEM Solutions.

15. Collaborate with the Segment Marketing Manager, Product Managers, and Product Marketing Managers to contribute to strategic product roadmaps and go-to-market plans tailored to the Animal Health segment.

16. Relay vital field intelligence to cross-functional teams and work collaboratively to influence product development, application support, and service offerings.

We are seeking a highly organized, discreet, and proactive Executive Coordinator to the CEO to provide high-trust support across both personal and professional matters. This role will focus primarily on personal coordination and day-to-day support for the CEO, while also handling selected business-related and administrative responsibilities.

  • Manage personal administrative procedures and coordinate documentation with relevant institutions.

Executive and Business Support

  • Manage the CEO's professional calendar, prioritizing meetings, commitments, and strategic focus time.

Legal and Administrative Coordination

What Success Looks Like

Proxima Studio

Location: Remote / Flexible

Role Type: Full-Time Contract or Permanent

About Us

We are the indie team behind Suck Up!, where we turned goofy social deduction and conversational AI into pure comedic chaos (with over 200m views on YouTube). Now, we are building our next title: a management simulation that sits between the sandbox of The Sims and the chaotic/comedy of Schedule 1.

We operate small, fast, and scrappy. We value creative ownership, rapid prototyping, and people who can establish a cohesive, signature visual language from the ground up.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Technical 3D Character Artist who specialize in character pipelines and animations, with a cartoonist’s comedic timing and a systems-first mindset.

You will architect our character pipeline from the ground up. You will build a scalable, modular character system: designing plug-and-play facial features, swappable clothing kits, and a unified rig that lets code drive endless distinct NPCs. Your characters must prioritize bold silhouettes and comedic physicality, extreme emotional states, physical impairment, and chaotic meltdowns instantly readable in first person.

Key Responsibilities

  • Modular Character Pipeline: Model, texture, and rig a stylized, low-poly character kit with modular heads, socketed facial features, and swappable clothing that read clearly across extreme states (drunkenness, rage, distress) and across actions.
  • Master Rigging & Retargeting: Build and maintain a unified humanoid skeleton with standardized attachment sockets (hands, eyes, accessories, seats) to share animations seamlessly across all roles.
  • Smart Objects & Environments: Model modular furniture, stages, and props adhering strictly to interaction metrics, snap grids, and navmesh constraints.
  • Unity Integration: Configure character prefabs, Mecanim, rigging, animation states
  • Visual Direction: Establish character style, master visual language across the game

What We Are Looking For

Artistic & Design Sense

  • Cartoonist's Comedic Instinct: Strong grasp of silhouette, exaggerated postures, and physical slapstick (Schedule I, The Sims). You favor punchy readability over photorealism.
  • Systemic Thinking: Experience designing reusable, modular kits meant to be mixed and matched hundreds of times.

Technical Competencies

  • Full Stylized 3D Pipeline: End-to-end expertise in Blender (or equivalent) for low-poly modeling, texturing, rigging, and skinning with clean optimization.
  • Deep Unity Proficiency: Direct experience setting up Humanoid Avatars, Prefabs, Animator Controllers, and collision hulls.
  • Sockets & Retargeting: Proven workflow for modular prop attachment, socket hierarchies, and retargeting shared animations across varied body types.
  • Code based animations: Unity C# scripting for procedural animation/IK, animation blending, target tracking, and more.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and portfolio link.

Portfolio Priorities:

  • In-engine captures of stylized/low-poly characters in motion with distinct silhouettes.
  • Rigging and animation samples showing comedic timing and clean skinning.
  • Modular workflows (customization kits, swappable parts, grid-based props).

jobs.title: Consultant: Tax and Non-Tax Incentives for Mining Downstream Viability Projects:
jobs.excerpt: The International Institute for Sustainable Development is a globally recognized think tank with more than 30 years of experience working to solve today's greatest sustainable development challenges.
jobs.description:
The International Institute for Sustainable Development is a globally recognized think tank with more than 30 years of experience working to solve today's greatest sustainable development challenges. We combine deep expertise across critical policy areas with a collaborative approach to research, advice, and hands-on support that delivers real-world results. Headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, we are a diverse team of over 300 experts working from offices in Canada and Switzerland as well as other locations around the world. 

IISD hosts the Secretariat of the Intergovernmental Forum on Mining, Minerals, Metals and Sustainable Development (IGF).

The IGF's Global Mining Tax Initiative (GMTI) helps countries to increase mining revenues for sustainable development. Drawing on broad experience working with IGF member governments, the Secretariat offers this specialized and comprehensive program covering fiscal policy for the entire mining value chain, from exploration and development to mining, processing, mineral sales, and mine closure. The GMTI focuses on all aspects of fiscal policy, including taxes, royalties, and financial modelling, and has developed particular expertise on the fiscal treatment of mineral beneficiation and downstream processing.

The Challenge

As demand for critical minerals accelerates with the energy transition, a growing number of resource-rich countries are moving to capture more of the value chain domestically and attract investment. Whilst a variety of fiscal and non-fiscal tools are available, many resource-rich countries offer tax and non-tax incentives to attract investment into downstream mineral processing, from smelting and refining to further stages of value addition. These incentives can include corporate income tax holidays, accelerated depreciation, royalty relief, value-added tax and import duty exemptions, energy subsidies, infrastructure provision, export restrictions or differentiated export taxes on unprocessed ore, and guaranteed offtake arrangements.

Governments introduce these measures with the aim of capturing more value domestically, creating jobs, and building industrial capacity. However, the fiscal and non-fiscal cost of these incentives is rarely tracked systematically, and there is limited evidence on whether they actually influence investment decisions or simply reward projects that would have gone ahead regardless. Downstream processing economics are also heavily shaped by global market conditions, such as smelting overcapacity and depressed treatment and refining charges, that incentives alone cannot offset. Governments are often left weighing significant revenue foregone against uncertain and long-dated returns in jobs, value addition, and industrial development.

Our Response

To help governments make better-informed decisions on this trade-off, the IGF is developing a practice note assessing the short-, medium-, and long-term impact of tax incentives for mining downstream viability projects. The note will examine three country cases, each anchored to the critical mineral most relevant to its downstream ambitions: Zambia and copper, Brazil and iron ore or niobium, and Guinea and bauxite. Each case will be given equal depth, applying a shared analytical framework so that findings can be compared across countries with materially different fiscal capacity, market structure, and governance context.

Deliverable – Technical Input for the Downstream Incentives Practice Note

The IGF seeks a consultant, or small consultant team, to research and support the drafting of the comparative practice note. The consultant will be responsible for the following tasks:

  1. Prepare a short inception note confirming, for each of the three countries, the downstream stage under review (for example, smelting and refining for copper, alumina and possible smelter-grade aluminium for bauxite, and pelletizing, direct reduced iron, or ferroniobium processing for iron ore and niobium), the incentive taxonomy to be applied consistently across cases, and the impact metrics and time horizons to be used.
  2. For each of the three countries, document the incentives each received or was eligible for and assess the role those incentives played in the project's outcome relative to other determinants.
    1. Inventory and governance: For each of the three countries, compile an inventory of tax and non-tax incentives from the mining code, tax legislation, investment and industrialization laws, and any special economic zone regimes, capturing not just which incentives are available, but how they are governed: their legal basis, the granting authority, eligibility criteria and conditions, and the administrative and monitoring arrangements that shape how effective they are in practice.
    2. Projects: Identify actual downstream projects (built, under construction, planned, or abandoned), documenting the incentives each received or was eligible for and assessing the role those incentives played in the project's outcome relative to other determinants.
  3. Gather available fiscal and economic data for each country, including revenue foregone estimates where they exist, capital investment, employment, and the share of raw versus processed mineral exports over time, and flag data gaps and how they were addressed.
  4. Conduct stakeholder consultations in each country, engaging as relevant the ministry of finance, ministry of mines, revenue authority, investment promotion agency, state mining company, and major private operators.
  5. Draft the practice note, presenting the three country cases in a common format with a synthesis chapter setting out crosscutting findings and being explicit about the limits of comparability between the cases.
  6. Revise the draft in response to internal IGF review and, where relevant, feedback from country authorities.

Timelines

  1. Inception note confirming scope, framework, and metrics for all three countries. Due: November 2026. Days: 3 days.
  2. Literature review and international comparative summary. Due: November 2026. Estimated effort: 5 days.
  3. Incentive inventory and project mapping for Zambia (copper). Due: November 2026. Estimated effort: 3 days.
  4. Incentive inventory and project mapping for Brazil (iron ore/niobium). Due: December 2026. Estimated effort: 3 days.
  5. Incentive inventory and project mapping for Fuinea (bauxite). Due: December 2026. Estimated effort: 3 days.
  6. Preparation of questionnaire for stakeholder consultations. Due: December 2026. Estimated effort: 1 day.
  7. First draft and final draft of report. Due: December 2026. Estimated effort: 18 days.

Location: Remote

IISD will not apply for residency and work permits for this position on behalf of the applicant.

Candidates must hold appropriate work authorization for locations where they expect to be based.

Application Process

Application deadline: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled.

This is a consultant position. Submissions must be in English.

To apply for this consultancy, interested applicants should submit the following:

  • A CV (detailing your experience with mining fiscal policy, tax expenditure analysis, or downstream mineral processing).
  • An expression of interest (one page), including proposed approach and, where relevant, coverage of the three countries by team member if submitting as a team.

NOTE:

  • Incomplete applications will be automatically disqualified.
  • Only those candidates IISD wishes to interview will be contacted.

Description

Medical Monitor Dermatology, Europe

The Medical Monitor Dermatology provides medical and scientific support to clinical research programs. The Medical Monitor will perform thorough data review to ensure data integrity and subject safety oversight, and will communicate with sites, investigators, and internal project team members to ensure questions are promptly addressed

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You are skilled in building positive working relationships with all stakeholders (clinical sites, colleagues, sponsors) in a clinical research project
  • You skillfully balance the strict requirements of clinical research protocols with the realities of clinical trials
  • You are able to interpret high volumes of data and situations efficiently, and take position and advise as necessary

RESPONSIBILITIES

﻿

Protocols and projects

More specifically, as required by the projects’ scope of work, the Medical Monitor will:

  • Keep current on study protocol, study protocol amendments, Investigator’s Brochure (IB), additional safety information made available during the course of the study, and relevant clinical research guidelines involving the therapeutic indication.
  • Develop or review Medical Monitoring plan.
  • Provide project team training on study protocol and/or therapeutic area/indication.
  • Prepare for, attend, and present at Investigators’ Meetings.
  • Prepare for and attend Safety Review Meetings, as needed.
  • Provide 24-hour, 7 days a week, on-call (outside business hours) service for urgent safety-related matters
  • Provide ongoing medical support during the study to investigators, site personnel, and monitors
  • Provide advice to the sites on protocol-related issues including: questions related to the protocol inclusion and exclusion criteria, concomitant medications/medical conditions, follow-up visits due and guidance on prohibited medication
  • Review lab critical values and alerts.
  • Assess the impact of any prohibited medication taken on study and evaluate any appropriate action for the subject.
  • Evaluate the appropriateness of any dropout subject replacement.
  • Provide emergency unblinding code-break of randomized treatment assignment.

Medical advisory role (clinical sites)

  • Provides 24-hour, 7 days a week, on-call service for urgent trial-related safety issues, questions on the protocol, or other safety concerns.
  • Provides first line contact for investigators, site personnel, and monitors regarding study related medical/safety issues and resolution of study protocol and subject eligibility issues.
  • Provides advice to the clinical team staff / sites to answer any medical questions related to patient eligibility, and safety or clinical issues during the trial.
  • Assesses the impact of any prohibited medication taken on study and evaluates any appropriate action for the subject.
  • Evaluates the appropriateness of any dropout subject replacement.

Data Activities

  • Provide project-related medical consultation to the Indero project team members during business hours throughout the duration of the study.
  • Escalate to the Project Manager or Sponsor any issues requiring medical input and significant safety or data integrity concerns identified during review of data or site contact.
  • Attend meetings with Indero project team members (PM, DM, stats, CRO) and/or Sponsor, as required.
  • Verify the medical accuracy of subject safety data and maintain an ongoing assessment of the safety profile of the study.
  • Review subject safety-related data listings/tools for the purpose of identifying potential trends, unreported protocol deviations related to safety assessments, AEs, and SAEs; and address safety concerns.
  • Review protocol deviation listings to address potential safety concerns; perform impact assessment; and identify any potential trends.
  • Review coding listings of adverse events, medical history, and concomitant medications to ensure all terms are coded properly.
  • Assess if any stopping rule was met and evaluate any appropriate action or follow up with the subject, if applicable.
  • Review clinical study report.
  • Participate in the Central Monitoring activities with site data signal detection and risk management activities for the safety portion; participate in the safety review for RBM and central monitoring.

Safety Medical Monitoring and SAE Reporting Activities

  • Provide medical review of SAE form, and reviews SAE causality assigned by the Investigator.
  • Write and/or review SAE narratives
  • Work with the Pharmacovigilance Services provider or Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) to review SAEs and follow-up on outstanding safety queries, interact with Sponsor and discuss safety issues with sites, as needed.
  • Provide assistance in pharmacovigilance activities
  • Assist Indero/Sponsor in choosing safety committee members.
  • Serve as a non-voting member of the safety committee to convene and organize proceedings, as applicable.
  • Develop operating guidelines in conjunction with committee members and submit these to Sponsor for review.
  • Support business development activities with proposal development and sales presentations.
  • Participate in feasibility discussions relating to specific project proposals.
  • Assist with drafting of standard operating procedures and working practices regarding Medical Monitoring activities.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned or requested by the Chief Medical Officer.

Requirements

PROFILE

Education

  • Medical degree;

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research in a CRO, dermatology clinical trials, pharmaceutical, or biopharmaceutical company (Medical Monitor, Medical affairs, Medical Director, Safety).
  • Dermatology

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of the drug development process.
  • Ability to work in partnership with a multidisciplinary group of colleagues, including translating concepts into practical approaches and promoting consensus.
  • Outstanding ability to work independently with minimal supervision, ability to work effectively within a team, and matrix environment.
  • Ability to organize and work efficiently on several projects, each with specific requirements and/or shifting priorities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal skills.
  • Client-focused approach to work;
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, formerly Innovaderm, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Indero, formerly Innovaderm is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Commercial Customer Success team supports hundreds to thousands of customers who depend on the Samsara platform daily. This team is dedicated to equipping every customer with the necessary resources to achieve rapid value, regardless of their background or expertise.
To scale this impact, we are seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager, AI & Automation to be a hands-on developer responsible for designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems to support a digital-first post-sales strategy.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Customer Journey Optimization: Pinpoint friction points in the customer experience, create proactive interventions, and turn interactions into automated, personalized journeys.
  • End-to-End Execution: Write code, execute experimental tests, and continuously maintain production solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner across teams to ensure a cohesive experience for all users.
Success is measured by key customer outcome metrics, including increased adoption, minimized churn risk, and higher NRR tied to the agents you deploy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Analyze: Identify customer painpoints and areas of opportunity with an analytical mindset combined with a customer-centric lens.
  • Build: Build the digital CS playbooks, taking advantage of the programs and resources other teams have built, design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), build guardrails, and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.

  • Deploy: Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production-ready before they reach CSMs. Ensure anything we deploy makes the experience more simple, not more complex, for our customers.

You’ll also work closely with the Head of Search to push our search offering forward through testing new strategies, developing and validating new approaches, turning successful tests into case studies, and helping bring those learnings to the rest of the department. Results Tracking and Monitoring

  • Own performance against defined client goals and target outcomes, proactively identifying and executing the strategies needed to drive measurable results.

  • Own client communication and reporting for your accounts’ SEO initiatives, confidently explaining strategy, results, and recommendations in a way that connects search metrics to real business outcomes.
  • Contribute to process improvement and knowledge sharing, helping evolve internal playbooks, templates, and reporting standards for the search marketing team.

What We’re Looking For

ROWE (Results Only Work Environment)

No vacation policy, no time tracking, no office requirements. Autonomy and accountability go hand in hand here. jobs.title: Outcomes Architect
jobs.excerpt: About Docket Docket is the AI Marketing Agent platform helping B2B marketing teams move past the broken MQL model.
jobs.description:
About Docket

Docket is the AI Marketing Agent platform helping B2B marketing teams move past the broken MQL model. Our agents engage buyers in real conversations, qualify intent using our proprietary Sales Knowledge Lake™, and surface Agent Qualified Leads (AQLs), a far better signal than form fills and lead scores.

We're building the category of agentic marketing. We need an Outcomes Architect to make sure every customer gets measurable pipeline, value and ROI from it.

Why this role exists

AI agents don't need adoption. Nobody has to be trained to log in, so the traditional CSM job of driving usage doesn't apply here.

What our customers need is a strategic partner. Someone who understands their business, their role and the problems they're trying to solve. Someone who helps them decide which outcomes matter, measures them, changes the approach when the numbers fall short, and knows where to double down when they work.

That's an Outcomes Architect. The role is closer to strategy consulting than account management, with real technical depth underneath. You'll own customers from pilot kickoff through renewal and expansion, and you'll be measured on the results they get.

What you'll own

  • Your customers, end to end. Typically 4–5 active pilots and 10–15 annual customers. You lead the pilot and stay with the account after it converts, so customers have one owner throughout.

  • The outcome, not the relationship. You define success with the customer, set the baseline, measure it, and own the results: pipeline, value and ROI.

  • Retention and growth. Renewals, expansion into new agents and use cases, and customer stories we can share.

What you'll do

  • Set the bar at kickoff. Agree on success criteria and a baseline with every customer, and deliver the business outcomes they bought Docket for, from pilot through renewal and expansion.

  • Design and tune the agents. Prompts, qualification logic, routing rules and agent behavior.

  • Connect the stack. Integrate agents with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, Gong, webhooks and APIs, and trace where leads get lost.

  • Find the signal. Analyze conversation and visitor data to see what's converting, what's leaking and what the market is asking about.

  • Drive the decision. Turn analysis into clear recommendations for CMOs and demand gen leaders, and walk them through what to change.

  • Grow the account. Spot the next agent or use case each customer needs, and build the business case for it.

  • Shape the product. Bring customer feedback to Product with evidence, not anecdotes.

  • Run on AI yourself. Build the workflows, prompts and automations that let you manage a full portfolio without drowning in it.

Who you are

  • You've been the customer. 4+ years in B2B marketing, demand gen, growth or marketing ops. You've owned pipeline, MQL or conversion targets, and you know what a CMO is measured on. A traditional CSM background isn't what we're looking for.

  • You own numbers. You can name a metric you were accountable for, where it started, where you took it, and what you changed.

  • You're AI-native, not just AI-comfortable. You've rebuilt a real process with AI, not just used it to write faster, and you can show us what you built.

  • You've built with conversational AI. Hands-on prompt engineering or conversational AI work, not just reading about it.

  • You're technical without an engineering title. You've built Zaps, Clay tables, HubSpot workflows or prompt chains because it was faster than filing a ticket.

  • You've worked at an AI-native or early-stage SaaS company. You know how to move fast when the playbook is still being written.

  • You've worked with US customers. You're comfortable running calls and building relationships with US-based marketing and revenue leaders.

  • You tell executives the truth. You can tell a CMO their agent isn't converting, back it with data, and come with a plan.

  • You thrive when the goal isn't fully defined. You can work out what success looks like with a customer after kickoff, then go deliver it.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling or implementing marketing automation or martech

    How we interview

    Come ready to show something real you built with AI: a prompt, an agent, a workflow or an automation. Walk us through the problem it solves, how you built it, what broke along the way, and how you know it works. No-code builds are welcome. An engineering background isn't required.

Rainforests also sustain rainfalls, food supply, vital ecosystems, and livelihoods for over a billion people. Protecting them is not just a moral imperative, it is essential for a stable, prosperous, and sustainable future for us all. As the COVID-19 crisis highlights, we live in a fragile and interconnected world where sustainability cannot be taken for granted.

Kairos Power is a nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal of dramatically improving people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Ads Manager team builds the core self-serve platform that brands, agencies, and retailers use to create, manage, and optimize their advertising campaigns on Instacart. We own the services, APIs, and data models behind campaign creation, creative management, and reporting, along with the advertiser-facing experiences built on top of them. Our work serves the advertisers who drive Instacart's main revenue, and there is tremendous room to grow. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer (IC5) to own high-impact initiatives such as ads web observability and North Star metrics and automated AI review for ads formats.

About the Job

  • Lead and deliver projects end to end, from design through launch, that improve advertiser activation, platform health, and ad revenue growth.
  • Design, build, and operate scalable, well-tested services and APIs that power campaign management and reporting, reaching into the frontend where needed.
  • Partner with product managers and engineers inside and outside Ads Manager to turn ambiguous requirements into well-scoped plans.
  • Define key architectural patterns, write and review system design documents, and improve observability and system reliability.
  • Mentor junior engineers and raise the bar for code quality through thoughtful code review.
  • Contribute to recruiting and improve team processes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong experience building and operating backend services and APIs in a modern web framework such as Ruby on Rails or Go.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL, including data modeling and query performance.
  • Experience designing for scale, reliability, and maintainability across distributed systems.
  • Comfortable working across the stack, including integrating with frontend applications.
  • Self-starter and self-motivated, able to unblock yourself and drive work forward independently.
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills, with a sense of ownership for production systems.
  • Clear communicator who collaborates well with engineers, designers, and PMs across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work experience in the digital advertising industry or on self-serve platforms.
  • Experience designing and versioning public or partner-facing APIs (REST or GraphQL).
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and messaging systems such as Kafka or Sidekiq.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and tooling (AWS, Terraform, Datadog or similar).
  • Experience with React or TypeScript, and with integrating ML or AI capabilities into products.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is seeking a senior software engineer to help build and scale evaluation and analysis infrastructure for Autonomous Vehicle development.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a senior software engineer to help build and scale evaluation and analysis infrastructure for Autonomous Vehicle development. This role sits at the intersection of AV tooling, distributed systems, data platforms, and developer efficiency. You will develop and enhance systems that allow AV engineers to run AV log data analysis, assess model behavior, debug regressions, and produce critical metrics and insights at scale.


This engineer should be able to operate independently, partner deeply with senior technical leads, and bring clarity to complex platform decisions spanning evaluator execution at high-scale, performance tunings, structured outputs and output schema evolution, observability, and production readiness. This role directly improves how AV engineers examine autonomous driving performance, analyze regressions, validate analyzers, and trust the results produced by NVIDIA’s AV infrastructure. The ideal candidate will help make evaluation workflows faster, safer, more observable, and easier for teams to adopt.


What you'll be doing:

  • Design and build evaluation and analysis tooling used by AV and ML engineers.
  • Improve analyzer workflows, including onboarding, execution, qualification, and production observability.
  • Build reliable services, APIs, CI pipelines, and UI-facing workflows across the stack.
  • Define and evolve data contracts for analyzer outputs, including structured schemas, tabular data, time-series data, and metadata.
  • Improve system stability, performance, traceability, alerting, and operational debuggability for high-scale workloads.
  • Partner with AV engineering, data platform, infrastructure, and product teams to deliver end-to-end user workflows.
  • Establish guardrails for analyzer rollout, including pre-merge validation, output-size controls, runtime/memory metrics, and production monitoring.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience building production systems, developer tools, data platforms, or evaluation infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages.
  • Experience designing distributed systems, workflow orchestration, APIs, backend services, or data pipelines.
  • Ability to reason across systems software, data schemas, backend services, and user-facing tooling.
  • Experience collaborating across teams and driving ambiguous technical work to completion.
  • Ability to balance new feature development with production stability, maintainability, and user support, while demonstrating agility and adaptability in a fast paced environment.
  • Experience with Protobuf, Parquet, schema evolution, data contracts, and large-scale analytical storage.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Background with self-driving car development, simulation, evaluation, or analysis workflows.
  • Experience with observability, performance profiling, resource usage analysis, and production reliability.
  • Experience improving legacy systems through incremental migration, deprecation, and architecture cleanup.

Hours: Shift work 12-hour shifts, 8 hours of regular time, 3.5 hours of overtime per day

  • Promptly answer, evaluate, and prioritize incoming requests for service while communicating effectively with all callers

About Product

VyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management. Built on Linux, VyOS integrates powerful routing, firewall, VPN, and network services into a unified system. Unlike traditional networking hardware, VyOS can be deployed on a wide range of platforms, from physical routers and cloud environments to virtual machines, giving users flexibility and control over their network infrastructure.

The key strength of VyOS lies in its comprehensive feature set. It supports dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP), multiple VPN types (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard), firewall rules, traffic shaping, and more - all configured through a unified command-line interface (CLI) familiar to network engineers. Its ability to scale across various environments makes it popular with organizations seeking open-source networking solutions.

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics, Grafana Enterprise Logs, and Grafana Enterprise Traces. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

Engineers on the team focus on optimizing the efficiency and resilience of processing, storing, and querying metrics at large volumes. These services operate at a large scale and performance is key to keeping the offering competitive and running smoothly.

A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They likely are engaged in a larger project with another engineer, as well as mixing in some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. They are also responsible for writing and reviewing PRs and design documents from other engineers in the squad, shepherding automated release rollouts, and participating in the on-call rotation for their systems.

You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action. You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs

  • Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.excerpt: About the roleWe are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy: you’ll take a bug report or change request, investigate it across the codebase, and see it through to production. You’ll balance production support with feature engineering, backed by a supportive team, and we’re embracing agentic development with AI coding agents to ship efficiently without compromising quality.

Key responsibilities

  • Resolve production issues: Triage, diagnose, and resolve issues across distributed microservices, tracing a request from the user-facing API down to the services that talk to external systems.
  • Support incident response: Investigate root causes, apply fixes, add regression tests, and document findings so issues don’t recur
  • Deliver enhancements: Build improvements to existing services, including new versions of certification programs, scorecard and scoring changes, payment adjustments, and integration updates
  • Work within the architecture: Follow established patterns and shared internal libraries in a layered service architecture, from the API gateway through the business logic services down to the adapters that integrate with external systems
  • Maintain integrations: Maintain and extend integrations with external platforms for performance data, CRM, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payment processing, email, and cloud file storage
  • Manage data changes: Write and update database migration scripts and investigate data-related production issues carefully against live data
  • Partner with QA and product: Answer testers’ questions, clarify expected behavior, help reproduce issues, and support verification so fixes and features can be signed off smoothly. Ask product clarifying questions early and confirm intent and edge cases
  • Improve observability and documentation: Contribute structured logging, masking of sensitive data, and clearer production visibility, and take part in code review while keeping documentation current as the platform grows

Required qualifications

  • Proven ability to take ownership of a problem from start to finish, from initial bug report or change request through to a tested, deployed solution
  • Production experience building and maintaining backend services with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Strong experience with NestJS (or a comparable structured backend framework), including modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, and middleware
  • Solid REST/HTTP fundamentals, including service-to-service communication, API contracts, versioning, and error handling
  • Comfortable with relational databases, writing and reviewing PostgreSQL queries, and safe migration practices
  • Experience debugging distributed systems where a single feature spans several services, reading logs and metrics to find root causes rather than symptoms
  • Sound judgment about risk, including the difference between a safe local fix and a change that calls for a rollout plan, particularly for payments, authentication, and live data
  • Experience integrating third-party systems (payment providers, CRMs, ERPs, identity providers) behind a clean internal interface
  • Understanding of authentication patterns: OAuth 2.0, JWT verification, single sign-on (SSO), and service-to-service (machine-to-machine) authentication
  • Comfortable with agentic development, using AI coding agents and tooling to investigate, build, and ship work efficiently while keeping a careful eye on quality
  • Ability to write tests that confirm fixes and prevent regressions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear status updates, incident notes, pull request descriptions, and documentation others can act on

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a platform through the transition from active build to maintenance-and-enhancement mode
  • Familiarity with adapter patterns that isolate external systems from core business logic
  • Experience with webhook-driven integrations, including verifying signatures, scoped service-to-service authorization, and safely handling repeated inbound events
  • Familiarity with containers and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) and services deployed on a major cloud provider such as AWS
  • Experience with observability practices such as structured logging and masking of sensitive data

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

jobs.excerpt: As a Healthguide, you will be supported by clinical teams in your strengthening of the connection between the patient and their primary care physician/medical practice staff, as well as improving the patient’s health and well-being.
jobs.description:
As a Healthguide, you will be supported by clinical teams in your strengthening of the connection between the patient and their primary care physician/medical practice staff, as well as improving the patient’s health and well-being. The Healthguide engages patients and helps them navigate their care, solve their healthcare issues, and improves communication with their medical practice.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Working primarily remotely, Healthguides will be working with the patient’s medical practice staff and Guidehealth’s Case Management team, to manage a targeted population of patients.
  • Functioning independently and being a highly collaborative team member as an extension of medical practice.
  • Assisting the patient in achieving better health outcomes by addressing their questions and concerns, connecting them with the medical practice, partnering in implementing high-impact care plans and closing care gaps, escalating medical issues, and navigating them to the right resources including assisting with referrals to specialty care and community-based organizations (CBOs).
  • Accurately documenting patients’ medical history and medical issues in the electronic health record (EHR).
  • Understanding the referral and prior authorization process.
  • Continuously building a trusting, professional, working relationship with assigned medical practices and within the Guidehealth organization.
  • Implementing and meeting assigned Key Performance Indicators to produce a positive patient health outcome, while decreasing medical spend.
  • Utilize effective communication modalities (calls, texts, portals, emails) to engage and schedule high-risk patients.
  • Appropriately escalating medical issues to the Health Guide Registered Nurse, Primary Care Physician Medical practice or Guidehealth leadership.
  • Following all security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI (Protected Health Information) under Guidehealth’s custodianship as well as Guidehealth Intellectual Properties.
  • Position may require compensated travel as needed (10-15%) to clinical sites in the Atlanta, GA area for patient and provider engagement and conducting retinal eye exams with paid training provided.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE

  • Certified or Registered Medical Assistant OR Certified EMT required with 2 or more years of experience.
  • A love for patient coordination to serve people with complex medical and social needs.
  • Willingness to become proficient in motivational interviewing, critical listening skills and behavioral change management that lead to better patient engagement.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on empathy, patience, professionalism, and respect in all patient, team, and client interactions.
  • Exceptional conversation skills and the ability to precisely document patient interviews leveraging software and in real time.
  • Experience and understanding of medical terminology and the function of a primary care physician practice.
  • Knowledge of the social determinants of health.
  • Demonstrated competency and ability to independently navigate technology using multiple platforms, computer screens, and other technical components (i.e., Electronic Medical Records, care management analytics databases, phone dialing system, Microsoft Office).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word, Excel
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of electronic health records, such as: eClinicalWorks, EPIC, Athena, Cerner. Ability to balance competing priorities while remaining detail oriented and focused.
  • Exceptional written, visual and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to track the progress of multiple tasks while ensuring that tasks are completed.
  • Ability to work independently as part of a patient’s overall care team under supervision of licensed clinical professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work successfully in a remote work environment.
  • Reliable transportation and a valid state driver’s license for occasional travel to provider sites.
  • Adherence to patient confidentiality through use of a provided headset during all conversations in a private home office without distraction.
  • Performance of other duties as assigned.
  • Compliance with all Guidehealth policies and procedures.

The base pay range for this role is between $21-$24 per hour paid bi-weekly

BENEFITS:

While you are hard at work advancing value-based healthcare, we are here to ensure YOU have the care you and your family need and the opportunities for growth and development. Our commitments to you include:

  • Work from Home: Guidehealth is a fully remote company, providing you the flexibility to spend less time commuting and more time focusing on your professional goals and personal needs.

  • Plan for the Future: Our 401(k) plan includes a 3% employer match to your 6% contribution.

  • Learn and Grow: Your professional growth is important to us. Guidehealth offers various resources dedicated to your learning and development to advance your career with us.

All full-time employees of Guidehealth who work 30 hours per week or more are eligible for our comprehensive benefits package. Temporary employees and contractors are not eligible for benefits.

COMPENSATION:

The listed compensation range listed is paid bi-weekly per our standard payroll practices. Final base pay decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors which may include, but are not limited to: skill set, years of relevant experience, education, location, and licensure/certifications.

Diversity, inclusion, and belonging are at the core of Guidehealth’s values. We are an equal opportunity employer. As a remote-first organization handling sensitive healthcare data, Guidehealth verifies candidate identity at multiple stages of the hiring and onboarding to safeguard patient privacy, data security, and compliance requirements.

Guidehealth is a fully remote company. We provide new employees with the necessary equipment to function in their role at no charge to the employee. Employees provide their own internet connection, capable of conducting video calls on camera and connecting to various internal and external systems. The required internet speed is a minimum of 100 mbps download, 10 mbps upload. Please run a speed test here to confirm your internet connection meets these requirements.

At Guidehealth, we value transparency and collaboration as part of our commitment to excellence. As your primary employer, we kindly ask all team members to disclose any secondary employment, regardless of whether it may present a potential conflict of interest.

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients.

Sr. Industry Manager- CPG, HLS/ProServe

Location: USA Remote

Are you a recognized voice within the CPG, HLS/ProServe market who thrives at the intersection of industry leadership, market strategy, and growth? As an Industry Manager, you will act as a market maker, strategist, and growth catalyst—shaping industry vision, identifying near and emerging opportunities, amplifying customer outcomes, and influencing the solutions, investments, and partnerships that define Hitachi Solutions' role in the market and drive immediate and long-term growth.

Role Summary

The Sr. Industry Manager is responsible for driving industry-led growth by translating market challenges into business opportunities enabled through Microsoft Business Applications, Data, AI, and Cloud solutions.

As a strategic industry leader, the Sr. Industry Manager serves as a bridge between customers, Microsoft, and Hitachi Solutions, helping shape market strategy, accelerate commercial opportunities, influence customer transformation agendas, and enable the broader organization to deliver differentiated industry value.

This role combines deep industry expertise, executive engagement, thought leadership, and business acumen to help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes while strengthening Hitachi Solutions' position as a trusted advisor and industry leader.

Key Responsibilities

Industry Strategy & Growth

  • Identify emerging industry trends, challenges, regulatory shifts, and growth opportunities.
  • Translate industry challenges into scalable solutions, sales plays, offerings, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Shape industry-specific growth strategies aligned to Microsoft Business Applications, Data, AI, and Cloud priorities.
  • Influence innovation and investment priorities based on market needs and customer demand.

Executive Engagement & Transformation

  • Engage senior business and technology executives to understand strategic priorities and transformation objectives.
  • Facilitate business and technology discussions focused on growth, efficiency, customer experience, and innovation.
  • Help customers develop business cases and transformation roadmaps that align technology investments to measurable outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor during strategic customer engagements.

Commercial Acceleration

  • Support strategic pursuits and high-value opportunities.
  • Contribute industry expertise to account planning and opportunity development.
  • Help position Hitachi Solutions solutions and services in the context of customer industry priorities.
  • Partner with sales leadership to improve opportunity quality, executive access, and win rates.

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

  • Develop industry-specific perspectives, content, and market insights.
  • Represent Hitachi Solutions at customer events, executive roundtables, conferences, webinars, and partner forums.
  • Support industry-related marketing campaigns and market awareness initiatives.
  • Strengthen Hitachi Solutions' reputation as an industry-focused transformation partner.

Organizational Enablement

  • Enable sales, delivery, product, innovation, and marketing teams through industry expertise and market knowledge.
  • Create repeatable industry assets, frameworks, sales plays, and executive engagement materials.
  • Drive organizational alignment around industry priorities and opportunities.

Industry Expertise

  • 12+ years of industry, consulting, technology, or business transformation experience.
  • Deep understanding of industry operations, market dynamics, business processes, and customer challenges.
  • Ability to identify business issues and translate them into strategic opportunities.

Executive Advisory Skills

  • Experience engaging senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and storytelling capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate business value and executive-level outcomes.

Microsoft, Data & AI Acumen

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Cloud, Business Applications, Data, and AI technologies.
  • Ability to connect technology investments with business objectives and measurable outcomes.

Commercial & Business Acumen

  • Experience supporting business development, strategic pursuits, consulting engagements, or transformation initiatives.
  • Ability to develop business cases, value propositions, and strategic recommendations.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Proven ability to influence across matrixed organizations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to align multiple functions around common objectives.

Why Join Hitachi Solutions?

  • Step into a high-impact role that builds upon a foundation of deep industry expertise.
  • Leverage your reputation and knowledge to drive innovation and transformation for leading organizations.
  • Be part of a globally recognized team committed to excellence, collaboration, and growth.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Base Salary Pay Range*: USD $180,000 – USD $225,000

*The current applicable Base Salary Pay Range for this role is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills relevant to the role, internal equity, alignment with market data, or other law.

Other Compensation / Benefit Overview

In addition to Base Salary, the successful candidate may be eligible to participate in the following plans / programs, upon satisfying all hiring requirements:

  • Annual Sales Incentive Plan
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
  • Life Insurance and Disability Programs
  • Retirement Savings with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Work Arrangements including Remote Work

#REMOTE

Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

Hitachi Solutions is a global Microsoft solutions integrator passionate about developing and delivering industry-focused solutions that support our clients to deliver on their business transformation goals. Our industry focus, expertise, and intellectual property is what truly sets us apart. We have earned, and continue to maintain, a strategic relationship with Microsoft. Recognized for our achievements - teaming with our clients to deliver innovative digital solutions and services - is how we have achieved year after year recognition.

As their trusted advisor, we support our clients to deliver on their strategic business initiatives as they unify, automate, and modernize their data and operations to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance their customer’s experience. Our over 3,000 team members across 14 countries, and our 18 years of 100% focus on Microsoft technologies and business applications, is how we deliver excellence through expert services and industry-focused cloud solutions.

A part of Hitachi, Ltd., our company has a long and rich history of innovation, financial strength, and international presence of one of the world’s largest companies. Since 1910, Hitachi, Ltd. has been a leader in manufacturing innovative products and solutions that support industry and social infrastructure around the globe supported by 303,000 employees in over 100 countries and across 864 companies.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You'll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit—an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company recognized as one of the best big companies to work for, as well as one of the best places to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position works within the Abbott Cancer Diagnostics business.

We're empowering smarter medical and economic decision-making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, diagnostic solutions help clinicians and care teams make informed decisions for patients across a broad range of health conditions, including cancer.

As a Revenue Cycle Coverage and Claims Associate II, you'll support accurate and timely insurance reimbursement by independently resolving complex eligibility, claim, denial, and payment issues. You'll use Epic, payer portals, clearinghouse tools, and other systems to manage escalations, maintain accurate account information, and help move claims toward resolution. Working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. CST.


What You'll Work On

  • Independently verify patient insurance eligibility and coverage, research discrepancies, and update demographics, financial information, and guarantor details.
  • Review, edit, and submit claims and appeals; correct rejected claims from claim scrubbers, clearinghouses, or payers; and provide supporting documentation as needed.
  • Analyze denials, underpayments, unpaid aging claims, and reimbursement issues using federal, state, payer, and internal guidelines to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Manage complex claim escalations, bulk projects, claim edit and follow-up work queues, CRM support, and workflow validation related to new products or process changes.
  • Document actions accurately, maintain HIPAA confidentiality, meet quality and turnaround standards, and partner with internal teams and payers to drive timely claim resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
  • One (1) or more years of experience in a revenue cycle role and three (3) or more years of experience in medical billing, claims, and/or insurance processing.
  • Extensive and current knowledge of government, managed care, and commercial insurance claim submission requirements, reimbursement guidelines, and denial reason codes.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance terminology, and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and keyboarding, with strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving, and quality output.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a changing environment while communicating professionally with payers, clients, and internal teams.
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday during normal business hours aligned to 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. CST
  • Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Related Associate's degree or medical billing certification.
  • Five (5) or more years of experience in the medical or insurance billing field.
  • Experience with Epic or another electronic health record (EHR) application.
