jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.excerpt: Hi 👋 I'm Freddie, CFO at Pinpoint.  We build and sell software that helps in house recruitment teams attract, hire and onboard the right people.
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Freddie, CFO at Pinpoint.

We build and sell software that helps in house recruitment teams attract, hire and onboard the right people. We're a team of about 100 across the UK and the US, with a mature product, strong product market fit and happy customers.

Our data platform already does a lot. It runs on Google Cloud Platform and feeds our internal tooling and reporting, as well as a number of customer facing resources such as RecTrends, our public benchmarking site. What we're missing is someone who owns where it goes next. Right now that falls on me and Luke, our Director of RevOps, which is why we're hiring a Head of Data.

You'll work right across the business: with product and engineering on the data we capture, with our AI engineering team on what we build on top of it, and with Customer Success, Sales and Marketing on the data they rely on every day. You'll set the data strategy everyone works from.

You'll also work closely with Tom, our CEO, on a customer facing data initiative we haven't launched yet. We'll tell you more when we talk.

The fine print
  • UK based and fully remote, working UK hours, with team meetups in London every quarter. Our HQ is in Jersey.
  • You report to me and you're our first data leader. There's no team under you, and that's by design: you set the direction and do the building yourself.
  • This isn't a pipeline maintenance role with a bigger title, but the pipeline is still yours: month end and our other financial processes can't go down.
  • A big part of the job is prioritising: questioning requests, weighing their value, and knowing when something is a nice to have.
  • Our values actually matter here. We hire people who reflect them in how they work, collaborate, and make decisions.

What you'll do

  • Set the data strategy and the guidelines for how everyone builds with and uses our data, so we all work from the same trusted sources rather than our own versions, and keep it current as priorities shift.
  • Be the person senior leadership turns to when an idea needs data: shape it, test its value, and deliver the version that matters.
  • Own the data behind our new initiative with Tom, starting with what's missing to build the version customers will see, and get its outputs into our customer intelligence platform (a tool we built in house to understand our customers).
  • Work alongside our product managers, not for them: give them the tooling to pull the product usage data they need themselves, and get involved early in product work so the right data is captured.
  • Give Customer Success, Sales and Marketing clear, simple views that tell them what matters, like which customers are at risk and where there's room to grow.
  • Own our customer intelligence platform end to end, including the roadmap, and RecTrends, our public benchmarking site.
  • Own the pipeline from source to insight, with the monitoring and data dictionary that let people trust what they find, and data that's clean and documented enough for our AI tools to use safely.
  • Over time, build machine learning benchmarks from our customer data with our AI engineering team.

What you'll bring

  • Ownership of data strategy or a whole data function at a fast growing startup or scale up, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • A data stack you designed and built yourself in a lean team
  • Expert SQL and data modelling (Dataform or dbt), with strong Python and code managed properly in version control
  • Deep hands on time with BigQuery or a similar cloud warehouse (Snowflake works too) and modern ELT, and the judgement to pick tools on merit, cost and maintainability
  • A track record of data products people actually use, including non technical teams, not just dashboards
  • Experience turning raw product usage data into metrics people act on
  • Commercial judgement that connects data work to revenue, retention and strategy
  • Clear explanations for senior leaders and non technical teams, in writing and in the room
  • Daily use of LLMs and agentic tools, backed by the engineering depth and strong opinions to know when they're wrong, and how to make data safe and reliable for them

Bonus, if you have
  • Practical ML or statistical modelling on real business problems, such as benchmarking, scoring or forecasting
  • Event streaming, such as Pub/Sub or Kafka
  • Vertex AI or LLM pipelines
  • Fivetran, Hightouch, Segment or PostHog

You may not enjoy this role if
  • You want a team underneath you. There isn't one, so defining the strategy and then delivering it yourself has to excite you.
  • You'd rather not work closely with non technical people to deliver and enable internal data products.
  • You want an unlimited budget. We need to be smart about how we approach projects, so each one delivers enough value to justify the cost.

What we offer

We want Pinpoint to be the best place you've ever worked, somewhere you feel valued, supported and excited to grow. Here's what you get:
  • Comprehensive healthcare: excellent medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Unlimited holidays: take the time you need to rest and recharge
  • Mental health support: unlimited, immediate access to professional counselling via Spill
  • Retirement contributions: 401k or pension contributions depending on your location
  • Remote first: work where you're most productive, with flexibility and trust as the default
  • Equity with real upside: share in the long term value you help create
  • Fully paid parental leave: up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents
  • Learning budget: annual funds for courses, books or anything that supports your growth
A detailed overview of our benefits is here.

What you're wondering

  • Who will I work with? Me, Luke, our Director of RevOps, and Tom, our CEO, on the new initiative. You'll also work closely with Dom, our CTO, and the engineering team, who build the products that produce much of our data, plus our product managers and the Customer Success, Sales and Marketing teams who use it.
  • What tools will I use? GCP (BigQuery, Dataform, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Vertex AI), Fivetran (plus other replication on the product side), Hightouch, HubSpot, GitHub, Hex and Vercel. It's a good foundation, not a fixed one: we expect you to challenge it.
  • What does success look like? In your first 90 days, you'll own all of our data infrastructure and maintenance, and work out what data we're missing for the new initiative. By the end of year one, everyone gets the data they need quickly from the same trusted sources and knows where to find it, product managers pull usage data themselves, the new initiative has full coverage of the metrics it needs, Tom and the leadership team see you as a proper strategic partner on data, and engineering respects you.
  • What's the salary? We'll talk about pay openly in your first conversation with Mike, our VP of Talent.

jobs.excerpt: About usClipt is a fast-growing video editor staffing and creative services agency.
jobs.description:
About us

Clipt is a fast-growing video editor staffing and creative services agency. We place skilled video editors with brands and creators, and we produce short-form and long-form video for some of the biggest consumer brands in the world.

We're also the team behind Smart Nonsense, a YouTube channel with 3.5 million subscribers built on one mission: make learning fun.

We work with more than 100 clients today, and that number keeps growing. We're a small, hands-on team that moves quickly, cares about craft, and treats each other (and our clients) well.

The role

We're hiring our first dedicated Head of Finance to own invoicing, accounting, and collections for the business. You'll be the person who keeps our numbers accurate, our invoices out the door on time, and our cash coming in.

This is a full-time, remote role reporting directly to leadership. Day one, the focus is execution: getting invoices right, closing the books each month, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks. Over time, we want this person to grow with us into a true finance leader who helps with budgeting, forecasting, pricing, and planning.

You don't need to have done all of that before. We care most that you're organized, detail-oriented, responsive, and eager to take on more as the company grows.

How the role grows:

  1. First 3 months: Learn our clients, billing setups, and tools. Take full ownership of monthly invoicing and accounts receivable.
  2. First 6 months: Run a clean, on-time monthly close. Build simple, reliable processes and reporting that the team can count on.
  3. First year and beyond: Step into higher-level work like cash flow forecasting, budgeting, client profitability, and financial planning alongside leadership.

What you'll do

Invoicing and billing

  • Prepare and send a high volume of monthly invoices across 100+ clients, each with its own billing setup (retainers, hourly, per-project, and blended arrangements).
  • Keep a clear, up-to-date record of each client's billing terms, rates, and any special situations.
  • Catch errors before invoices go out, and resolve billing questions quickly when they come up.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Track every outstanding invoice and know where each one stands.
  • Partner with our Client Success team to follow up on late payments and collect what's owed, professionally and persistently.
  • Share a regular snapshot of what's been billed, what's been paid, and what's overdue.

Accounting and monthly close

  • Help close the books each month, accurately and on schedule.
  • Categorize transactions, reconcile bank and payment accounts, and keep our records clean.
  • Work with our outside accountant or bookkeeper on taxes, year-end, and anything else they need.

Accounts payable and payroll support

  • Help manage payments to our editors, contractors, and vendors so everyone is paid correctly and on time.

Keeping us organized

  • Build and improve simple processes, checklists, and templates that make our finances easier to run.
  • Be the go-to person for finance questions across the team, and respond quickly.
  • Spot problems early and flag them before they become bigger issues.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, billing, or finance, ideally supporting a US-based company.
  • Hands-on experience with invoicing and accounts receivable at real volume.
  • Comfort with accounting software (QuickBooks Online, Xero, or similar) and strong spreadsheet skills (Excel or Google Sheets).
  • Exceptional attention to detail. You double-check your work and notice when numbers don't add up.
  • Highly organized, with a system for keeping track of many moving pieces at once.
  • Responsive and reliable. When someone on the team asks a question, they hear back from you quickly.
  • Clear, professional written and spoken English, including polite but firm communication about overdue payments.
  • Able to work overlapping hours with our US team (Central Time).

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in accounting or finance, or progress toward a CPA.
  • Experience at an agency, staffing firm, or services business with many clients on different billing terms.
  • Familiarity with Stripe
  • Experience building financial reports or dashboards, or an interest in learning forecasting and budgeting.

Working with us

  • Location: Remote, with flexibility to join ad-hoc occasional meetings overlapping with US time zone
  • Schedule: Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Compensation: Competitive and based on experience, with room to grow as the role expands.
  • Start date: ASAP

You'll be joining at an exciting point. You'll have real ownership from day one, direct access to leadership, and a clear path to grow into a senior finance role as we scale.

How to apply

Send your resume and a short note about a time your organization or attention to detail saved the day. To show us you read this far, include the word "reconciled" in your subject line.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Croatia Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-65,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

jobs.excerpt: Partnership Development Lead CaaS, DACH Charging-as-a-Service (CaaS) Location: Germany (scope: Germany, Switzerland, Austria) About ABB E-mobility ABB E-mobility is a global leader in electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure and services, delivering high-performance charging solutions to customers across Europe, North America and beyond.
jobs.description:
Partnership Development Lead CaaS, DACH

Charging-as-a-Service (CaaS)

Location: Germany (scope: Germany, Switzerland, Austria)

About ABB E-mobility

ABB E-mobility is a global leader in electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure and services, delivering high-performance charging solutions to customers across Europe, North America and beyond.

Within ABB E-mobility, we are building a new business line focused on an end-to-end managed offering that brings together hardware, software and operational excellence into a unified service model. In this role you own how that offering reaches the market in Germany, Switzerland and Austria.

About Charging-as-a-Service

Through our Charging-as-a-Service (CaaS) business, we are moving up the stack beyond hardware to enable large enterprises to own and operate branded EV fast charging networks without the hassle.

CaaS is not a traditional CPO model.

We provide supermarket and discount chains, fuel and convenience retailers, QSR brands and large landowners with a fully integrated, white-label platform that combines:

  • ABB’s industry-leading DC charging hardware

  • Asset management with contractual uptime guarantees

  • End-to-end business operations

  • Frontend driver services

Our partners retain control of their brand, pricing and customer relationship while we handle the technical and operational complexity.

Our ambition in DACH is to make CaaS the preferred charging platform partner for enterprise portfolios across Germany, Switzerland and Austria.

Role summary

The Partnership Development Lead, DACH owns CaaS revenue and order intake in Germany, Switzerland and Austria. You own the pipeline, the number and the partner relationships behind it.

This is a founding commercial role. You will be our first CaaS hire in the region, taking the business from the first deals and conversations to a portfolio of multi-site partners across three countries. You personally hunt, close and lead the enterprise partnerships that define our position in the market.

You will report to the Global Head of Charging-as-a-Service and work day to day with our European operations, strategy and product teams. Your job is to win the partners that put CaaS on the map in your region.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the CaaS revenue and order intake target for DACH and the account plan to deliver it

  • Build and own the pipeline of multi-site portfolio opportunities across supermarket and discount chains, fuel and convenience retailers, QSR operators, hotel chains, retail park owners and large landowners in Germany, Switzerland and Austria

  • Lead engagement with the priority enterprise accounts in the region at board and C-suite level, from first conversation to signed contract

  • Structure and negotiate long-term CaaS agreements together with our central teams

  • Build a partnership ecosystem across site design, engineering, civil works, electrical installation so projects get delivered on time

  • Represent ABB E-mobility and CaaS at industry events in the region

  • Stay the commercial owner of signed partners as our operations team takes over delivery and day-to-day service

  • Bring DACH market and regulatory requirements into the CaaS product and technology roadmap

Ideal candidate profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys winning new business and building something from the ground up. You likely bring:

  • 7+ years in consulting or business development

  • Expertise selling technical products or solutions to enterprise customers

  • Owner mentality. Hands-on and self-starting, willing to roll up the sleeves to get a result

  • Comfort operating with high autonomy inside a global corporation, and the judgment to know when to draw on the ABB organization and when to move independently

  • Fluent German and English

  • Familiarity with EV infrastructure, charging networks or grid connection processes in the region is a plus

How we operate

  • High velocity. We are a new business line inside ABB E-mobility with the mandate to decide closer to the customer and move faster than a corporate function can.

  • Full-stack ownership. We sell hardware, software, operations and driver experience as one product. Everyone here understands the whole stack.

  • Impact over hierarchy. Small team, wide scope. No task is above or beneath anyone.

  • Backed by ABB. Global hardware, an industrial balance sheet and the credibility that opens enterprise doors.

Location

Germany, with scope across Germany, Switzerland and Austria. Remote-first, with regular travel to partner and customer sites, ABB E-mobility locations in the region, and our European office.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Ecosystem Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own the technology, processes, and operational infrastructure behind our channel, distribution, original equipment manufacturer (OEM), global systems integrator (GSI), and managed service provider (MSP) partnerships. You'll shape how our partners go to market, serving as the primary process owner for deal registration, partner programs, partner quote-to-cash, and partner attribution. You'll combine operational strategy with hands-on execution, using artificial intelligence (AI) to automate workflows and help ecosystem operations scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and govern end-to-end partner processes, including deal and referral registration, service attach, two-tier distribution, rules of engagement, and quote-to-cash. Partner with Deal Desk and Billing on resale, distribution, OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction workflows, and resolve complex registration, quoting, and billing escalations.
  • Own operational execution of partner tiering, onboarding, certification compliance, not-for-resale (NFR) licenses, rebates, and incentives, including eligibility tracking, approval routing, and payments.
  • Own and administer the partner technology ecosystem, including Impartner partner relationship management (PRM), Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) partner objects, deal registration, and partner portals. Maintain system health and data integrity, and co-manage vendor roadmaps, renewals, and service-level accountability.
  • Partner with Revenue Technologies and Systems to maintain integrations across partner platforms, Salesforce, enterprise resource planning (ERP), quoting, billing, and financial systems, including partner attribution and compensation data flows. Lead prioritization and user acceptance testing (UAT) for implementations, migrations, and platform enhancements with IT and Enterprise Applications.
  • Own the ecosystem data model and work toward one standard partner attribution record across the customer lifecycle. Serve as a resource for Ecosystem Sales, partners, and internal teams on attribution, territory, and compensation-impacting data, and maintain reporting and dashboards as a single source of truth for partner pipeline, registration activity, and program performance.
  • Lead ecosystem month-end close with Deal Desk, Compensation, Accounts Receivable, and Finance, covering opportunity corrections, partner splits, territory review, and reconciliation.
  • Identify, build, and deploy AI agents to automate workflows such as deal registration routing, NFR provisioning, partner data quality checks, and reporting. Evaluate processes for opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten cycle times.
  • Maintain the authoritative ecosystem process map, runbooks, and training materials. Support tool configuration, testing, and end-user training. Own channel price files and partner quoting for product launches and stock keeping unit (SKU) changes. Coordinate improvements with operational peers, IT, Finance, Product, and Legal through GitLab Work Items.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in business-to-business software-as-a-service channel or partner operations, with direct ownership of ecosystem workflows and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Impartner or an equivalent PRM platform, including deal registration and partner portal administration.

Guest Experience is responsible for Search and Discovery, Merchandising, and end-to-end online software experience worldwide from top-of-funnel discovery through post-booking engagement. We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Guest Data Science team. This tech lead will be at the core of using AI and casual inference to understand user behavior in our app, detect underlying intent, and to build data products needed to provide a compelling and personalized experience of our app. We build products that help guests find the inventory most relevant to them in our marketplace.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Staff Data Scientist, you will lead innovation efforts to build methodologies to identify and evaluate the preferences important to every guest, at every step of their online discovery funnel. You will be instrumental in shaping our data strategy to drive guest conversion and regular engagement with the Airbnb platform across our Homes, Experiences and Services business verticals.

This role emphasizes technical excellence and driving business impact with cutting-edge science. Your role will involve close collaboration with Product to identify in-product optimizations and shape UX design architecture to path how guests navigate from surface-to-surface in our app.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate to be a domain expert with granular user behavior and sequence datasets in a marketplace setting. You will hold a high bar for our customer experience and balance a passion for AI with a strong desire to accurately understand user behavior and business success. Your efforts towards personalized content discovery will help make Airbnb feel tailored for you, maintaining a dialogue with our guests to deeply understand their preferences and reflect that understanding back to them, enabling every guest to easily discover the travel they will love.

  • Learn: Develop deep understanding of how guests navigate and re-engage with our app via analysis, research, and by leveraging granular user action and sequence datasets.
  • Partner: With product and engineering, drive technical frameworks and science leadership to explore innovative paradigms for detecting revealed preferences and quantifying online frictions.
  • Build: Write code for prototypes to detect and quantify taxonomy of guest preferences via iterative development of data frameworks, models and artefacts derived from AI toolkits
  • Evaluate: Assess assumptions and efficacy of derived guest preferences via measurement and validating hypotheses linked to online guest action and engagement. Setup experiments and data feedback loops to own a high bar over continuous impact.
  • Influence: Regularly present findings and recommendations to leadership audiences to inform strategy and cross-functional deliverables.
  • If you’re passionate about going deep into personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you!

  • Preferred domain experience in search, UX discovery, personalized evidence systems

  • Strong in communication with XFN partners in product, engineering, and design to enable data-driven product development with a focus on the user experience.
  • Expert in at least one programming language for data analysis (Python or R) with familiarity in SQL. Comfort with developing proof-of-concept prototypes. Passionate about AI and possessing a learner’s mindset towards LLMs and dynamic systems.
  • Proven ability to succeed in both collaborative and independent work environments

jobs.description:
Job Description:

About the Role

The Groove is building out a formal finance and accounting function to match its growth — moving from a founder-run, FreshBooks-era setup to a clean, accrual-basis close on Workday. We're hiring a Staff Accountant to be the hands-on, day-to-day executor of that build-out: reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR support, and the general ledger discipline that lets the rest of the finance team focus on policy and higher-level review rather than data entry. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help stand up a finance function from the inside, working directly with the CFO and an experienced controller consultant.


What You'll Do

  • Perform monthly and quarterly bank reconciliations in Workday, including clearing out a backlog of unapplied deposits and cash.
  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts on an accrual basis each quarter, researching and correcting unnatural or stale balances.
  • Support the transition to accrual-basis accounting: prepaid amortization, depreciation, accrual entries for payroll/PTO/bonus/commission, and other standard month-end adjustments, under the Controller Consultant's direction.
  • Assist with accounts payable: invoice coding, cost-center/worktag completion, and 1099 vendor tracking alongside the AP/payroll lead.
  • Assist with accounts receivable: cash application, unapplied payment research, and supporting a weekly reconciliation process for time-and-billing data.
  • Support payroll-related reconciliations, including matching payroll journal entries to ADP settlement detail and reviewing benefits deductions for accuracy.
  • Help build and maintain a documented monthly close checklist as the function matures.
  • Take on increasing responsibility for recurring, process-driven accounting work as Workday automation (bank-rec, AP workflow, revenue-recognition) comes online, freeing up senior team members for review and exception-handling rather than data entry.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.
  • 3–5 years of general ledger / staff accounting experience: journal entries, account reconciliations, AP/AR, and month-end close support.
  • Solid working knowledge of GAAP and double-entry accounting fundamentals.
  • Comfort with Excel for reconciliation and analysis work (lookups, pivot tables).
  • Workday Financials experience is a strong plus — this role will work inside Workday daily, including during an active configuration and clean-up project.
  • High attention to detail and comfort working through unresolved or messy data to find the right answer, rather than needing a fully built-out process to follow.
  • Self-starter who's comfortable in a lean, fast-moving environment — this is our first dedicated staff accounting hire, so some ambiguity comes with the territory.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a professional services or consulting business (time-and-billing, project-based revenue).
  • Prior exposure to a system conversion or ERP implementation.

Interest in growing into a senior accountant or assistant controller role as the function matures.

EEO Policy:

The Groove is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetics, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran or marital status.

Ready to embark on an exhilarating journey of innovation and collaboration? Apply nowand be part of our exciting team at The Groove!

jobs.description:
Zappi is looking for a senior advertising effectiveness and creative development expert to help strengthen our authority, differentiation, and commercial success in the advertising research and creative effectiveness space.

This person will serve as both:

  • A strategic, cross-functional SME and connective layer internally
We are looking for an experienced advertising and marketing professional with a strong understanding of creative development and advertising program building. The ideal candidate will bring a marketing-led perspective, with experience working in/with brands, agencies or advertising platforms, and understand how data and technology can be leveraged to inform better advertising decisions.

While an understanding of consumer insights and advertising effectiveness is valuable, this is not primarily an insights or research methodology role.
You should be credible with senior Marketing, Brand, Media, Creative, Commercial, Strategy and Insights leaders, and able to connect a practical understanding of advertising with a modern, scalable approach to advertising research and creative effectiveness.

What you'll do:

Serve as an industry expert
  • Bring strong expertise in advertising, marketing strategy, creative development, campaign planning and advertising programmes, with an understanding of how brands and agencies develop effective advertising.
  • Act as a senior subject matter expert on creative development, advertising effectiveness, campaign performance and the role of data and technology in informing creative decisions.
  • Understand how large enterprise organisations operate, including process, politics, agency dynamics, decision-making, budget pressures, stakeholder complexity, and media and creative timelines.
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in advertising effectiveness, AI-generated creative, synthetic respondents, creative volume, digital and social testing, predictive models, and connected learning systems.
  • Function as a trusted internal advisor across the organisation.


Help drive cross-functional GTM readiness

  • Help Product Marketing build messaging, frameworks, demos, POVs, enablement, competitive guidance, and customer-facing materials when expertise-level knowledge is needed.
  • Support enterprise opportunities as a strategic expert and advisor, speaking directly to customers and prospects when senior advertising expertise is needed.
  • Clarify where Zappi’s advertising solutions fit within the creative development lifecycle, from early creative exploration through evaluation, optimisation and campaign learning.
  • Own the competitive intelligence programme for advertising research and creative effectiveness, translating market, competitor, customer, and industry shifts into internal guidance and external-facing content.

Build external credibility

  • Develop a visible external voice in the advertising effectiveness and creative development space.
  • Create thought leadership on the future of advertising research, better creative decision-making at scale, AI in creative development, synthetic methods in ad testing, and connected creative learning.

  • Serve as a second voice outside of Product to help ensure product direction aligns with real-world customer workflows, buyer expectations, and unmet needs.

What success looks like

  • Zappi has a stronger, clearer, and more differentiated point of view in advertising effectiveness, creative development, and modern creative decisioning.
  • GTM teams are more confident and effective in advertising conversations, with stronger discovery, sharper positioning, and better objection handling.
  • Zappi’s advertising offerings are easier for Sales and Account teams to position as a strategic growth opportunity, not simply a set of point solutions or individual ad tests.
  • Enterprise buyers increasingly view Zappi as a strategic partner for advertising effectiveness, creative development, and connected campaign learning.
  • Product and GTM strategy are more closely aligned to customer realities, creative development workflows, competitive dynamics, and emerging market needs.
  • Zappi builds greater external authority through thought leadership, customer education, industry participation, and expert-led advertising narratives.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, creative development, brand strategy, campaign strategy or advertising effectiveness, ideally gained within an agency, advertising platform, ad tech business or in-house brand or marketing team.
  • A strong understanding of how advertising is developed and how creative development and advertising programmes support broader marketing objectives.
  • Experience working with brands, agencies, advertising platforms or marketing teams, with an understanding of their priorities, workflows and challenges.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate, Banking & Lending to bring go-to-market plans to life across Sezzle’s growing set of financial products, both live and upcoming. The Head of Product Marketing owns strategy and go-to-market for these products. You’ll own execution: turning those plans into shipped tests, campaigns, and lifecycle messaging, and reporting back what the data says.

This role is well-suited for someone who loves getting things built and out the door, is energized by data, and wants to learn how product marketing strategy is made by working right next to it. Priorities follow company goals and key performance metrics, so you’ll spend more time on some products than others as launches and opportunities shift.

The salary range for this role is $2,500 - $3,333 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Testing & Optimization

  • Turn insights about where users drop off in product journeys into experiments that improve the experience
  • Build and run tests in whatever form they take, from in-app copy and design changes to targeted email and push campaigns, working with product managers and designers
  • Share results clearly and quickly, and flag anything that suggests we should change course
  • Treat everything as a test: design for learning, monitor results, and iterate based on what the data tells you

Research & Insights

  • Run user research end to end once the questions are set: build the survey or study, send it to the right group of users, analyze the results, and write them up
  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities
  • Use AI tools to speed up analysis and sharpen the insights you bring back

Go-to-Market Execution

  • Turn launch and marketing plans into clear project timelines with owners and dates
  • Partner with our marketing communications team to bring email, push, and in-app campaigns to life
  • Guide marketing materials through compliance and legal review in a regulated industry
  • Coordinate everything needed to get new products ready for launch

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work closely with product managers, marketing communications, design, compliance, and data teams on every product you touch
  • Share regular progress updates with the team and cross-functional partners
  • Document research findings and test results, and keep team strategy documents up to date
  • Adapt quickly as priorities and launch timing shift

Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Lifecycle Marketing, Consumer Research, or a related field
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with funnel data, behavioral data, and survey results, and using AI to evaluate them
  • Highly organized and execution-minded, with a track record of getting work shipped on time across multiple stakeholders
  • Clear, concise written communicator in English, able to turn complex results into a sharp readout
  • Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you’re already using them regularly

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, banking, lending, payments, or credit products
  • Experience getting marketing copy through compliance or legal review in a regulated industry
  • Experience running A/B tests or in-product experiments
  • Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
  • Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
  • Familiarity with user research methodologies

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Head of Marketing

OneAvant | Remote (EMEA)

About OneAvant

OneAvant is a Malta-based, AI-powered business management platform helping retail businesses, hotels, restaurants, and factories run smarter operations. From automated purchase orders to AI-driven insights, OneAvant gives operators the full picture of their business, tailored to the industry they work in.

Our platform is built around four core products, each solving a different piece of the operations puzzle:

Hospitality Guest Management: automated check-in, keyless rooms, unified housekeeping, and concierge-level service requests that make every guest feel remembered

ERP – Manufacturing: production automation and full traceability, from raw material to finished product, with automated ordering and CRM built in

Business Intelligence: real-time data aggregated across platforms, with an AI query builder that lets anyone ask questions and get instant answers

Retail & Sales: live inventory tracking, automated purchasing and deliveries, and seamless e-commerce integration

Today, OneAvant powers businesses across Europe and beyond, giving them the confidence to move faster and grow without operational blind spots. As we scale, we're looking for people who want to help more businesses trade the chaos of disconnected tools for one platform that just works.

About the Role

As our Head of Marketing, you'll be the bridge between Product, Sales, and Partnerships, translating what we build into why it wins in the market, reporting directly to the CEO. That includes growing our distribution network, finding new partners across our product lines and giving each one the positioning, pricing guidance, and materials they need to start selling with confidence You'll own GTM strategy end to end, shape our competitive positioning, and turn complex product capabilities into stories that make buyers lean in, across both direct sales and channel partnerships

Senior Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales (East Coast)
Sales Engineering | United States (Remote)

You'll be the technical lead in Alkira's largest enterprise deals — in the room with network architects and infrastructure directors, owning the technical side of the deal from first conversation through POC to close.

Location: Remote, US. Candidates should reside in East Coast, USA

Travel: approximately 25%, including regional air travel as needed. Please discuss the specifics for this position with the recruiter.

What you'll do

  • Present and demo the Alkira platform to technical decision makers, from engineer to CIO
  • Clearly articulate the Alkira value proposition and have a sound understanding of market, industry and competitive landscape
  • Partner with Alkira Account Managers to understand customer requirements and pain points. Assist with any technical asks from customers and help respond to RFP/RFIs
  • Scope, run and win Proof of Concepts end to end
  • Assist customers with design and deployment based on best practices
  • Work with Alkira Product Management team to provide feedback on upcoming features from the customer's lens

What you need

  • 8+ years in a customer-facing pre-sales engineering role — Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Solutions Architect — ideally at a networking or security vendor, cloud provider, channel partner, or consultancy
  • Strong networking fundamentals – Everything below builds on this, and it is not negotiable
  • Deep expertise in routing protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, and static routing, with hands-on experience in route policy design, route redistribution, filtering, and traffic engineering
  • Understanding of network virtualization and software-defined networking, including VRFs, multi-tenant network architectures, SD-WAN, and the encapsulation protocols used to build overlays at scale (GRE, VXLAN, GENEVE and similar)
  • Hands-on experience with IPsec VPNs, encryption standards, NAT, and secure connectivity architectures
  • Good understanding of how enterprises extend cloud connectivity using a variety of Networking Technologies (i.e. Cloud On-Ramps, SD-WAN and IPsec)
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise network design and deployment experience across data center, WAN and hybrid/multi-cloud
  • A deep understanding of network services — DNS, DHCP, load balancing, traffic inspection and similar
  • The ability to troubleshoot live, in front of a customer, across routing, security and cloud domains
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort presenting and demoing to customers in person – In this role you are the technical credibility of the company

Strongly preferred

  • Understanding of cloud networking constructs across AWS, Azure, and GCP (e.g., VPCs/VNets, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, Cloud Router, peering, and hybrid connectivity such as Direct Connect and ExpressRoute)
  • Network security expertise, including firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point), firewall policy design, service insertion/chaining, and Zero Trust principles
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer, PCNSE)

  • BA/BS/MS in a technical field

Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world's largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you'll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We’re hiring an Associate SEO and AEO Manager to build the foundation of YipitData’s discoverability and organic growth engine.

Buyers increasingly find answers through search engines and AI assistants before they ever talk to a vendor. YipitData sits on a limitless engine of proprietary insight, and this role is about pointing that engine at the market so prospects find us on their own, engage with our content, and raise their hands to talk to us. You’ll own our SEO and AEO strategy for the YipitData organization end to end: mapping the questions our buyers ask across their journey, turning that map into a content roadmap designed to be the definitive answer, and building the systems that track whether it’s working. You’ll partner closely with the YipitAgent team to produce and verify content at scale, and with marketing, product, and sales to connect organic traffic to pipeline.

This is a builder’s role. You’ll bring bleeding-edge, AI-informed tactics to a program you get to shape from the ground up, with the data, tooling, and support to move quickly.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Non-branded organic sessions and AI-sourced sessions grow quarter over quarter.
  • YipitData is cited as a source in AI-generated answers for the questions our buyers ask.
  • Content ships at a consistent, measurable velocity and gets refreshed when performance slips.
  • Organic becomes a reliable, attributable source of conversions and pipeline.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Associate SEO and AEO Manager You Will:

  • Own YipitData’s overall SEO and AEO strategy, from technical foundations and on-page optimization to how our content gets surfaced and cited in AI answer engines.
  • Own keyword, query, and question mapping across the full buyer journey, identifying where prospects are searching, what they’re asking, and where we can be the definitive answer.
  • Translate that mapping into a prioritized content roadmap and detailed article briefs, including structure, target queries, entities, and the proof points that make a piece authoritative.
  • Coordinate with the YipitAgent team on content production, and own verification and quality review of content before it goes live.
  • Build and maintain our tracking and reporting system for content velocity, non-branded organic sessions, AI-sourced sessions and visibility, AI answer citation share, organic conversion rate, and organic-sourced pipeline.
  • Continuously iterate on content performance, including a disciplined refresh program that updates, consolidates, or retires pages based on data.
  • Build and manage our third-party presence on platforms that influence both human buyers and AI models, such as Reddit, Quora, Crunchbase, G2, and industry directories.
  • Work with PR on our citation strategy so our proprietary data becomes the source that publishers, analysts, and AI systems reference.
  • Implement structured data, schema, internal linking, and technical SEO best practices in partnership with web and engineering stakeholders.
  • Run a steady cadence of experiments on titles, formats, structure, and distribution.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

jobs.title: Senior Content Marketer, Campaigns/Enterprise
jobs.excerpt: About AnimalzAnimalz is a content marketing agency that partners with B2B SaaS companies, venture capital firms, and other tech organizations to drive long-term, sustainable growth through high-quality content.
jobs.description:
About Animalz

Animalz is a content marketing agency that partners with B2B SaaS companies, venture capital firms, and other tech organizations to drive long-term, sustainable growth through high-quality content.

Our fully remote team of experienced content marketers delivers strategies and content tailored to each customer's goals and context. We pride ourselves on our deep interest and understanding of software products and audiences, our commitment to thought leadership, and our relentless pursuit of mastering our craft.

Our customers include industry leaders like Amplitude, Ramp, and Wistia, as well as high-growth early-stage startups.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Content Marketer: an exceptional writer with the editorial judgment to own content quality for the customers they serve.

This is a writing-first role. About 70% of your time will be spent researching and writing content yourself—work that calls for real research, original thinking, and craft.

On the Enterprise & Campaigns team, that writing spans various formats: thought leadership that gives leaders a point of view worth repeating, along with the blog posts, guides, landing pages, and email sequences that carry a campaign from first touch to conversion. You'll write for some of our largest customers, whose audiences (and internal reviewers) expect work that holds up under scrutiny.

The rest of your time goes to making sure everything else your accounts publish is just as good as what you write. You'll manage the freelance writers who contribute to your accounts, keep the content calendar on track, review every piece before it reaches the customer, and ensure customer feedback is acted on and remembered.

You won't do any of this alone. Every account is served by a small team, and you'll work alongside teammates who own the overall strategy and the customer relationship. Your ownership is the content itself: writing much of it, and standing behind all of it.

What You'll Do

  • Write high-quality content (blog posts, guides, landing pages, and more) that's genuinely worth reading, grounded in a real understanding of each customer's product and audience
  • Write across the full range of campaign formats: thought leadership, blog posts, guides, landing pages, and email nurtures
  • Move between registers with ease, from a long-form piece in an executive's voice to tight conversion copy on a landing page
  • Review every piece your accounts deliver before it reaches the customer, whether you wrote it, a freelancer wrote it, or it started as an AI-assisted draft. (Note: we have separate Editors who edit pieces in production for feedback. Your role is the final review)
  • Turn a campaign plan into a coordinated set of assets that tell one story
  • Help manage the freelance writers on your accounts, write briefs they can succeed with, and maintain customer brand guides and other assets for reference.
  • Work smoothly with larger marketing teams, keeping quality and momentum through multiple reviewers and longer approval cycles
  • Act on customer feedback quickly and thoroughly, and keep track of it, so a customer never has to give the same note twice
  • Communicate directly with customers about deliverables, timelines, and revisions, and join customer calls as a trusted voice on the work
  • Contribute to performance reporting, helping show customers what shipped, how it's performing, and what we're learning
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully, taking advantage of them where they genuinely help, and applying your own judgment and craft where they don't
  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing and internal initiatives, learning from teammates and sharing what you know

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6 years of experience in content marketing, with at least 2 of those years in B2B SaaS. Agency experience can be a plus
  • Exceptional writing ability: You're first and foremost a writer. You produce publication-ready content with minimal revisions, writing with clarity, precision, and strategic insight, and you adapt your voice to different brands while keeping your standards high
  • Campaign thinking: You see how individual pieces of content connect into a larger arc, and you write each one with its place in that arc in mind
  • Range as a writer: You're as comfortable with in-depth thought leadership as with concise, conversion-focused copy, and you can switch between them without losing quality
  • Strong editorial judgment: You can read someone else's draft, explain clearly why it does or doesn't work. You catch quality problems before customers do
  • Experience working with other writers: You've briefed, edited, or managed freelancers or teammates
  • Customer communication skills: You're clear, responsive, and trustworthy with customers, and you build confidence through the quality and reliability of your work
  • Experience with larger customers: You've worked with enterprise companies or bigger marketing teams, and you handle multiple stakeholders and review rounds with patience and grace
  • Strong organizational skills: You can manage multiple accounts, contributors, and deadlines at once without letting quality or dates slip
  • AI fluency: You use AI tools to support your workflow responsibly and effectively, you can edit AI-assisted drafts to publication quality, and you stay current on emerging best practices
  • Technical curiosity: You genuinely enjoy learning how software products and businesses work so you can write about them with authority
  • Ownership and adaptability: You take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and raise problems early, while they're still easy to solve

Room to Grow

Senior Content Marketers at Animalz have real room to grow. You'll start by taking ownership of content for a small set of customers, then take on bigger and more complex accounts as you're ready. From there, many people grow into leading content strategy or managing customer relationships—first alongside a senior teammate, then independently—which is the path to our Associate Head of Content role. Others go deep instead: our most experienced Senior Content Marketers lead content for our most demanding customers and mentor newer teammates, and that's a career here in its own right.

Whichever direction you grow, you'll keep writing. Even our most senior people do; it's the heart of what we sell.

Your First Few Months

You'll spend your first weeks learning our processes and editorial standards and getting to know your accounts, writing your first pieces with plenty of editorial support. Over your first few months, you'll step into full content ownership of your first account (with your Head of Content close by as a backstop) and grow from there at a pace that matches your experience.

Our Values

At Animalz, our values guide how we show up for our customers, our teammates, and the content we create.

  • Value Over Vanity: Success isn't measured in customer praise, but in the growth outcomes we deliver for them.
  • Two Steps Ahead: Great service means addressing a need or issue before it becomes notable.
  • Power Source, Not Power Trip: We find our greatest impact in being in service to others—our customers, our customers' customers, and one another. True power comes not from authority but from influence.
  • Pursue Mastery: Through deliberate practice and open collaboration, we build expertise that elevates both our work and our ability to deliver transformative results for our clients.
  • Left Brain, Right Brain, Robot Brain: We create extraordinary outcomes by combining empathy and creativity, data and research, and algorithms and AI.
  • In the Arena: We don't advise from the sidelines – we're active practitioners who shape the future of our industry through bold experimentation and continuous learning.

Working Arrangements

Location: Fully remote (Americas or EMEA)

Timezone Requirements: At least 4 hours of overlap with US timezones (EST/PST) to collaborate effectively with our team and customers

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 USD annually

Placement within the range is based on experience, skills, and demonstrated impact in previous content marketing roles.

  • Unlimited PTO policy
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Technology stipend
  • Learning stipend
  • Health & wellness stipend
  • Team lunch stipend
  • Health & vision insurance (US only)
  • 401(k) retirement plan (US only)

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Animalz, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities can thrive. We particularly encourage applications from historically underrepresented groups in tech and marketing.

Equal Opportunity

Animalz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 USD annually

jobs.description:
National Technologies (NTI), a Network Connex Company, is a premier turnkey installer of fiber optic and data center infrastructure. Working on our team puts you on the leading edge of innovation in the digital communications space.

If being a part of a tight-knit organization that operates in some of the most advanced technology environments around the world sounds like a dream job, NTI might be the right fit for you! With the perks of a large organization, NTI remains true to its roots as a home-grown company with an open door culture that welcomes new ideas and encourages professional growth. We set you on the right path with careful onboarding and thorough training programs that prepare you for success in your role and beyond.

THE OPPORTUNITY

National Technologies is seeking a Director of National Labor Coordination to lead enterprise-wide planning, visibility, and allocation of field labor resources. This leader will create a national view of current and future labor demand and ensure the right people are positioned on the right projects at the right time.

Serving as the central coordination point for traveling field labor, this role works across programs, markets, project teams, and operations leadership to anticipate manpower needs before they become project emergencies. The role brings labor demand, employee capabilities, leadership needs, timing, geography, and future assignments together into one national strategy.

WHAT YOU WILL LEAD

  • Maintain a forward-looking national labor-demand forecast across active and upcoming projects.
  • Maintain visibility into available and committed field resources, including employees approaching demobilization and their next assignments.
  • Coordinate mobilizations, demobilizations, transfers, and future assignments across projects, programs, markets, and geographic regions.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive field skills registry covering employee experience, certifications, technical strengths, leadership capability, customer experience, travel availability, and project history.
  • Match employee capabilities to project requirements, looking beyond job classifications alone.
  • Identify future labor shortages, surpluses, and capability gaps before they affect project execution.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements with project, program, and operations leadership.
  • Manage critical traveling personnel as national organizational resources rather than isolated market resources.
  • Forecast future recruiting and manpower requirements and coordinate leadership succession needs with National Labor Development.
  • Provide executive leadership with labor forecasts, utilization information, risk assessments, and resource recommendations.
  • Develop standardized manpower-request and forecasting processes, and challenge unsupported or excessive requests.
  • Reduce unnecessary dependence on external labor through stronger internal resource planning.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role will be reflected in:

  • Accurate national labor forecasts.
  • Critical positions filled when required.
  • Fewer emergency staffing requests.
  • Improved utilization of internal employees.
  • Reduced unnecessary use of external labor.
  • Stronger skill-to-project matching.
  • Greater visibility into future labor demand.
  • Fewer resource conflicts between markets and programs.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Significant experience in construction operations, workforce planning, field operations, labor coordination, or large-project staffing.
  • Strong understanding of construction labor requirements and field-leadership structures.
  • Experience coordinating labor across multiple projects, markets, or geographic regions.
  • The ability to evaluate employee capabilities beyond job classifications alone.
  • Strong planning, forecasting, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and resolve resource conflicts.
  • Strong communication skills and credibility with both field and office leadership.
  • Experience in union construction environments is strongly preferred.
  • Telecommunications, data center, mission-critical, electrical, or related construction experience is preferred.

THE LEADER WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You understand that manpower planning is more than filling names into open positions. You can evaluate individual capabilities, project requirements, leadership needs, timing, geography, and future demand, then turn those variables into an objective national labor strategy. You make difficult resource recommendations based on the needs of the entire organization, balance project requirements against broader portfolio priorities, and prevent valuable resources from becoming unnecessarily siloed.
