jobs.description:
Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring a Back-End Developer IV to serve as lead back-end developer on the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Accelerated Transformation of Legacy Applications and Systems (ATLAS) program — one of the largest civilian IT modernization efforts in the federal government. ATLAS covers a mission-support portfolio of more than 200 applications and roughly 3,000 databases, moving the agency off legacy sustainment and onto cloud-native architectures, automated workflows, DevSecOps delivery, and integrated AI capability.

In this role you translate portfolio architecture into server-side engineering patterns that back-end teams across the portfolio build against. You bring mastery of multiple back-end technologies, messaging systems, and integration patterns, and you apply it where the work is hardest: decomposing legacy monoliths, untangling point-to-point integrations built over decades, and standing up the enterprise APIs and services that replace them.

You lead complex system integrations, design portfolio and application service/API layers in alignment with the enterprise integration and API strategy, drive microservices adoption as a disciplined practice rather than a default, and provide technical leadership for large-scale back-end transformation across multiple delivery teams.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $149,000–$165,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

*This position is contingent upon contract award*


Responsibilities

  • Define and implement server-side engineering patterns within established enterprise architecture and platform standards: runtime platforms, frameworks, service boundaries, data access patterns, and reusable service conventions
  • Establish and maintain back-end implementation patterns — microservices, event-driven, API-first, domain decomposition — and apply the architectural criteria that determine when each is the right call
  • Lead complex system integrations across legacy and modernized systems, including protocol translation, data reconciliation, and cutover sequencing on systems that cannot go down
  • Design portfolio and application service/API layers in alignment with the enterprise API and integration strategy: RESTful and event-based interfaces, API contracts and versioning, gateway integration, authentication and authorization patterns, and developer-facing documentation
  • Architect and implement messaging and streaming infrastructure (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or cloud-native equivalents), including delivery guarantees, idempotency, ordering, and failure handling
  • Design the serverless and event-driven processing built around that infrastructure — AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, or equivalent for ingestion, transformation, and event handling — and determine where serverless is the right fit against containerized services on cost, latency, and sustainment grounds
  • Drive decomposition of legacy monoliths into services: define bounded contexts, sequence the strangler-pattern migration, and manage the interim state where old and new run side by side
  • Lead database modernization work on the back end — schema evolution, data migration, dual-write and sync strategies, and the transition off legacy data stores
  • Set and enforce back-end engineering standards: coding standards, service templates, error handling, observability, resilience patterns, and performance budgets
  • Own non-functional outcomes for back-end services: availability, latency, throughput, scalability, and cost efficiency in a cloud environment
  • Integrate security into back-end design — secrets management, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege service identity, and controls aligned to FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and applicable FAA and DOT policy
  • Build and maintain the reusable back-end assets that make a modernization factory model work: service scaffolds, shared libraries, integration accelerators, and reference implementations
  • Provide technical leadership, design review, and code review to back-end engineers across multiple teams; mentor mid-level and senior developers
  • Partner with enterprise architecture, front-end, data, and cybersecurity leads to ensure back-end designs fit the target-state architecture
  • Have the ability to write production code on the highest-complexity components as necessary — this is a hands-on lead role, not a purely advisory one

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
  • 8–10 years of progressive back-end development experience, including demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams or a large system
  • Expert-level proficiency in one or more major server-side stacks, with working command of a second (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, .NET/C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go)
  • Deep experience designing and operating enterprise APIs: REST, API contracts and versioning, gateway and management tooling, and API security patterns
  • Hands-on expertise with messaging and event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, SQS/SNS, or equivalent), including production experience with delivery semantics and failure modes
  • Proven experience leading complex system integrations across heterogeneous legacy and modern systems
  • Demonstrated experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices, including the migration strategy — not just greenfield service development
  • Strong database expertise across relational and non-relational stores: data modeling, query performance, transactions, and large-scale data migration
  • Cloud-native back-end experience in a major cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers, orchestration, and managed services
  • Practical DevSecOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and observability instrumented into services
  • Ability to set standards other teams adopt, and to communicate technical trade-offs to program leadership and government stakeholders
  • Experience implementing observability, resilience, and performance engineering for distributed services, including tracing, metrics, fault handling, and capacity/performance testing
  • Experience implementing shared engineering standards and reference patterns across multiple delivery teams
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to advise senior government and corporate stakeholders and to justify architectural decisions
  • Working proficiency with approved AI-assisted development tools for code analysis, refactoring, test generation, and documentation

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting FAA, DOT, or comparable federal civilian modernization programs
  • Experience modernizing mainframe or COBOL-era back ends, or integrating with them during transition
  • Specification-first API development using OpenAPI, including contract-driven design, generated clients and servers, and automated contract testing
  • Production experience designing and operating GraphQL APIs, including schema design, federation, resolver performance, and query cost control
  • Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable interfaces that expose enterprise services and data to AI systems and agents
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL data stores — document databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB) and graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune, or equivalent) — including knowing when each is the right choice over a relational store
  • Large-scale database modernization experience (Oracle, SQL Server, or mainframe data stores to cloud-native or open-source targets)
  • Experience with service mesh, distributed tracing, and advanced observability in a microservices estate
  • Familiarity with FAA enterprise architecture, security engineering, and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes
  • Experience applying AI/ML or automated code transformation tooling to back-end legacy modernization
  • Relevant certifications: AWS or Azure Solutions Architect / Developer, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), or equivalent
  • Prior experience in a modernization factory, delivery center, or platform engineering organization

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen
  • Existing FAA suitability determination or transferable federal background investigation strongly preferred

Benefits

The Company

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence.

We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification.

Industry Recognition

Growth | Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Private Companies, DC Metro List Fastest Growing; Washington Business Journal: Fastest Growing Companies, Top Performing Small Technology Companies in Greater D.C.

Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award

Benefits

We offer competitive benefits package including paid time off, healthcare benefits, supplemental benefits, 401k including an employer match, discount perks, rewards, and more. We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. Reimbursement amounts may fluctuate due to IRS limitations. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking. We are committed to supporting your curiosity and sustaining a culture that prioritizes commitment to continuous professional development.

We work hard; we play hard. Kentro is committed to incorporating fun into every day. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

The Sr Data Analyst works independently across recurring and ad hoc analytics needs, translates business questions into analytical approaches, and delivers clear, actionable insights to internal and client stakeholders.   • Support stakeholder discussions by clearly explaining performance changes, report logic, assumptions, and recommended actions.
  • Improve analytics delivery by identifying opportunities for better reporting structure, cleaner metric definitions, improved documentation, and more scalable analysis workflows.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

AI Fluency / AI-Assisted Analytics Expectations

Expected to be an active adopter of approved AI-enabled analytics and productivity tools that improve the speed, clarity, and quality of reporting, insight generation, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Understands that AI-generated analysis, summaries, or recommendations must be checked against source data, metric definitions, business context, and governance expectations before being shared or used for decision-making. Demonstrates curiosity and practical enthusiasm for how AI can improve analytics quality, productivity, and decision support without replacing disciplined analysis or stakeholder reasoning.

At this level, AI fluency means reliable use within workstreams. Expected to apply approved AI-assisted workflows to improve delivery quality, repeatability, documentation, and stakeholder communication, and to help junior practitioners understand where AI can and cannot be used responsibly.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Databricks experience and/or certifications
  • Knowledgeoffinance business conceptsand analytics approaches especially within a retail product pricing context
  • Familiarity with other business intelligence platforms (Power BI, Looker)
  • Additional analytics, business intelligence, or experimentation platform experience and training as relevant

Collaboration / Stakeholder Expectations

  • Serves as a dependable analytics partner to internal teams and client stakeholders across reporting, dashboarding, and insight generation needs.
  • Partners with stakeholder Data Engineering and Platform teams when reporting requirements or data logicrequire more scalable or technical solutions.
  • Participates confidently in client-facing discussions by explaining methodology, findings, reporting logic, and implications in clear business language.
  • Helps create consistency across team delivery by improving documentation, sharing best practices, and supporting more junior practitioners.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

The benefits

This is a full-time position based in the United States. The offered salary range is $90K - $140K annually, depending on experience and location.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

jobs.title: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Care Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: About the Role A US-based medical practice specializing in sleep medicine is seeking an experienced Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Care Coordinator to support patients on CPAP therapy.
jobs.description:
About the Role

A US-based medical practice specializing in sleep medicine is seeking an experienced Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Care Coordinator to support patients on CPAP therapy. This role is central to the practice's remote monitoring program: you will review patient data daily, conduct outbound calls to patients who need encouragement or troubleshooting, document interactions accurately for billing compliance, and coordinate with the clinical and DME teams to ensure patients remain on therapy and progressing well.

This is a clinically adjacent role that requires a warm phone presence, strong organizational habits, and comfort working with data in a remote monitoring platform. A clinical background — nursing, medical assisting, respiratory therapy, or similar — is preferred and carries weight for billing purposes as well as patient care quality. Training will be provided on all internal workflows. The practice is looking for a coordinator who can be ready to contribute by November 1, 2026.

Key Responsibilities

Daily Data Review and Patient Flagging

  • Review patients' CPAP usage data in Sanusom daily, including usage hours, mask leak rates, AHI scores, and missed nights
  • Identify patients who fall below therapy thresholds or show concerning trends and prioritize them for outreach
  • Download compliance reports, upload them to the appropriate patient chart in Athena, and assign them to the correct provider for review

Patient Outreach and Coaching

  • Conduct outbound calls to patients with low usage, elevated mask leaks, or other therapy concerns, using established call scripts and intervention protocols
  • Troubleshoot common CPAP issues including mask fit problems, pressure discomfort, dry mouth, and air leaks, and guide patients toward solutions
  • Encourage and motivate patients to remain on therapy in a warm, supportive manner — the goal is to help patients succeed, not to pressure them
  • Handle a daily outbound call volume of approximately 60 patient calls
  • Schedule follow-up calls and ensure no patient is lost to follow-up

Documentation and Billing Support

  • Use Sanusom's call timer to record monitoring time accurately for each patient interaction, in compliance with RPM billing requirements
  • Document every call in both Sanusom and Athena using standard clinical templates, ensuring records are complete, timely, and accurate
  • Respond to patient messages via Klara within established response time standards

Care Coordination

  • Coordinate with the DME and CPAP supply team on mask refits, equipment issues, and supply needs identified during patient calls
  • Coordinate with scheduling for follow-up provider appointments when clinically indicated
  • Escalate clinical concerns to the provider promptly and in accordance with established protocols

Systems

The practice uses Sanusom (remote monitoring platform), Athena (EHR), and Klara (patient messaging). Full training on internal workflows will be provided. Prior experience with RPM, RTM, or CPAP compliance platforms is a strong advantage.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in remote patient monitoring, chronic care management, or patient outreach — ideally with sleep medicine, CPAP therapy, or DME patients
  • Solid understanding of CPAP therapy, including common patient challenges such as mask fit issues, pressure intolerance, dry mouth, and air leaks
  • Warm, patient, and encouraging phone presence — you know how to motivate a patient who is struggling without making them feel pressured or judged
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with a consistent habit of accurate and timely documentation
  • Comfortable reviewing data dashboards and identifying patients who need follow-up based on usage trends
  • Strong understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements, particularly in a remote work environment
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for clinical patient calls

Preferred

  • Clinical background such as a nursing degree (RN or LPN), medical assistant certification, respiratory therapist (RT) credential, or equivalent — this matters for both patient care quality and RPM billing compliance
  • Experience with Sanusom, Athena, or Klara
  • Prior experience in a sleep medicine practice, DME company, or CPAP compliance program
  • Familiarity with RPM and RTM billing codes and documentation requirements

What We Are Looking For

CPAP therapy is only effective when patients actually use it — and many patients struggle in silence without the right support. The RPM Care Coordinator is the bridge between the data and the patient: you see that someone has not been using their equipment, and you pick up the phone. The quality of that call matters. Patients need to feel heard, not lectured. They need practical help, not a checklist. And they need to know that someone at their practice actually noticed.

The right candidate for this role combines clinical awareness with genuine interpersonal warmth. You are organized enough to manage a high daily call volume without losing track of anyone, disciplined enough to document every interaction correctly for billing, and motivated by the knowledge that your work directly improves patient health outcomes.

Schedule and Start Date

  • Full-time: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time
  • Fully remote
  • Target start date: November 1, 2026

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $6/hr

jobs.excerpt: About the teamZillow has the richest housing market data in the industry.
jobs.description:
About the team

Zillow has the richest housing market data in the industry. You help us build out a foundational model that leverages a representation of who is in the market, what they’ll pay, and how that demand clears against supply.

The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15–20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. This Principal Applied Scientist will help build the Zillow World Model: a single, uncertainty-aware model of the housing market that ties together supply, demand and macro conditions such as mortgage rates and policy. Today, bespoke models like Zestimate, Time-to-Pending and Listing Soon each answer one question well. The foundational “World” Model aims to answer the multi-step “what if” questions consumers actually ask, such as “If I list at $500K, when will it sell?” or “I want at least $800K; what should I list at?”, as consistent projections of one market state, and to serve those answers to Voyager, Zillow’s AI Mode, as a tool.

This is a very new field and an open-ended research effort. You will partner with the World Model working group (listing-state modeling, market simulation and evaluation) and with product, engineering, platform and data teams. Zillow observes both sides of the housing market at a depth no one else can, so this work can directly help guide users toward their goals.

About the role

  • Build the demand layer of the World Model: turn large-scale shopper behavior (search, engagement, session trajectories) into structured demand representations, including explicit attention-to-demand conversion.
  • Design and train latent state-space, multi-tower and/or sequential dynamics models with calibrated uncertainty that support multi-step rollouts, forward planning (“if I do X, what happens?”) and backward planning (“I want X; what should I do?”).
  • Estimate willingness-to-pay, per-home demand curves and market clearing dynamics, connecting learned representations to economic quantities.
  • Apply causal identification in observational data and define where the model must abstain because a correlation does not support a “what-if” claim.
  • Contribute to the World Model evaluation battery: state probes, calibrated multi-target forecasts, rollout drift, causal checks and out-of-regime replays.
  • Independently drive ambiguous research end-to-end, and provide technical leadership and mentorship in translating state-of-the-art research into production impact.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $195,600.00 - $312,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $185,800.00 - $296,800.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Hands-on experience building latent state-space or world models (RSSM/Dreamer-family, JEPA-style latent prediction, or event-sequence transformers): belief-state representations, stochastic transition models with calibrated uncertainty, and evaluation of multi-step rollouts, not just single-target forecasting.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn large-scale user behavior data into structured demand representations (utility or willingness-to-pay estimation, funnel/conversion modeling) while correcting for selection bias in platform-observed populations.
  • Practical causal inference in observational settings (quasi-experiments, instruments, policy discontinuities), and judgment about when a learned correlation does and does not support a counterfactual claim.
  • Proven record of delivering on open-ended research projects, with the ability to scope ambiguous problems and provide technical leadership to scientists and MLEs.
  • Strong programming skills, especially Python, plus experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Nice-to-haves

  • Economics fluency (strongly preferred): market microstructure, search-and-matching, or structural/discrete-choice demand models; reasoning about equilibrium feedback.
  • Experience with agent-based or market simulation, or simulation-based reinforcement learning.
  • Published work in world models, model-based RL, causal inference or structural demand estimation.
  • Experience with multimodal representation learning or bitemporal, leakage-safe training data.
  • Familiarity with two-sided marketplaces, real estate, or long-horizon consumer journeys.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Title:Business Development Manager(Utilities and Critical Infrastructure)

Location:(Unites States) - Remote role

Hanwha Vision America (HVA), formerly known as Hanwha Techwin America (HTA), is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company. HVA is an industry-leading provider of advanced network video surveillance products, including IP cameras, storage devices, and video management systems founded on world-class technologies. We offer end-to-end security solutions and have achieved global success across various industry verticals, including retail, transportation, education, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and airports.

We are seeking a Business Development Manager (BDM) for the Utilities & Critical Infrastructure Vertical that drives new-logo growth, brand preference and revenue for Hanwha Vision's intelligent video surveillance and edge-AI solutions across electric, water/wastewater and natural gas utilities.

Target environments include transmission and distribution substations, generation sites, utility control centers, water and wastewater treatment plants, pump stations, reservoirs and dams, and gas distribution facilities. Target customers include investor-owned utilities, public power and municipal utilities, and electric cooperatives.

As the vertical's subject matter expert, the BDM builds senior relationships with utility security directors, compliance (NERC CIP) managers, operations and engineering leaders, and the system integrators and engineering firms that serve them. The role positions Hanwha's thermal, AI analytics, PTZ and ruggedized camera portfolio against the sector's core problems: physical attacks on substations, copper theft and vandalism at unmanned sites, regulatory compliance, and lean operations staff.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • New-Logo Hunting & Vertical Strategy:Build and run a national plan to win net-new utility accounts. Prioritize target lists of investor-owned utilities, public power and municipal utilities, electric co-ops and large water/wastewater systems.
  • End-User Relationship Management:Build trust-based relationships with utility corporate security directors, NERC CIP compliance managers, substation and T&D engineering, water/wastewater operations leaders, and risk and emergency management teams.
  • Partner & Channel Alignment:Work with Hanwha regional sales, the A&E team, utility-focused system integrators, engineering firms (EPCs and consulting engineers that write substation and treatment-plant specs), and distribution partners to identify, register and win multi-site and system-wide rollouts.
  • Specification & Standards Influence:Get Hanwha written into utility security standards, substation design standards and engineer-of-record specifications, which govern purchasing.
  • Solution Selling & Technical Advocacy:Deliver presentations and demonstrations of Hanwha's value for utilities, such as:
    • Substation & Remote-Site Perimeter Protection:Radiometric thermal and AI-based perimeter intrusion detection, PTZ auto-tracking and long-range coverage for unmanned substations, pump stations and reservoirs. Covers ballistic-attack, intrusion, copper-theft and vandalism scenarios.
    • Compliance Support:Positioning video, analytics and audit trails to support customers' NERC CIP-014 security plans, CIP-006 physical access monitoring, and water-sector risk and resilience assessments.
    • Operational Thermal Monitoring:Temperature monitoring of transformers, breakers and other critical assets for early fault detection and preventive maintenance.
    • Supply-Chain Trust:Leading with Hanwha's trusted supply chain and cybersecurity posture with utility security, IT/OT and procurement teams.
    • Enterprise Integration:Interoperability with enterprise VMS, PSIM and utility SOC platforms over constrained substation and remote networks.
  • Funding & Procurement Navigation:Help customers and partners align projects with public bids, rate-case capital plans and grant programs, including the federal-funding rules attached to them.
  • Market Intelligence & Feedback:Communicate Voice of the Customer insights to Product Management to shape utility-specific products, such as substation-hardened and long-range thermal hardware.
  • Pipeline & Forecast Management:Keep an accurate CRM pipeline that reflects utility capital-planning and budget cycles, RFP timelines and multi-year rollouts.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience:5–7+ years of business development or enterprise sales in physical security, video surveillance, utility technology or industrial automation. Must have a track record of winning net-new accounts, not only growing existing ones.
  • Vertical Expertise:Deep, verifiable knowledge of the utility ecosystem. That includes public procurement and RFPs, rate-case and capital-budget timing, and the differences between investor-owned utilities, public power and co-ops.
  • Regulatory Fluency:Working knowledge of the regulations that drive utility security spending, especially NERC CIP-014 and CIP-006 for electric utilities and AWIA risk and resilience assessments for water.
  • Technical Proficiency:Strong understanding of IP video networks, OT and substation network topologies, bandwidth-constrained remote sites, enterprise VMS architectures, and thermal and AI analytics.
  • Relationship Network:An existing network among utility security and compliance leaders, utility-focused integrators, and engineering firms that design substations and treatment plants is a significant plus.
  • Communication Skills:Excellent presentation and writing skills. Must be able to translate technical and compliance concepts into clear risk-reduction and operating benefits for utilities.
  • Clearance to Access Sites:Able to pass a utility personnel risk assessment for unescorted access, which under NERC CIP-004 includes identity verification and a seven-year criminal history check.
  • Travel:Up to 50% regional and national travel for meetings, substation and plant site surveys, and utility trade events.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Frequent travel via commercial airlines and/or driving is required.
  • Must be able to enter energized substations, treatment plants and remote utility sites for site surveys. Must follow all utility safety rules and escort requirements and wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toe boots, FR clothing where required).
  • Must be able to pass utility background screening for site access.
  • Standard office conditions when working from a home office.

jobs.description:
College Board – Technology – Information Security Office

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team 

The Cyber Security Operations team is critical to the strategic foundation of our products, most notably the secure delivery of our Digital SAT and AP programs. We are a highly motivated group of cyber security professionals who take a proactive approach to ensuring a strong security posture. We partner across the organization to mature our Threat Management and Incident Response procedures and are constantly seeking and experimenting with new technologies. We are currently using a variety of cutting-edge tools that provide comprehensive cyber security operations for the College Board’s critical infrastructure in support of the College Board’s mission to connect students to college success and opportunity.


We learn by doing. The team experiments with different ideas, works out solutions together, and encourages each person to pursue what they are passionate about, whether that is building a new capability, automating threat hunts, or creating new internal tools. A strong managed detection and response partnership and a deliberately balanced on-call model keep alert fatigue low, so the team can focus on meaningful threat hunting and the investigations that matter.


About the Opportunity  

As a Cyber Threat Hunter, you will play a hands-on role in defending the cloud and enterprise environments that power the Digital SAT, AP, and other high-stakes programs. You will work in an AWS-heavy environment at national scale, where proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting, careful investigation, and clear documentation directly support exam integrity and student trust.


This is an early-career role for someone with strong cyber defense foundations who is eager to learn fast. You will start by getting to know our environment and tools, then move into threat hunts paired with senior engineers, help build and tune detections, support incident investigations, and bring a fresh perspective to our playbooks. Over time, you will help validate controls through purple team exercises and use automation to make our workflows faster and more reliable.


You will partner closely with engineers, architects, product security, GRC, and product teams to close visibility gaps and reduce risk in practical, measurable ways. Success in this role means fewer blind spots, higher fidelity alerts, and a cyber defense program that is proactive rather than reactive.


In this role, you will:

Threat Hunting & Detection Engineering (45%)

  • Execute hypothesis-driven threat hunts across AWS, identity, endpoint, and network telemetry, starting alongside senior engineers, and document findings and recommended control or detection improvements.
  • Help build, tune, and maintain detections focused on high-risk behaviors such as IAM misuse, persistence, privilege escalation, and data access or exfiltration.
  • Reduce alert noise through structured tuning, baselining, and enrichment while preserving meaningful coverage.
  • Map detections and hunts to MITRE ATT&CK techniques to identify and close visibility gaps.

Incident Response & Investigation (30%)

  • Support investigation and containment of security incidents by performing log analysis, helping scope impact, and documenting findings.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of incident response playbooks for common cloud and identity-based scenarios.
  • Contribute clear after-action reports that identify root cause, control gaps, and prioritized remediation steps.
  • Participate in periodic tabletop or fire drill exercises to validate readiness and improve response coordination.

Purple Teaming & Continuous Improvement (15%)

  • Participate in purple team exercises to validate detection effectiveness and help prioritize remediation of identified gaps.
  • Partner with offensive testing and engineering teams to translate findings into improved detections and hardened configurations.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen logging, telemetry coverage, and control effectiveness across cloud and enterprise systems.

Automation, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing (10%)

  • Develop lightweight automation and scripts to improve investigation speed, enrichment, and reporting consistency.
  • Use LLMs and AI tools to speed up enrichment, automation, and tool development, validating output before relying on it.
  • Maintain well-documented detection logic, hunt results, and response procedures to improve repeatability and team scalability.
  • Share threat insights and lessons learned with the broader security and engineering community through briefings or written updates.

About you, you have:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in cyber defense, such as threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC analysis, or incident response, in enterprise environments. Recent graduates with a year or more of relevant hands-on experience are encouraged to apply.
  • A clear understanding of threat hunting as a proactive, hypothesis-driven practice, and how it differs from incident response.
  • Strong foundations in endpoint and operating system behavior, including process trees, parent and child processes, and how to recognize anomalous activity.
  • Foundational to moderate cloud security experience in AWS, including working with cloud-native telemetry (for example CloudTrail, IAM, S3, VPC Flow Logs, CloudWatch logs, and GuardDuty).
  • Hands-on experience writing queries and working with security telemetry such as EDR, SIEM, and authentication logs, including tuning detections to improve signal-to-noise. Experience with Sumo Logic is a plus.
  • Experience supporting incident response, including triage, log analysis, scoping, and documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including documenting investigations clearly and explaining findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A collaborative mindset with experience partnering across engineering, architecture, and development teams.
  • Eagerness to learn quickly, ask good questions, and bring a fresh perspective to established processes.

Nice to have

  • Relevant certifications (for example GCIA, GCIH, GNFA, AWS Security Specialty, Security+).
  • Familiarity with modern cloud platforms such as containers and Kubernetes, serverless, and CI/CD pipelines, and detecting identity-based attacks in cloud environments.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills (for example Python, PowerShell, Bash) to streamline investigations, enrich alerts, and improve repeatability across hunting and response workflows.
  • Familiarity with using LLMs and AI tooling to automate security workflows.
  • Exposure to purple team or detection validation activities, and to mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Exposure to investigative and forensic methods, such as log forensics, timeline analysis, and evidence handling.
  • Experience in an MDR, SOC, or GRC role with incident response exposure.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $116,000–$125,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

At CivicPlus, we strive to bring our company vision to life through innovation and collaboration. Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Hours: Full-time, salaried (40hrs/week), Mon-Fri, 7:30am-9pm ET rotating shifts and rotating Saturdays 7:00am-5pm ET

The Opportunity:

As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

Prescription Verification and Dispensing

  • Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
  • Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
  • Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
  • Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
  • Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification

Patient Care

All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.

  • Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
  • Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
  • Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
  • Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable

Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach

  • Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
  • Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays

Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management

  • Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
  • Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
  • Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed

Compliance, Safety and Quality

  • Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
  • Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
  • Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
  • Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
  • Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
  • Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
  • Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
  • Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

Required

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
  • Active Missouri Pharmacy License in good standing with the Missouri Board of Pharmacy
  • Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
  • Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools

Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
  • Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
    • AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
  • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols

What Success Looks Like:

  • Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
  • Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
  • Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
  • Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
  • You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Enterprise Foundations is the engineering team responsible for the architectural and integration work that allows Instacart's Retailer Platform to scale across the world's largest grocers. Our work spans omnichannel integrations — bringing products like FoodStorm catering and Caper Carts onto unified Instacart platform rails — enterprise extensibility (sandbox environments, configuration systems, retailer-facing tooling), and the cross-cutting data isolation work that allows Instacart's ML and Data Engineering teams to safely build bespoke models on top of the platform. As Instacart's enterprise retail business expands to hundreds of partner brands and new international markets, this team's work is foundational to how the platform matures.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II to own and ship one of the team's most complex multi-quarter work-streams — at the seam of omnichannel identity, international storefront search expansions, and partner-owned integrations that we ultimately operate ourselves. You'll be the technical DRI for your area: framing the problem, designing the systems, driving the rollout, and codifying the patterns so the rest of Enterprise Platform can adopt them without your direct involvement. You'll work closely with Staff engineers on the team who set the team-wide architectural thesis, and partner across Connected Stores, Professional Services, Commerce, Search, Data Engineering, and ML to land integrations that hold up across organizational boundaries.

About the Job

  • Own a multi-quarter integration workstream end to end — for example, unified customer identity across FoodStorm and Storefront Pro, international storefront and search expansion for enterprise retailers, or consolidation of bespoke retailer-vertical services onto shared Instacart platform rails — from problem framing through design, implementation, rollout, and deprecation of legacy paths.
  • Drive the technical direction for your area: write the ERDs, propose the options, make and defend the trade-off calls, and bring partner teams along through design reviews and written artifacts that read clearly for first-time readers.
  • Lead vendor and cross-team integrations where Instacart will eventually own the system — push for the right observability, fallback behavior, and cost/latency guardrails up front, and challenge partner designs early rather than inheriting them at handoff.
  • Build reusable patterns, frameworks, and templates that other engineers across Enterprise Foundations and adjacent teams adopt with minimal hand-holding; treat "system at a glance" docs and migration runbooks as first-class deliverables.
  • Operate hands-on as a senior individual contributor on the highest-leverage technical work in your area; raise the bar on design quality, code quality, observability, and operational rigor.
  • Mentor more junior engineers in your area, delegate well-defined implementation pieces while retaining overall technical ownership, and act as a credible technical peer to senior and staff engineers in adjacent organizations.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, multi-quarter projects end to end as a senior individual contributor.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as the technical DRI for cross-team workstreams — framing problems proactively, proposing options with clear recommendations, identifying risks early, and driving execution through to adoption.
  • Experience designing and shipping distributed systems and integrations that span multiple services, teams, or external partners in a production environment with real customers.
  • Strong proficiency with backend technologies in production environments (e.g., Ruby/Rails, Python, Go, or similar), along with relational databases, distributed data systems, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Track record of producing durable technical artifacts — ERDs, design docs, runbooks, and reusable patterns — that other engineers can build on without ongoing direct support.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguous, high-growth environments where partner roadmaps and integration commitments are still maturing, with a record of driving clarity and forward motion through that ambiguity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct domain experience in commerce platforms, omnichannel retail, OMS, POS, catering systems, or connected-store / in-store technology.
  • Experience with customer identity, account linking, or SSO integrations across multiple consumer-facing surfaces.
  • Experience building or scaling search, retrieval, or ranking systems, including integrations with third-party search providers.
  • Background working on international expansion — localization, data residency, multi-region infrastructure, or in-country compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading vendor or partner-owned integrations where the system is ultimately operated and owned by the integrating team.
  • Experience designing per-tenant configuration, isolation, and extensibility for multi-tenant enterprise platforms.

Company Overview

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend.

Why Join QinetiQ US?

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview

QinetiQ US is seeking an experienced Senior Finance Manager to join our Finance team. This position will report to the VP of Transformation.

The Senior Finance Manager plays a key leadership role in overseeing financial planning, analysis, reporting, and strategic decision support. This position partners closely with executive leadership to drive financial performance, maintain strong internal controls, and support long‑term business growth. This position will support financial management and control for complex government contracts, including cost-reimbursable, fixed-price, and time-and-materials (T&M) types, as needed. The Senior Finance Manager will also lead and/or support transformation initiatives across the Company or a function, as assigned. This role involves leading program financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and earned value management (EVM) in support of program managers and senior leadership. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in government contract accounting, financial analysis, and compliance with FAR/DFARS and other federal regulations.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary financial liaison between program managers, corporate finance, and clients on assigned programs.
  • Develop and maintain detailed program budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses.
  • Prepare and present monthly financial reports (including EACs, ETCs, and cash flow) to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support project start-up, execution, and close-out activities, including project setup in ERP system.
  • Track funding, burn rates, and contract ceilings; proactively notify stakeholders of risks or funding shortfalls.
  • Ensure compliance with contract terms, cost accounting standards (CAS), and internal policies.
  • Leading analysis on cost, schedule, performance, variance, and risk reporting and analysis.
  • Develop and provide monthly financial reports to program managers
  • Partnering with program managers and division leads to assist them in running their programs proactively by providing oversight on financial tracking.
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor invoicing, accruals, and funding flows.
  • Support audits and data calls from DCAA, DCMA, or internal reviewers.
  • Proactively analyze data to answer key questions from stakeholders with an eye for what drives business performance, investigating and communicating areas for improvement in efficiency and productivity.
  • Consistently meets all required deadlines (contract modifications, project setup changes, accruals, at risk approvals)
  • Guide and mentor junior program finance staff, if applicable.

Financial Planning and Analysis (FPA)

  • Support management, development and reporting of forecast, as needed, to provide coverage of the Director of FPA position.
  • Support management of the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes, ensuring accuracy, insight, and alignment with strategic goals.
  • Provide proactive financial analysis, modeling, and scenario planning to guide business decisions.
  • Prepare and present financial results, KPIs, and strategic insights to senior leadership.
  • Oversee monthly close activities in collaboration with accounting, ensuring timely and accurate reporting.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate business cases, investments, cost optimization opportunities, and pricing decisions.
  • Strengthen internal controls and ensure compliance with financial policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including operations, HR, and business units—to support financial performance and operational efficiency.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team, as assigned, fostering collaboration, growth, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance reporting, analytics, and financial systems.
  • Support audit processes and maintain strong relationships with external and internal auditors.

Transformation Efforts

  • Coordinate and lead projects to support Transformation efforts across the company.
  • Transformation efforts, include project planning, execution and management of initiatives.
  • Coordinate with contractors, and others across the Company to ensure successful on-time completion of assignments.
  • Support documentation, training and project management.
  • Execute discrete projects, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or related field.
  • 7–10+ years of relevant experience in program control, financial analysis, or project accounting in a government contracting environment.
  • Deep understanding of federal contracting (FAR, DFARS), cost-plus and fixed-price contracts, and indirect cost allocation.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., Deltek Costpoint, Unanet, SAP) and Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, vlookups, etc.).
  • Demonstrated experience with EVM principles and tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; ability to work cross-functionally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • IBM TM1, Hyperion or other similar budgeting and forecasting tool
  • PMP or similar project finance certification.
  • Six Sigma Green to Black belt

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this role is $155,000 - $170,000 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. jobs.excerpt: At Cureety (which recently acquired Reimagine Care), we start with a simple truth: people facing cancer need support and care extending beyond the walls of the clinic.
jobs.description:
At Cureety (which recently acquired Reimagine Care), we start with a simple truth: people facing cancer need support and care extending beyond the walls of the clinic. We partner with oncology providers through an AI-enabled virtual cancer care platform. Our technology doesn’t replace human touch; it amplifies it. We are a team of oncology experts on a mission to improve the cancer journey for patients and providers.

By providing 24/7 access to oncology-trained clinicians and resolving 95% of the patients’ needs virtually, we identify symptoms sooner and reduce avoidable emergency visits. Patients receive proactive, whole-person support for their clinical, emotional, and social needs.
Our vision is to harness the power of AI to make cancer care more human, accessible, and sustainable for everyone it touches.

Part 2: Overview of Role & Core Responsibilities

The Advanced Therapy Monitoring (ATM) Registered Nurse plays a specialized, high-acuity role within Cureety’s Advanced Therapy Monitoring program, delivering outpatient video-visit care to patients at home following CAR-T therapy, bone marrow transplant (BMT), and during the high-risk step-up dosing period of bispecific T-cell engager (BiTE) therapies.

We are seeking an experienced oncology Registered Nurse to serve as a clinical expert, supporting patient care coordination and workflow collaboration. The role is remote. This individual will provide remote monitoring, virtual assessments, and care coordination across Cureety’s multistate ATM patient population.

Operating within a collaborative, nurse-led care model, the ATM RN triages patient concerns, manages clinical escalations surfaced through Remi, our AI-powered virtual oncology care assistant, and partners closely with oncology and hematology teams to ensure timely intervention and seamless communication regarding patient status changes and care plan updates.
This is a full-time position within Cureety’s Virtual Care Center supporting the continued growth and expansion of the ATM program.

Advanced Cellular Therapy Clinical Practice

  • Participate in cellular therapy workflows across the ATM program, from patient identification through post-treatment monitoring.
  • Conduct video visits with patients following CAR-T, BMT, and BiTE step-up dosing on an outpatient basis.
  • Review patient-reported outcomes, physiologic monitoring data, and symptom assessments, supporting escalation pathways during high-risk monitoring periods.
  • Assess, triage, and manage escalations identified through Remi, applying clinical judgment to determine urgency and next steps.
  • Recognize and manage cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) risk, including early identification and escalation.
  • Maintain clinical awareness of cytopenias, bleeding risk, infection risk, and other oncologic emergencies specific to the post-cellular-therapy and step-up dosing periods.
  • Communicate proactively with treating oncologists and malignant hematology teams to close the loop on patient status changes and care plan updates.
  • Escalate cases requiring onsite and provider-level intervention to the client per agreed-upon workflow and escalation processes.
  • Maintain relationship continuity with client clinical teams through virtual working sessions as needed to address workflow, education, or care coordination.
  • Coordinate with ATM clients for patient identification and onboarding into the program.
  • Document all patient encounters, clinical assessments, interventions, and communications accurately and timely within designated EMR and technology platforms.
  • Participate in the ATM program’s on-call rotation.

Program & Quality Contribution

  • Ensure preparedness and compliance as it relates to remote patient care for the defined ATM patient population.
  • Work collaboratively with the Virtual Care Center and ATM team to follow all Cureety policies, procedures, escalation pathways, and communication and documentation best practices.
  • Bring frontline insights back into program design, workflow improvements, and product requirements as the ATM program scales across additional cellular therapy and BiTE regimens and client sites.
  • Support quality reviews, audits, and identification of safety improvement opportunities.
  • Adhere to SOPs, regulatory requirements, and quality management processes.
  • Participate in training, competency assessments, and quality improvement activities.

Part 3: Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Oncology Registered Nurse (RN) with a Bachelor of Science in Nursing.
  • Active, unrestricted multistate Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) RN license issued by the nurse’s primary state of residence.
  • Willingness to obtain and maintain single-state RN licensure by endorsement in non-compact client states (e.g. Nevada & California), sponsored by Cureety, within 30 days of hire.
  • Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN) or Transplantation and Cellular Therapy Certified Nurse (HSCT / cellular therapy specialty).
  • Minimum 5 years of recent experience in malignant hematology/oncology nursing.
  • Direct clinical experience with advanced cellular and immune effector therapies, including CAR-T, BMT, and bispecific T-cell engager therapies.
  • Ability to work a schedule supporting patients across Eastern through Pacific time zones, including participation in ATM on-call coverage.
  • Proficiency with Electronic Medical Records (EMR); must be able to navigate multiple platforms simultaneously in a fast-paced virtual triage environment.
  • Strong clinical judgment, critical thinking, high attention to detail, process orientation, and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and therapeutic rapport with patients, caregivers, and oncology provider clinical teams during a high-acuity, high-anxiety treatment period.
  • Remote position, but the candidate must reside in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones.

Preferred

StarCompliance is on a mission to make compliance simple and easy. Through a customizable, 360-degree view of employee activity, the STAR software enables firms to automate the detection and resolution of potential areas of conflict while streamlining daily workflows and increasing efficiency.

Role

The Platform Quality Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within StarCompliance’s centralised Platform Quality Engineering function, responsible for ensuring platform-level quality assurance across the enterprise SaaS platform.
Reporting to the Lead Quality Architect, the Platform Quality Engineer contributes directly to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated quality controls that validate cross-service integration, core enterprise user journeys, and non-functional platform characteristics. The role is focused primarily on integration and API-level testing across a distributed, cloud-native system, including asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
StarCompliance’s enterprise platform is built on distributed services and cloud infrastructure, including messaging and integration components such as Azure Service Bus. The Platform Quality Engineer is expected to understand how these systems behave under load, failure, and recovery conditions, and how to test them to ensure reliability, resilience, and performance at scale.
The role places strong emphasis on validating failure modes, resilience, and recovery behaviour across distributed services, diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data, and contributing to enterprise performance testing.
The Platform Quality Engineer works closely with Product Owners and engineering teams to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, ensuring the enterprise platform is validated under realistic functional and load scenarios ahead of release

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests primarily at the integration and API layers to validate behaviour across distributed services.
  • Develop tests that validate asynchronous and event-driven workflows, including messaging, retries, ordering, and failure scenarios (e.g. Azure Service Bus–based integrations).
  • Contribute production-quality code to shared automation frameworks and quality tooling used across the enterprise platform.
  • Design and execute performance and scalability tests for the enterprise SaaS platform
  • Build and maintain performance test data, scenarios, and workloads that reflect real-world usage patterns, including message throughput and concurrency.
  • Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines, contributing to reliable, high-signal quality gates.
  • Support validation activities within the Staging environment as the primary platform integration and quality assurance layer
  • Analyse functional, integration, and performance test results to identify systemic platform risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Product Owners to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, preparing targeted integration and performance tests in advance.
  • Collaborate with architecture, platform, and engineering teams to improve system testability, reliability, and observability.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test creation, improve coverage, analyse failures, and reduce test flakiness.
  • Adhere to and contribute to quality standards, patterns, and engineering practices defined by the centralised Platform Quality Engineering function

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable experience in platform- or enterprise-scale SaaS application quality assurance, with a focus on validating integration, non-functional characteristics, and release readiness across distributed systems.
  • Strong coding skills in one or more of C#, TypeScript, or Python, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining automated tests at the integration and API layers for distributed, cloud-native systems.
  • Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and how to test them, including messaging, asynchronous processing, retries, ordering, and failure handling
  • Hands-on experience testing event-driven systems using cloud messaging or integration technologies (e.g. Azure Service Bus, Kafka, SNS/SQS, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with performance testing tools and approaches (e.g. k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar).
  • Experience designing realistic performance test scenarios and generating representative test data, including load, concurrency, and message-driven workloads.
  • Practical experience integrating functional and performance testing into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Experience diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, test quality, or failure analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason about system behaviour and failure modes in distributed environment
