jobs.description:
Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech companythat’smodernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic withhighly talented,drivenand fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what ateam focused on doing the right thing feels like!

Ourtalentedpeopleare whatmakesusfriendlyandhavefun!We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. Weutilizeouremployees’ personal strengths to helpgrowour companyand ensure our team is living their best, authentic life.Weshare our appreciation for our team members regularly during all-hands,a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutoutsin our Teams channels, social media, amongstmore.Ourremote-firstwork environment blendswork and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist.

Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well-being and balance can do for your careerand lifestyle!

We'rean AI-first engineering team, and we treat that as a discipline, not a shortcut. Every engineer here works with agentic coding tools — Claude Codeand GitHub CoPilot are key drivers in our daily work,which changes the shape of the job:

  • You'llspend more of your time on design,decompositionand review, and less on typing. Agents handle much of the implementation; you own the architecture, theverificationand everything that ships.
  • We invest in the system that makes AI effective: project context, customagentsand skills, MCP integrations and multi-agent code review. Improving that system is engineering work here, andit'spart of the role.
  • Judgment matters more, not less. Knowing when to hand work to an agent — and when not to — is a skill we hire for and grow.
  • Skillable'swhole business is proving skills by doing. We hold our own work to the same standard: AI-assisted ornot,itisn'tdone untilit'sverified.

The Software Engineer is responsible for owning features within the designated team - designing, building, and maintaining both server-side logic and infrastructure as well as client-side logic and interfaces that are key to our custom labs and related applications. Develop and optimize APIs, databases, UIs, design systems, and libraries written in either C# or JavaScript/TypeScript. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the product and technology roadmap is consistently delivered.

What You Will Do:

  • Own complex software features within your team’s domain, leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering rigor.
  • Guide and direct AI agents through feature development, serving as the primary architect, reviewer, and decision-maker to frame the problem, set constraints and make the calls that ensure solutions are aligned with business requirements and technical standards.
  • Utilize AI tools to generate high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code, project context management, reusable skills, agent workflows, prompt frameworks and automated quality checks,
  • Drive comprehensive automated testing and verification practices for every feature before release, ensuring unit tests and validation scenarios are tied back to the requirements.
  • Own the quality of all delivered software by rigorously reviewing AI-generated output, challenging assumptions, finding the gaps, and validating that solution fully resolves the problem.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with AI-assisted development, ensuring generated solutions meet expectations for security, maintainability, correctness, and long-term sustainability.
  • Create and maintain documentation of features, design decisions, configurations, and other key technical areas of the application.
  • Actively collaborate with other developers, QA engineers, designers, and product experts in a cross-functional scrum team.
  • Assist with scope and estimation for proposed features, leading to accurate cost and timeline estimates.
  • Handles ambiguity within a feature: fills reasonable gaps in requirements, identifies open questions early, and proposes answers rather than only raising problems
  • Adhere to quality development patterns and practices, ensuring the team adheres to these standards.
  • Communicates status clearly and asks for help without hesitation.
  • Adhere to standards and best practices for non-functional requirements such as system performance, usability, reliability, adaptability, security, legal and other operational aspects.
  • Participate in team on-call rotation during evenings, weekends, or holidays for emergency support or special events.
  • Consistently review work to ensure quality, avoid errors and maintain high standards.
  • Support and promote the company values through positive interactions with both internal and external stakeholders on a regular basis.
  • Other strategic business initiatives or special cross-functional project involvement as required.

What You Bring to the Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field (computer software, computer science, software development, etc.) or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software developer in an agile product team.
  • 3+ years working with .NET Framework and C# required, AND Typescript or JavaScript required.
  • Hands on experience delegating real implementation work to AI agents and reviewing and verifying what comes back for delegated engineering, not autocomplete.
  • Proven experience regularly use of modern AI tools/agent tools including GitHub CoPilot and Claude Code or similar as a standard practice in building software that is not experimental.
  • Strong fundamentals in system design, debugging and code review so AI raises the bar for, supporting existing coding skills.
  • Evidence of building scaffolding around AI tools: custom agents, MCP servers, eval harnesses or enablement that made AI work more efficiently for a team or department, strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional judgment in AI-generated output, preventing pursuits of ineffective solutions and technical dead ends and ensuring course correction early.
  • Demonstrated experience in MSSQL and Entity Framework.
  • Proficiency in collaborating with UX designers to translate designs into working software.
  • Proficiency in creating and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Proficiency in Unit Testing, including writing comprehensive, maintainable, and efficient test cases to ensure code correctness, reliability, and performance.
  • Experience working with cloud native applications.
  • Proactively addresses challenges, seeking opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Self-motivation and the ability to contribute effectively with minimal supervision, within a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to adapt to dynamic project needs while maintaining quality and focus.
  • Ability to participate in team on-call rotation during evenings, weekends, or holidays for emergency support or special events.
  • Experience with the following is appreciated but not strictly required: Authentication (e.g., OIDC, OAuth, SAML), NextJS, ExpressJS, and Building pipelines and DevOps practices.

Salary Range

The base salary for this position is $115,000 - $145,000 annually. Consistent with applicable laws, compensation will be determined based on the candidate's level, relevant skills, qualifications, and experience along with requirements for the position and annual financial plans.

Skillable is a distributed first team with employees working across the U.S., and we do not consider geography when determining compensation ranges.

Pay range and current benefit offerings are effective for 90 days from posting date. Standard employment offerings are subject to potential change upon periodic review and analysis, at the discretion of Skillable.

What We Offer

We believe in providing a suite of benefits that ensure our employees know we appreciate them as people first. Skillable wants to be a company that promotes physical, emotional and all around well-being through our benefit offerings! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Fully remote with a monthly stipend to pay for office services and supplies
  • Medical (2 plan options), dental (2 plan options), vision, health savings account with generous employer contributions, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, EAP, group paid life insurance, group paid STD and LTD and voluntary life/AD&D insurance, accident and critical illness options.
  • 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, healthy lifestyle reimbursements.
  • Unlimited PTO, Paid holidays, bereavement leave, parental leave, caregiver leave and paid FMLA leave.
  • Privilege of logging off at 2:00 pm local time, every Friday for team members who are caught up on work and meeting deliverables. Full company closure during the 4th of July holiday week.

  • Stipend of $200 a month for office expenses.
  • Access to pet insurance; access for employees and dependents to Skillable learning opportunities through our product and more!

Working Conditions:

The job conditions for this position are in a remote home office setting, requiring a space that supports privacy and focus to attend to regular and frequent video and voice calls. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Periodic travel may be required equaling up to approximately 10% of the time.

Skillable participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work int he U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment.

If you did not apply but are being pursuedabouta position, ourinitialoutreach will only occur through LinkedIn - not via Indeed. If you receive an unexpected message directing you to apply through another website or from anyone other than our Talent Acquisition Manager, please treat it with caution.

Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a hands-on Technical Architect to lead customer-facing application development and modernization initiatives. You will work directly with customers to understand their applications, business processes, data, integrations, and modernization objectives, then translate those needs into production-ready architecture and software.

The ideal candidate combines traditional software-engineering depth with hands-on experience building and deploying enterprise applications on Appian and/or Salesforce. This is not a platform-administration or low-code-only role. You will use modern AI-assisted development tools to generate and accelerate code, tests, documentation, and technical analysis while remaining accountable for the security, quality, maintainability, and production readiness of the final solution.

Responsibilities

  • Lead customer discovery and translate business and mission requirements into solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation plans.

  • Assess existing applications, workflows, data, integrations, infrastructure, and modernization constraints.

  • Architect and build enterprise applications using Appian, Salesforce, traditional software technologies, cloud-native services, or hybrid approaches.

  • Make informed build-versus-platform decisions based on business requirements, platform capabilities, scalability, security, maintainability, and cost.

  • Design application components, process workflows, data models, APIs, integrations, identity controls, and deployment approaches.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools to analyze applications and generate code, tests, documentation, designs, and modernization artifacts.

  • Personally develop critical application components, integrations, APIs, prototypes, and reusable architectural patterns.

  • Review, test, refine, and validate AI-generated code and technical artifacts before production release.

  • Guide delivery teams through implementation, testing, deployment, production stabilization, and ongoing support.

  • Communicate architectural decisions, risks, and technical tradeoffs clearly to customers, business stakeholders, and engineering teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain the required federal suitability or security clearance.

  • 10+ years of software development, application architecture, solution architecture, or technical-delivery experience.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a significant application from requirements and design through production deployment and ongoing support.

  • Strong hands-on engineering experience with Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or comparable enterprise technologies.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying production applications using Appian and/or Salesforce in a large enterprise environment.

  • Experience designing APIs, integrations, distributed systems, data solutions, and secure enterprise applications.

  • Experience integrating Appian or Salesforce applications with custom software, databases, identity providers, cloud services, and external APIs.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, security tooling, and production observability.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to generate, refactor, test, document, or analyze production software, with disciplined human validation.

  • Strong customer-facing discovery, consulting, communication, technical leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production application-development experience with both Appian and Salesforce.

  • Appian certification and experience with process models, records, interfaces, expression rules, integrations, security, and deployment.

  • Salesforce experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, platform events, APIs, data architecture, or application security.

  • Experience determining when to use enterprise-platform capabilities versus custom Java, .NET, Python, or cloud-native development.

  • Federal consulting experience and familiarity with FISMA, NIST, FedRAMP, or zero-trust principles.

  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required

jobs.excerpt: Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech companythat’smodernizing the world of training.
jobs.description:
Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech companythat’smodernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic withhighly talented,drivenand fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what ateam focused on doing the right thing feels like!

Ourtalentedpeopleare whatmakesusfriendlyandhavefun!We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. Weutilizeouremployees’ personal strengths to helpgrowour companyand ensure our team is living their best, authentic life.Weshare our appreciation for our team members regularly during all-hands,a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutoutsin our Teams channels, social media, amongstmore.Ourremote-firstwork environment blendswork and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist.

Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well-being and balance can do for your careerand lifestyle!

We'rean AI-first engineering team, and we treat that as a discipline, not a shortcut. Every engineer here works with agentic coding tools — Claude Codeand GitHub CoPilot are key drivers in our daily work,which changes the shape of the job:

  • You'llspend more of your time on design,decompositionand review, and less on typing. Agents handle much of the implementation; you own the architecture, theverificationand everything that ships.
  • We invest in the system that makes AI effective: project context, customagentsand skills, MCP integrations and multi-agent code review. Improving that system is engineering work here, andit'spart of the role.
  • Judgment matters more, not less. Knowing when to hand work to an agent — and when not to — is a skill we hire for and grow.
  • Skillable'swhole business is proving skills by doing. We hold our own work to the same standard: AI-assisted ornot,itisn'tdone untilit'sverified.

The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for the technical shape of the team’s roadmap by choosing where their depth is the most beneficial, owning cross-cutting architecture, foundational dept, and the tooling that makes their whole area deliver faster and with quality. Develop and optimize APIs, databases, UIs, design systems, and libraries written in either C# or JavaScript/TypeScript. to ensure the product and technology roadmap is consistently delivered.

What You Will Do:

  • Set the technical bar for a team; lead the design and scope of complex software features into well-defined implementation plans, leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering rigor.
  • Guide and direct AI agents through feature development, serving as the primary architect, reviewer, and decision-maker to frame the problem, set constraints and make the calls that ensure solutions are aligned with business requirements and technical standards.
  • Build effective scaffolding that enables AI tools to generate high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code, project context management, reusable skills, agent workflows, prompt frameworks and automated quality checks.
  • Drive comprehensive automated testing and verification practices for every feature before release, ensuring unit tests and validation scenarios are tied back to the requirements.
  • Own the quality of all delivered software by rigorously reviewing AI-generated output, challenging assumptions, finding the gaps, and validating that solution fully resolves the problem.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with AI-assisted development, ensuring generated solutions meet expectations for security, maintainability, correctness, and long-term sustainability.
  • Continuously raise the team capabilities in AI-driven engineering by improving workflows, tooling, agents and best practices other engineers depend on for quality outcomes.
  • Create clarity for a team in undefined territory by framing the problem, setting constraints, and giving others a workable starting point where no pattern exists.
  • Makes the complex clear for technical and non-technical audiences, facilitates healthy disagreements, and consult with others on technical input before making a group decision.
  • Create and maintain documentation of features, design decisions, configurations, and other key technical areas of the application.
  • Lead the collaboration with other developers, QA engineers, designers, and product experts in a cross-functional scrum team.
  • Accountable for the team’s delivery, pace and quality by scoping and staging work across team members and representing them in cross-functional meetings.
  • Define scope and estimation for proposed features leading to accurate cost and timeline estimates
  • Propose, prototype, and champion technologies and processes that continuously help Skillable advance integration solutions.
  • Mentor team members and establish standards by developing talent, resolving technical friction, and communicating direction to create team alignment. Establish quality development patterns and practices, ensuring the team adheres to these standards.
  • Propose alternate designs that improve time-to-market or reduce cost or complexity.
  • Explore and recommend new technologies, patterns, and methods to accomplish items on the technical and product roadmap.
  • Recommend standards and best practices for non-functional requirements such as system performance, usability, reliability, adaptability, security, legal and other operational aspect.
  • Participate in team on-call rotation during evenings, weekends, or holidays for emergency support or special events.
  • Consistently review work to ensure quality, avoiding errors and maintaining high standards.
  • Contribute to interviewing and selecting new team members.
  • Support and promote the company values through positive interactions with both internal and external stakeholders on a regular basis.
  • Other strategic business initiatives or special cross-functional project involvement as required.

What You Bring to the Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field (computer software, computer science, software development, etc.) or equivalent work experience.
  • 15+ years of professional experience as a software developer in an agile product team.
  • 10+ years working with .NET Framework and C# required, AND Typescript or JavaScript required.
  • 1+ years of professional work experience in a lead position or unofficially leading cross-functional projects.
  • Experience working with hands-on technical training environments, virtual labs, or learning platforms is highly desirable.
  • Experience mentoring and developing team members officially or unofficially, as well as promoting best practices and standards within a department and industry.
  • Hands on experience delegating real implementation work to AI agents and reviewing and verifying what comes back for delegated engineering, not autocomplete.
  • Proven experience regularly use of modern AI tools/agent tools including GitHub CoPilot and Claude Code or similar as a standard practice in building software that is not experimental.
  • Strong fundamentals in system design, debugging and code review so AI raises the bar for, supporting existing coding skills.
  • Evidence of building scaffolding around AI tools: custom agents, MCP servers, eval harnesses or enablement that made AI work more efficiently for a team or department, strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional judgment in AI-generated output, preventing pursuits of ineffective solutions and technical dead ends and ensuring course correction early.
  • Demonstrated experience in MSSQL and Entity Framework.
  • Proficiency in collaborating with UX designers to translate designs into working software.
  • Proficiency in creating and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Proficiency in Unit Testing, including writing comprehensive, maintainable, and efficient test cases to ensure code correctness, reliability, and performance.
  • Experience working with cloud native applications.
  • Proactively addresses challenges, seeking opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to contribute effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to adapt to dynamic project needs while maintaining quality and focus.
  • Ability to participate in team on-call rotation during evenings, weekends, or holidays for emergency support or special events.
  • Experience with the following is appreciated but not strictly required: Authentication (e.g., OIDC, OAuth, SAML), NextJS, ExpressJS, and Building pipelines and DevOps practices.

Salary Range

The base salary for this position is $150,000 - $200,000 annually. Consistent with applicable laws, compensation will be determined based on the candidate's level, relevant skills, qualifications, and experience along with requirements for the position and annual financial plans.

Skillable is a distributed first team with employees working across the U.S., and we do not consider geography when determining compensation ranges.

Pay range and current benefit offerings are effective for 90 days from posting date. Standard employment offerings are subject to potential change upon periodic review and analysis, at the discretion of Skillable.

What We Offer

We believe in providing a suite of benefits that ensure our employees know we appreciate them as people first. Skillable wants to be a company that promotes physical, emotional and all around well-being through our benefit offerings! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Fully remote with a monthly stipend to pay for office services and supplies
  • Medical (2 plan options), dental (2 plan options), vision, health savings account with generous employer contributions, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, EAP, group paid life insurance, group paid STD and LTD and voluntary life/AD&D insurance, accident and critical illness options.
  • 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, healthy lifestyle reimbursements.
  • Unlimited PTO, Paid holidays, bereavement leave, parental leave, caregiver leave and paid FMLA leave.
  • Privilege of logging off at 2:00 pm local time, every Friday for team members who are caught up on work and meeting deliverables. Full company closure during the 4th of July holiday week.
  • Reimbursement for up to $750 annually to use towards lifestyle choices that impact their wellness such as gym memberships, fitness classes or healthy meal plans,
  • Stipend of $200 a month for office expenses.
  • Access to pet insurance; access for employees and dependents to Skillable learning opportunities through our product and more!

Working Conditions:

The job conditions for this position are in a remote home office setting, requiring a space that supports privacy and focus to attend to regular and frequent video and voice calls. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Periodic travel may be required equaling up to approximately 10% of the time.

Skillable participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work int he U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment.

Fraud Prevention:

To protect candidates from recruitingscams, please note that our Talent Acquisition Manager will only contact applicants using the personal contact information provided when applying through our official careers page. If you did not apply but are being pursuedabouta position, ourinitialoutreach will only occur through LinkedIn - not via Indeed. If you receive an unexpected message directing you to apply through another website or from anyone other than our Talent Acquisition Manager, please treat it with caution.

Skillable can only hire potential candidates with a primary residence in the following States: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IN, KY, MA, ME, MI, MO, NC, ND, NE, NH, NV, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking a highly experienced Staff Applications Engineer with 10+ years of professional software engineering experience to provide deep technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and drive the design and execution of complex, cross-functional initiatives. As a Staff Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in defining technical strategy, shaping architecture, establishing engineering best practices, and delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions that support long-term business objectives.

  • Drive improvements in scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of critical applications and platforms.
  • Lead incident response for high-impact production issues and establish processes for continuous operational improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering leadership, product management, architects, and executive stakeholders to align technical strategy with business priorities.

  • Conduct code reviews and contribute hands-on development to high-impact components where technical leadership is most valuable.
  • Raise the engineering hiring bar by participating in technical interviews, mentoring interviewers, and improving hiring processes.
  • Represent engineering in cross-functional planning, prioritization, and roadmap discussions, helping stakeholders make informed technical decisions.
  • Author and review architecture documents, technical RFCs, design specifications, and architecture decision records (ADRs) to create lasting technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience leading large-scale, cross-functional engineering initiatives.
  • Proven success designing and delivering complex distributed systems, cloud-native applications, or large-scale enterprise platforms.
  • Deep expertise in one or more areas including distributed systems, cloud platforms, microservices architecture, or large-scale data systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern backend language such as Java, C#, Go, Python, or C++.
  • Extensive experience with system architecture, software design patterns, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Public technical contributions such as conference presentations, open-source projects, technical blogs, or published papers.
  • Hands-on experience operating and supporting high-scale production systems.
  • Experience influencing engineering organizations, technology strategy, and software architecture across multiple teams.
  • Familiarity with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and cost-aware engineering practices.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Technically proficient Product Manager to oversee the day-to-day implementation and enhancement of our clinical integration and interoperability capabilities. This role will be responsible for managing implementation CMS-0057 compliance initiatives, Azure-based FHIR data ingestion pipeline, and bi-directional integration with EHR systems. The Product Manager will work closely with engineering, clinical, compliance, and external partners to deliver scalable, standards-based healthcare interoperability solutions.


What you will do:

  • Drive the Clinical and Interoperability pod strategy and execution, focusing on compliance, scalability, and provider impact.
  • Lead implementation of CMS-0057 including Provider Access APIs, Prior Authorization workflows (CRD, DTR, PAS), and Payer-to-Payer Data Exchange.
  • Oversee ingestion of clinical data using FHIR APIs via Azure Health Data Services, Azure Functions (Node.js and C#), and Azure Data Factory.
  • Manage bi-directional EHR integration efforts using FHIR, HL7v2, and other healthcare data standards.
  • Ensure all interoperability components align with Azure-native architecture and HIPAA compliance requirements.
  • Work with internal Data Governance teams to support data lineage, metadata, and data quality initiatives.
  • Translate clinical and technical requirements into clear product specifications for development teams.
  • Collaborate with EHR vendors and provider partners to streamline data exchange and onboarding.
  • Collaborate with RISK Adjustment Team and Quality Gap stakeholders to ensure FHIR clinical data is flowing as expected and is being harnessed for the appropriate inputs around HCC risk score and care gaps
  • Maintain ,build processes & Control around existing EMR eco systems and govern accordingly
  • Engage stakeholders across payer, provider, and technical teams to drive adoption and usage.
  • Stay informed on regulatory changes, FHIR enhancements, and interoperability trends like TEFCA and USCDI+.

What you need to succeed:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in healthcare, health IT, or payer systems.
  • Proven experience with CMS-0057, Da Vinci Implementation Guides (PAS, CRD, DTR), and healthcare compliance.
  • Strong technical understanding of FHIR, HL7, USCDI, CCDA, and clinical data ingestion pipelines.
  • Experience with Azure Health Data Services, Azure Functions (Node.js and C#), and Azure Data Factory.
  • Demonstrated background in integrating with EHR systems
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills across technical and clinical audiences.
  • Ability to manage agile teams, prioritize backlogs, and deliver outcomes in cross-functional settings.

The extras:

  • Experience with payer-provider interoperability platforms, TEFCA, or care coordination tools.

  • Knowledge of value-based care, risk adjustment (HCC coding), and HEDIS/STAR measure implications.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

jobs.excerpt: AboutSwan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking.
jobs.description:
About

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

To learn more about us:About Swan;Our story.

Job description

In this role, you will be the QA reference for two product squads at Swan: KYC/Onboarding (how individuals and companies open an account and get verified) and Capital Deposit (how entrepreneurs deposit share capital to incorporate their company). You will join the QA team, which works with every product squad so that Swan ships reliable banking features to its partners. The QA team is small, experienced and close-knit: we share practices and back each other up.

✨ Your mission

Your main mission is to ensure the quality of everything the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads release for the duration of the contract, while reducing the automated-test debt on these flows and making good use of AI to test faster and better.

✨ Main Tasks

  • Get up to speed quickly on the onboarding and capital deposit flows, their business rules and their regulatory constraints, and take over QA activities in both squads.

  • Analyze specifications and user stories with Product Managers and engineers, raising ambiguities, missing rules and risks early (shift left).

  • Design risk-based test strategies and functional test cases (ISTQB techniques: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions…) for new features.

  • Execute functional, exploratory and regression testing (UI and API), and validate releases.

  • Automate E2E scenarios with Cucumber (Gherkin) and Playwright (TypeScript) to cover new features and close the existing automation gap, and maintain the existing test suites.

  • Maintain the test repository (Qase) and the requirements repository so that requirements, test cases and coverage stay accurate and traceable.

  • Report bugs clearly, qualify bugs reported by others, follow them up to resolution, and take part in root-cause analyses and post-mortems.

  • Prioritize your work across two squads, and keep both teams informed of test status, risks and blockers.

  • Use AI tools (Claude) to speed up test analysis, test design and test automation, critically review what the AI produces, and share good practices with the QA team.

✨ Curious about your future team?

In this part please provide a short 3 to 4 line paragraph that gives us the scoop on the team such as the composition, internal structure, operational approach, key stakeholders, and any other detail of the team.

You will join a QA team of 4 QA engineers and a QA Platform Engineer led by the QA Manager, inside an Engineering organization of [X]+ people. Each QA engineer is embedded in one or more product squads (4 to 8 engineers with a dedicated Product Manager) that plan their roadmap quarterly and deploy as they go. Day to day, you will work closely with the engineers, Engineering Managers and Product Managers of the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads, and with other QA team members.
Within the QA team, we share a common automation framework, common tools (Qase, Linear, Notion, GitHub, home-made requirement repository tool) and an AI-assisted QA pipeline that we keep improving together.

Our technical environment:

  • E2E test automation: Cucumber (Gherkin) + Playwright (TypeScript)

  • Test management: Qase; requirements repository linked to test cases

  • Project management & documentation: Linear, Notion; code & CI: GitHub

  • AI: Claude / Claude Code, used across the QA team to support test analysis, test design and automation

  • Swan's public API is GraphQL

Preferred experience

✨ You’re a great match if:

  • You are a confirmed QA Engineer / software tester (around 4+ years of experience), ideally in an agile product team

  • You can work with several teams at once: you prioritize, you say what will and won't be done, and you keep everyone informed.

  • You are comfortable testing APIs (GraphQL or REST) as well as web interfaces.

  • You have hands-on experience with test automation, ideally Playwright and/or Cucumber/Gherkin, and you are comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (or a similar language).

  • You build good relationships easily, you communicate clearly in writing and out loud, and you can explain a risk or a bug to an engineer, a PM or a business stakeholder alike.

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT…) in your testing work, or you are keen to, and you keep a critical eye on what they produce.

  • Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry is a strong plus.

  • You know the ISTQB concepts and vocabulary (test levels, test techniques, risk-based testing, defect lifecycle) and apply them pragmatically. An ISTQB certification is a plus.

  • Languages: you are fluent in English and French.

  • Our ideal teammate: Sociable. Skilled. Empathetic. Frank. We love to challenge each other, and we leave our egos at the door 🙂

It’s okay if you don’t tick all the boxes — don’t let imposter syndrome prevent you from applying! 🙌

Swan is committed to providing a caring work environment for all employees, regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, or belief.

When it comes to recruitment, we’re interested in your work experience, skills, and overall personality. Because diversity makes the workplace stronger and is necessary for Swan’s success, we are intensifying efforts to incorporate concrete actions to help us improve in this area.

About Swan

✨ Our values:

Swan’s core values guide our actions daily. Individually, they may seem obvious, but together, they form a unique culture.

Simplicity: Leonardo Da Vinci said: “simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.” If something's convoluted or confusing, we work extra hard to break it down. - Making complex things simple is what we do.

Long Term: We always play the long game, whether it's to support our partners in their growth journey, or make tangible commitments to climate action.

Excellence: We are a team of experts who consistently go all out to create pixel-perfect banking services and exceed our partners' expectations— whatever it takes.

Be Human: We believe in the power of kindness and the importance of acting with integrity. But embracing our humanity extends beyond interpersonal interactions, it means caring about greater issues that affect our planet.

You can find out more about our culture.

Recruitment process

  • A 30-min video call with our Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Case study

  • Peer Interview automation, test execution, collaboration

  • Last interview with our CTO

jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information

Imunify360 Security Suite is a product of CloudLinux Inc., the maker of the #1 OS in security and stability for hosting providers. Imunify is an innovative security solution designed specifically for shared and VPS/Dedicated servers. The automated, easy-to-use solution with the six-layer approach to security delivers comprehensive and complete attack prevention.

The mission

We protect web hosting providers and the sites running on their infrastructure through a defense-in-depth stack: web-server-layer WAF, runtime application self-protection for PHP, deep application integrations (WordPress plugins and similar), a malware scanner with cleanup capability, and network-layer firewalls and IP reputation. The pieces talk to each other, and the threat intelligence they generate at scale powers detection across the stack.

Node.js is the segment of the hosting market growing fastest, and the next layer we want to build for it is runtime protection inside the Node.js process itself. Most Node.js workloads on managed hosting today are AI-generated web apps deployed by non-technical owners who can't, won't, and shouldn't be expected to patch their own code or audit their own dependencies. We're going to defend those apps anyway — at runtime, without their cooperation, without breaking them.

You'll build that runtime protection layer end-to-end.

What you'll own

  • The product. A brand-new product line, yours to define — what we intercept, what we don't, what the customer-visible surface looks like.
  • The technical approach. Instrumentation strategy, deployment shape, programming language — all open. You'll consult with our architects but the direction is yours.
  • Implementation, end to end. You'll have the full tooling stack we provide — LLM subscriptions, modern dev infrastructure, the works. Use what makes you fast.
  • Methodology. How you build conviction in your detection logic — your call.
  • Cross-layer signal. Our existing stack produces threat intelligence at unmatched scale: tens of millions of monitored sites, petabyte-scale malware sample storage, real-time domain and URL reputation, IP-level attack feeds. These are available for you to plug into. Use what helps.

How we'll measure success

The product is held to four numbers: runtime overhead, false positives, false negatives, and customer-escalation volume. They reflect what hosting providers and their customers care about. Hit them well and the product runs inside a meaningful slice of the modern Node.js web.

What we're looking for

An experienced researcher or engineer who can build and iterate on a brand-new product, driving both the research and the development. The hard part of this work is knowing what's malicious, what's vulnerable, and what's just an unusual but legitimate pattern — and being right about it across the long tail of frameworks, libraries, and customer code we'll encounter in production.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Proven experience building and shipping a new product, security solution, major feature, or technical system from scratch.
  • Strong evidence of end-to-end technical ownership, from initial investigation and architecture through implementation, release, and production iteration.
  • Strong web application security knowledge and current knowledge of practical exploitation.
  • A working sense of how detection rules behave at scale — what catches attackers without flagging the long tail of legitimate code.
  • Ability to start as the PM, architect, lead engineer, and QA for this product. You ask for resources or help when you need them; you don't wait to be told what to do.
  • Comfort directing AI coding agents to high-quality output.

Nice to have:

  • Prior work on runtime-protection products, application firewalls, or instrumentation tooling.
  • Background in malware analysis or incident response.
  • Familiarity with managed-hosting environments.
  • Public security research, vulnerability disclosures, or detection rulesets you've authored.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js runtime and the JavaScript ecosystem.

What it's not

  • Not a scope-and-handoff role — you drive the work and own the outcome.
  • Not a "platform team will productize this later" role — you ship to real customer fleets and watch the telemetry quickly.
  • Not a spec-and-review role — you are hands-on every day.

Why this matters

  • Most managed-hosting customers are not developers. They cannot patch their apps. They cannot audit their dependencies. They will keep deploying vulnerable code from AI assistants because that's how modern web apps get built now. The textbook advice — "secure your code, audit your dependencies" — does not apply to them.
  • If we don't intercept exploits at runtime, nobody will. The numbers you hit on detection, performance, and false positives will materially affect how much of the modern web stays online when the next exploit class drops.

About Certara

Certara accelerates medicines using proprietary biosimulation software, technology and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Its clients include more than 2,000 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions and regulatory agencies across 62 countries.

Work that matters: When good drugs get delayed to the market, it’s not just money that’s wasted. Every day we save gives that many more patients longer, healthier lives. Work autonomously: Enjoy the freedom to develop your talents without being micromanaged. We’ll support you as you add to your skillset and grow to own multiple projects. jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Engineering team

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

About the team

Affirm’s Communications team builds and modernizes the highly available platform that delivers billions of customer messages reliably and on time across the customer journey. As a senior backend engineer, you will shape multi-region, multi-tenant infrastructure, APIs, and vendor integrations that help product teams communicate with customers at scale.

What you’ll do

  • You will own and deliver quarterly technical goals for the Communications area, collaborating with teammates to solve ambiguous, open-ended problems across messaging infrastructure.

  • You will design and evolve reliable backend services for high-volume communications across multi-region, multi-tenant environments, including orchestration, delivery, preferences, templates, and observability.

  • You will collaborate with product management, design, analytics, security, and engineering partners throughout the product lifecycle, articulating technical constraints and balancing customer impact, risks, and trade-offs.

  • You will design, implement, and operate resilient integrations with external messaging vendors, balancing reliability, latency, cost, and compliance.

  • You will proactively identify and solve project, process, technology, or business issues that affect scalability, developer experience, and operational resilience.

  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s services by defining service-level objectives and metrics, improving alerting and incident response, and participating in on-call efforts.

  • You will foster quality and ownership by improving design, testing, code review, rollout, and operational standards, and advocating for them through writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback, mentorship, and technical direction, and leading by example.

  • On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What we look for

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar.

  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, DynamoDB, and Kubernetes.

  • You have experience designing multi-region, multi-tenant platforms with strong isolation, scalability, failure recovery, and data-consistency guarantees.

  • You have experience integrating with third-party communications or messaging vendors and designing abstractions that account for different capabilities, rate limits, and failure modes.

  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

  • You are proficient with AI-assisted development tools and apply sound judgment to validate their outputs.

  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Compensation & Benefits

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

ESP base pay range per year: €86,000 - €122,000

Additional benefits include:
• Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle
• Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge
• Learning & Development programs
• Parental benefits

• Employee Resource & Community Groups

Location - Remote Spain

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this role, but do require that someone is based in Spain for the role.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
Overview

Intrepid, an SPA Company, brings more than 20 years of experience supporting the Department of Defense and U.S. Government, consistently setting the standard for excellence in the federal marketplace. Committed to advancing the mission of the U.S. Warfighter, Intrepid leverages technological superiority to deliver innovative solutions across air, space, land, and sea domains. We are proud to foster a collaborative, dynamic work environment, offering competitive compensation and an industry-leading 401k contribution. Our team is built through merit and achievement, and we’re always looking for the best and brightest to join us in our growth. We treat our people like family, we are mission-focused, and we give back! Join us today.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team to support the Army Material Command. This position will be responsible for working with clients to strengthen their financial management processes, operations and systems, with a focus on maximizing the impact of the organization’s resources. Additionally, this position will provide data management, analysis, and visualization capabilities with the accounting and financial processes, creating continuous audit readiness as well as provide advisory and support on asset visibility and accountability, asset resolution, and disposition.


Responsibilities

Seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our practice with a dedicated focus on military clients in the Defense & Security segment. This individual will have a big data architecture background, responsible for writing new python scripts, running existing code/jobs, editing complex inter-related python scripts, running Glue jobs (and other pipelines), implementing star-schema data models for PowerBI, designing Power Automate workflows, and other responsibilities with managing a Data Lake. The Data Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy environments, and support advanced automations and analytics initiatives for our federal client.

Responsibilities include:

  • Create ad hoc python script/SQL code or edit existing scripts for data ingestion or transformation.
  • Manage pipelines in a large Databricks AWS Data Lake (via Databricks: S3 > Glue > S3 via SQL and Python).
  • Restructure source data (implement a data model) and connection for PowerBI dashboards.
  • Provide documentation or work with another team member to create documentation for products created.
  • Analyze existing technical processes and systems to identify gaps, recommend improvements, and support modernization initiatives. Gaps include AWS environment size and scoping, opportunities for ML models, NLP models, connections to source data rather than uploaded data, PowerAutomate workflows, in-built QA flags, etc.
  • Support integration of advanced analytics and automation tools, leveraging platforms such as Power BI, Qlik, Power Apps, and Databricks to improve reporting and decision-making.
  • Design, configure, and develop custom solutions in Microsoft Power Platform using Power Apps, Power Automations, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in development and production environments to maintain stable and reliable data pipelines.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or minimum 5 years or more of experience in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Logistics or Business Management.
  • Strong Core Technological Skills in: Python, SQL, Microsoft Dataverse (CDS), Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, and PowerBI.
  • Experience with data analytics, automation, and AI tools.
  • Experience with ETL pipelines, integration of data sources, and big data processing.
  • Experience refactoring and optimizing legacy code.
  • Strong communication and ability to synthesize complex information and deliver high-impact solutions in fast-paced environments.
  • An active Secret DoD security clearance and the ability to maintain it throughout employment.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with Army financial systems, such as ADVANA, GFEBS, and LMP.
  • Prior experience supporting federal audit readiness or CFO functions within DoW or similar agencies.
  • Experience in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik), familiarity with data platforms (e.g., Databricks), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).

Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. , Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $76,225.43/Yr. - USD $151,649.84/Yr.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe're looking for talented Python interns to join our development team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for talented Python interns to join our development team. You'll work on real-world applications involving data processing, system integration, and building scalable software solutions.

This is an internship with strong potential to convert into a full-time position based on performance and mutual fit.

What You'll Work On

  • Building Python applications and APIs

  • Processing and analysing data from various sources

  • Working with databases and data pipelines

  • Contributing to system architecture and design

  • Writing clean, maintainable code with proper documentation

Required Skills

Required Skills

Python Programming

  • Strong understanding of Python fundamentals

  • Experience with object-oriented programming

  • Familiarity with common libraries (NumPy, Pandas)

  • Understanding of data structures and algorithms

  • Git/GitHub for version control

Backend Development

  • Experience with web frameworks (Django, Flask, or FastAPI)

  • Understanding of REST API design and development

  • Working knowledge of SQL and database queries

  • Familiarity with ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Django ORM, or similar)

  • Basic understanding of HTTP protocols and web services

Database & Data Skills

  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite)

  • Writing efficient SQL queries (JOINs, aggregations, indexing)

  • Understanding of database design and normalisation

  • Comfortable working with APIs and JSON data

General Technical Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset

  • Ability to debug and troubleshoot code

  • Understanding of authentication and authorisation basics

  • Good communication and documentation skills

  • Basic knowledge of deployment concepts

Nice to Have (But Not Required)

  • Exposure to financial markets or trading concepts

  • Understanding of async programming or multithreading

  • Experience with testing frameworks (pytest, unittest)

  • Experience with Docker or containerisation

  • Knowledge of message queues or event-driven systems

What Makes a Strong Candidate

  • Self-learner: Can pick up new concepts quickly

  • Detail-oriented: Writes careful, clean code

  • Curious: Asks questions and wants to understand how things work

  • Collaborative: Works well with the team

  • Persistent: Doesn't give up when facing challenges

Why Join Us?

Early Startup Team Benefits

  • Real Impact: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction

  • Fast Learning: Exposure to entire tech stack and business decisions

  • Ownership: Take ownership of features and projects from day one

  • Mentorship: Work closely with founders

  • Growth Path: Clear path to full-time role and career advancement

  • Flexibility: Flexible work culture and direct access to leadership

  • Equity Potential: Opportunity to be part of the founding team (for full-time conversion)

Work Environment

  • Small, focused team where everyone matters

  • Modern tech stack and best practices

  • Freedom to suggest ideas and improvements

  • Learn beyond just coding - product, business, deployment

Location & Work Setup

  • Fully Remote - Work from anywhere in India

  • Pune Office Available - If you prefer working from office or hybrid setup

  • Flexible Hours - Focus on output, not strict 9-5

  • Your Choice - We're comfortable with whatever works best for you

Interview Process

  1. Take-Home Assignment (1 day): A practical Python problem that should take 2-4 hours. We'll evaluate your code quality, problem-solving approach, and documentation. Submit within 24 hours of receiving it.

  2. Technical Round with CTO (15-30 min): Discussion of your assignment, Python concepts, and technical problem-solving. This is a conversation, not an interrogation.

  3. Final Round (30 min): Culture fit, expectations, and answer any questions you have about the role and company.

What We're Looking For

We value:

  • Strong fundamentals over specific framework knowledge

  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly

  • Good coding practices and clean code

  • Genuine interest in software development

  • Problem-solving ability

We're an early-stage startup looking for people who want to build something from the ground up. If you love coding, want real responsibility, and are excited about being part of a founding team, we'd love to hear from you. This isn't just an internship - it's a potential launchpad for your career.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Antwerp, Belgium
jobs.excerpt: MissionThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Belgium Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!
